title: Chief of Staff
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 

Why this role exists

Pennylane is one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, building the financial operating system for SMBs and their accountants. As the company grows, the quality of its execution depends increasingly on how well its leadership team sets priorities, makes decisions, and follows through across the organization.
This role makes that system work. You’ll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives and closely with the executive committee to bring structure and momentum to Pennylane’s most important company-wide rhythms, from OKRs and leadership meetings to cross-functional steering and Board preparation.

This is not a traditional strategy role or a position observing executives from the sidelines. It is a high-leverage operating role for someone who enjoys creating clarity, improving how teams work together, and making sure important decisions turn into action.

 

What you'll own

You’ll help the executive team operate with greater focus, clarity, and consistency. That means:

  • Running our leadership rhythms. Structure the agendas, preparation, and follow-through for key executive and leadership forums. Make sure the right topics are discussed at the right time and that decisions, owners, and next steps are clear

  • Turning priorities into an operating cadence. Help coordinate the definition, cascade, and tracking of company OKRs. Maintain a clear view of progress and surface misalignment or execution risks early

  • Strengthening cross-functional follow-through. Bring consistency to how major company initiatives are reviewed through steering committees and executive reporting—without replacing the leaders accountable for delivering them

  • Preparing high-stakes moments. Coordinate the materials and inputs required for Board meetings, executive offsites, annual planning, and company-wide communications

  • Improving the system. Identify where information gets lost, decisions stall, or responsibilities are unclear, and design lightweight processes that help the organization move faster

Who we're looking for

  • 3–7 years of experience in top-tier management consulting and/or an operating role in a fast-growing company, with evidence of an exceptional trajectory

  • Outstanding organizational judgment—you can distinguish what requires executive attention from what should be resolved elsewhere

  • A structured, concise communicator who can turn complex and fragmented inputs into a clear agenda, decision, or executive-level document

  • Strong interpersonal skills and low ego. You are comfortable coordinating senior stakeholders, challenging constructively, and creating accountability without relying on formal authority

  • High attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. You anticipate what is needed, close loops, and reliably follow through

  • Comfortable operating behind the scenes and measuring success through the effectiveness of the broader team

  • Fluent in French and English

This role is designed as a launchpad into a broader operating position at Pennylane. It is a strong fit for someone early in an ambitious career who wants unusual exposure to how a scale-up operates and is motivated to turn that exposure into tangible organizational impact.

Recruitment process

Screening with Orane, Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)

Interview with Eric, VP Strategic Initiatives (1h)

Take-home business case, presented live (1h)

Final interview with a founder (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


En juillet 2026, Qonto a racheté Acasi pour construire la première offre bancaire et comptable vraiment intégrée pour les entrepreneurs. Notre conviction : les entrepreneurs méritent une comptabilité certifiée, intégrée directement à leurs outils, pilotée par des pros qui ont du temps pour conseiller plutôt que pour saisir. L'IA automatise ce qui peut l'être, et le métier se déplace vers ce qui a toujours eu le plus de valeur : le conseil et la relation client. 

En tant que Collaborateur Comptable, tu rejoindras une équipe en hypercroissance au cœur de cette transformation, avec un portefeuille de clients à piloter en autonomie et un rôle actif dans l'évolution de notre solution.

➡️ Ce que tu feras

  • Conseil de confiance : Tu es l'interlocuteur principal de tes clients sur leurs enjeux fiscaux, financiers, juridiques et comptables — pas un exécutant, un référent. Parmi tes clients, une variété de dossiers comme des professions libérales, consultants, développeurs, RH indépendants, entreprises d’e-commerce, agents immobiliers ou encore des holdings.

  • Pilote ton portefeuille : Tu prends en charge la tenue, la révision et les obligations fiscales de tes clients (TVA, liasses fiscales, dépôt des comptes), avec des outils pensés pour aller vite sur ce qui peut être automatisé.

  • Façonne notre produit : Tu es le lien entre tes clients et notre équipe produit. Leurs retours, leurs frustrations, leurs besoins — tu les remontes directement et tu participes à l'évolution de la solution Acasi.

  • Contribue aux clôtures : Tu travailles en équipe sur les clôtures comptables périodiques, en veillant à la cohérence et à la fiabilité des comptes.

➡️ Ce qu'on recherche

  • Formation comptable : DSCG, Master CCA, ou EC mémorialiste, à n'importe quelle étape de ton parcours.

  • Une première expérience en cabinet : 6 mois minimum avec du front-client, en alternance ou en poste. Tu connais le rythme des échéances et sais interagir en direct avec tes clients.

  • Appétence pour le digital et l'IA : Tu t'intéresses à ce que la technologie change dans le métier et tu veux travailler dans un cabinet qui en fait un avantage, pas un sujet de peur.

  • Organisation et écoute : Tu jongleras avec plusieurs dossiers et plusieurs clients. L'écoute et la rigueur ne sont pas négociables.

  • Envie de construire quelque chose : Acasi n'est pas un cabinet figé. Tu veux participer à ce qui se construit — pas juste occuper un poste.

  • Langues : français courant indispensable pour la relation client. Anglais B1 minimum — nos équipes et nos outils sont en partie en anglais.

➡️ Ce qu'on t'offre

  • Être au cœur du réacteur : L'IA va transformer la comptabilité plus vite que n'importe quel autre secteur. Chez Acasi, tu n'observes pas cette transformation depuis les gradins — tu en es l'un des acteurs.

  • Un rôle produit rare : Tu as une voix directe sur l'évolution d'un logiciel comptable utilisé par des milliers de clients. Peu de cabinets offrent ça.

  • Autonomie réelle dès l'arrivée : Ton portefeuille est à toi. La taille et la complexité s'adaptent à ton niveau — mais la responsabilité, elle, est immédiate.

title: Commercial Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
WHAT IS BOX? 

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU 

As an Commercial Account Executive on our Commercial team you'll be responsible for seeking out new opportunities within both new logos and our existing customer base. You will have experience prospecting, running discovery calls/demos, negotiating, and a track record of closing new business. You should also understand use cases and how to sell across multiple departments and industries. To be successful in this role you will understand how to go after new business and build relationships with potential customers. Intrigued? We want to speak to you! 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, which includes prospecting, conducting discovery calls and demos, negotiating deals, and closing new & existing business across all industries in the Small Medium Business segment (1-2000 employees).

  • Conduct thorough research to understand your customers and prospects better. Gain insight into their unique business challenges and how Box can provide value.

  • Drive the sales process by influencing key stakeholders both internally and externally.

  • Develop a comprehensive territory plan that covers all aspects of your target market.

  • Schedule visits to meet customers face-to-face within your assigned territory if you feel appropriate

WHO YOU ARE

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

  • Fluent German speaker

  • 2+ years of experience in a closing sales role, with a proven track record of success

  • Strong hunter with demonstrated pipeline generation creativity (events, social selling, automation tools).

  • Skilled in qualification and deal progression frameworks (MEDDIC familiarity helpful; outcome-focused mindset essential).

  • Curiosity and eagerness to learn about Box’s product, new technologies, the industry, and your customer's businesses

  • Clear examples of successfully closing deals using an established sales process 

  • Effectively utilizes a repeatable method for identifying untapped opportunities and expanding into new territories 

  • Previous experience in building relationships and selling to executives at all level

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

Based on current business needs, there is no relocation assistance provided for this role.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

BENEFITS 

  • Box Benefits package includes 30 days of vacation, medical, and dental coverage. We have a robust wellness program including 30 days of vacation (plus your birthday off!) and subsidized gym membership. Boxers can also participate in our Employee Stock Purchase plan and other additional perks and benefits. Germany's office is based in a WeWork (Neuturmstrasse 5, Munich, BY 80331,) as well as other European offices across London, Paris, Amsterdam, and Warsaw. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation.

For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice.

title: Commercial Account Executive, UK
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Role Description

Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s UK growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular UK travel, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our UK Commercial team.

We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week.

What You’ll Do

Grow Horizon3.ai’s UK Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions.

  • Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the UK market.

  • Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter.

  • Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities.

  • Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.

  • Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention.

  • Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood.

  • Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas.

  • Previous experience selling technical solutions into the UK market.

  • Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential.

  • Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management.

  • The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person.

  • Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC).

  • Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack.

  • The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams.

  • Fluency in English; additional language skills are welcomed.

Travel Required

We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

title: Communication System Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do

  • Design and specify communication links between vehicle and ground segment, including RF link budgets, waveform selection, and data rate/latency requirements.

  • Define communication system requirements and interfaces with avionics, ground segment, and flight control teams.

  • Support integration, bench test, and field test of communication hardware and protocols.

  • Analyze link performance and troubleshoot anomalies during integration and test campaigns.

  • Evaluate and select RF components, antennas, and transceiver hardware in collaboration with suppliers.

  • Maintain technical documentation in line with requirements.


Who You Are 

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.

  • Experience in RF/communications system design: link budgets, modulation/coding schemes, antenna systems.

  • Familiarity with data link protocols used in aerospace or defence applications.

  • Hands-on experience with RF test equipment (spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers).

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.


What we offer 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe's most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


Security and Eligibility Requirement 

Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/NATO/German citizen and eligible for Security Clearance.

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Communications Lead
descriptionHtml:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Communications Lead to define how Orbital Industries is understood in the market - and to build the communications motion that makes that understanding stick.

This is a category-creation brief. You'll articulate what the AI Industrial is, why CurieOS matters, and how Orbital Industries' full-lifecycle approach (materials, engineering, hardware) represents something genuinely new. You'll translate deep technical work - across AI, materials science, and hardware engineering - into clear, distinctive, high-quality communication that builds authority with investors, technical buyers, talent, and the broader market.

Your job is to set the strategic direction: brand voice, messaging frameworks, content strategy, and open doors for media.

Key Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Brand Voice

  • Define and own Orbital Industries' external communications strategy — how we are positioned, perceived, and understood in the market

  • Build and enforce consistency in brand voice across all external channels: website, social, events, collateral, press

  • Set the messaging framework for CurieOS and its three pillars (Materials, Deployment, Hardware), ensuring our full-lifecycle positioning is sharp and differentiated

  • Write strong creative and messaging briefs for design, video, and campaign work — giving the GTM team clear strategic direction to execute against

  • Ensure a clean separation between Orbital Industries (brand authority, category definition) and Orbital IT (commercial, customer-facing) in how we communicate externally

Stakeholder messaging

  • Work closely with the CFO and founders to ensure investor messaging reflects Orbital Industries' positioning as the AI Industrial category leader, not just a product company

  • Translate technical milestones (CurieOS releases, customer deployments, materials breakthroughs) into compelling narratives

Content and copy

  • Own long-form writing, thought leadership, website messaging, investor content, and campaign assets - from strategy through to production

  • Produce content that makes Orbital Industries' work in AI, materials science and hardware engineering accessible without losing credibility or nuance — you know the difference between simplifying and dumbing down

  • Develop and maintain CurieOS content across its three pillars: materials discovery, deployment engineering, and hardware product development

  • Use LLMs and modern tools to work efficiently while maintaining high editorial standards

Social Media Strategy

  • Own organic social strategy: voice, editorial calendar, content direction and output quality

  • Build Orbital Industries' social presence into a distinctive point of view, not just a broadcast channel — the GTM team handles day-to-day posting and scheduling

  • Track developments across AI infrastructure and adjacent industries to keep content timely and credible

  • Partner with the GTM Lead to align organic and paid social messaging

Website messaging

  • Own website copy and landing-page messaging, ensuring it is sharp, current and aligned to business priorities

  • Work closely with the GTM team on copy for campaign landing pages — you own the message, they own the conversion optimisation and testing cycle

Press and Media

  • Develop Orbital Industries' press function - strengthening media relationships, identifying opportunities, and positioning the company for coverage that reinforces our authority in the AI Industrial category

  • Amplify founder positioning for external audiences, interviews, speaking engagements and media appearances

  • Manage freelance press support and scale the function as the company grows

What We're Looking For

  • Significant leadership experience in communications, content, editorial or brand storytelling — ideally in a technical, deep-tech or science-adjacent environment. Experience with investor communications or fundraising narratives is a strong plus

  • An excellent writer with strong editorial taste and clear judgement; your portfolio should demonstrate range across long-form, short-form and messaging work

  • Deep curiosity about AI, science, engineering or technical products — you follow these spaces because you're genuinely interested, not because it's your job

  • The ability to make technical ideas accessible without losing credibility or nuance

  • Comfortable owning both strategy and execution — you can set the direction, produce the work, and build the systems that maintain quality without you touching every piece

  • Experience building or significantly expanding a communications function — you should find creating something from scratch exciting, not uncomfortable

  • High standards for writing, messaging, and brand consistency — you notice when things drift and you fix them before they compound

  • Strong collaborative instincts — you'll work closely with technical founders, engineers, a GTM Lead, a design function. You need to influence without owning every channel

  • Experience briefing and managing creative work: design, video, freelance writers, press agencies

  • Science degree or background is preferred

Why Join Orbital Industries?

  • Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital Industries as we grow

  • Flexible and generous paid time off

  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan

  • Regular company offsites to the USA and beyond

  • The chance to define the narrative for a new category — the AI Industrial — at a company where communications is a strategic function, not a support one

Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Compliance Officer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Compliance Officer to help establish and maintain the regulatory, permitting, licensing, and operational-compliance processes required to support the company’s growth.

Working within Operations, you will coordinate compliance activities across facilities, construction, manufacturing, testing, hazardous materials, suppliers, and launch operations. You will work closely with technical teams and German authorities to ensure that requirements are understood, actions are tracked, and evidence is maintained.

Fluent German and proven experience working with German authorities are essential.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Maintain the company’s operational compliance register, obligations, permits, licences, approvals, and renewal requirements.

  • Coordinate submissions, inspections, meetings, actions, and correspondence with German authorities and regulatory bodies.

  • Work with technical and operational teams to interpret requirements and convert them into practical processes and evidence.

  • Prepare and maintain compliance documentation, records, reports, registers, and audit trails.

  • Track compliance risks, gaps, corrective actions, changes, and dependencies across company activities.

  • Support internal reviews, external audits, inspections, project approvals, and operational-readiness activities.

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in compliance, regulatory affairs, operational governance, HSE compliance, or a similar role within a technical or industrial environment.

  • Experience working directly with German authorities, regulators, inspectors, licensing bodies, or other public institutions.

  • Fluent German and strong professional English, with the ability to manage clear written and verbal communication.

  • Strong organisational skills and experience managing multiple requirements, actions, deadlines, and stakeholders.

  • The ability to understand technical information and work effectively with engineers, operations teams, contractors, and external specialists.

  • A structured, detail-oriented, and proactive approach to building compliance systems in a fast-moving organisation.

Desirable experience

  • Aerospace, space, defence, rocketry, propulsion, chemical processing, construction, manufacturing, or other regulated industries.

  • German permitting, environmental, occupational-safety, construction, explosives, hazardous-materials, or industrial-compliance processes.

  • Experience with audits, inspections, licensing, regulatory submissions, corrective actions, and evidence management.

  • Experience supporting facilities, test operations, supply chains, contractors, or technical projects.

  • A degree or equivalent professional experience in law, engineering, compliance, business, environmental management, or a related discipline.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: Contract Sr Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
descriptionHtml:
The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.

Engineering Deliverables

  • Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.
  • Telemetry Gap Analysis: Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.
  • Data Sanitization Frameworks: Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.
  • Behavioral Inference Reports: Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.

Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate

Scope

The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.

Required Skills

  • Technical: Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. 
  • Domain Knowledge: Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience.
  • Soft Skills: Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.
  • Independent problem solving: Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources.

title: Core platform growth engineering
descriptionHtml:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

We've processed 200,000+ clinical tests across 4 countries with a team of 20. We're growing 10% week over week. And we're still early.

We need engineers who build systems, not features, people who own outcomes end-to-end, orchestrate AI to execute, and raise the bar for everyone around them.

You won't spend your days writing boilerplate. You'll write specs that agents execute, review AI-generated code with a critical eye, and make decisions that compound over time. This is what engineering looks like now. If that excites you, keep reading.

We'll shape the exact scope together, mobile, infra, platform, AI, full-stack, based on where you're strongest and where we need it most.

  

What we are looking for:

  • Backend: Membership & payments. A confirmed backend engineer (5+ years) who thrives on designing really reliable data models and services, without over-engineering them. You reach for the simplest model that holds. You'll own the systems membership growth runs on: subscriptions and their lifecycle, checkout and payments, promotions and partner offers.

    We're scaling across the EU, with the complexity that comes with it: new countries, currencies, payment methods, and regulations. This is code where a subtle bug costs real money and real trust. You care that the model is right before the endpoint exists, and that every edge case fails safely.

  • Frontend: Engagement & world-class experience. A confirmed frontend engineer (5+ years) with very good craft and a real sensibility for design. You like things crystal clear for the user, you build neat interfaces, and you don't wait for designs to be ready to propose something delightful.

    You'll own what a first-time visitor meets and what keeps members coming back: the acquisition funnel, onboarding, checkout, the everyday surfaces of the product. Your work has to be delightful and reliable for people who have never heard of us and decide in minutes whether to trust us with their health.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • You've shipped at least one product from 0→1 and felt the difference between writing code and building a system

  • You have 2 deep areas of expertise and can operate across the full stack when the situation demands it

  • You write specs before you write code — precise enough that an AI agent executes correctly on the first pass

  • You review AI-generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to a junior engineer's PR: edge cases, security gaps, design smell

  • You bias toward shipping. A good decision today beats a perfect one next week

  • You're genuinely interested in health — maybe you track your own biomarkers, or you're just frustrated that healthcare is still reactive

 

We would not be a fit if

  • You need a clearly scoped role before you can operate

  • You measure output in lines of code written

  • You've only worked in large orgs with dedicated infra, QA, and platform teams

  • You optimize for stability over velocity

 

Our current stack

TypeScript monorepo · Next.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL + Prisma · AWS (Terraform, Qovery) · GitHub Actions · Claude Code + Cursor

 

The process

  • Intro call (20 min): culture & role fit.

  • Technical interview (30 min)

  • At-home case study: hands-on project, delivery in 2 days.

  • Deep dive (90 min) and team chat (on-site)

  • Reference calls

 

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

 

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

Ton rôle

Tu es la machine à idées de l’équipe. Tu trouves les concepts et les angles qui font scaler les comptes, tu les fais produire, puis tu analyses ce que ça donne.

Ce poste est stratégique, pas opérationnel : tu imagines et tu pilotes, le studio exécute.

Ce que tu fais au quotidien

  • Tu épluches les ads des concurrents et des top spenders pour dénicher les concepts forts : ce qui tourne, depuis combien de temps, pourquoi ça marche

  • Tu suis les tendances organiques (TikTok, Reels, formats, codes, sons) et tu les transformes en pubs qui convertissent

  • Tu es force de proposition en continu : chaque semaine, de nouveaux concepts et de nouveaux angles à tester

  • Tu alimentes le pipeline pour que les comptes ne tombent jamais en fatigue créative

  • Tu analyses les résultats des créas que tu as fait pousser : ce qui marche, ce qui flop, et pourquoi

  • Tu réinjectes ces learnings dans la prochaine vague de concepts

Avec qui tu bosses

  • Les Performance Managers : ils pilotent les comptes, te donnent les chiffres et les contraintes, tu leur apportes les idées. Vous construisez ensemble la roadmap de tests et vous vous challengez.

  • Le studio créa (designers, monteurs, motion designers) : tu les briefes et tu les supervises pour que ce que tu as dans la tête sorte exactement comme tu l’avais imaginé. Tu valides avant lancement et tu leur fais un retour sur la performance.

Ton profil

title: CTO Cloud - CDI Paris - Theodo Cloud - H/F
descriptionHtml:
Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et réalisation en technologie digitale. Theodo Cloud, fondée en 2018, est l'entité experte DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction et le RUN d'applications performantes, sécurisées et scalables. L'entité travaille avec des clients comme Renault, Believe, Safran, Thales, BNP ou Bpifrance.

Le marché du cloud est en pleine accélération : les entreprises doivent migrer leurs infrastructures on-premise, maîtriser leurs coûts cloud (FinOps), sécuriser leurs environnements et adopter des architectures cloud-native pour accompagner leur croissance. Theodo Cloud a une opportunité unique de devenir un leader reconnu sur ce marché à très forte valeur, en s'appuyant sur son approche Lean Tech et ses partenariats avec AWS, Google Cloud, S3ns, Scaleway et Outscale.

Missions principales et objectif

Le/la CTO Cloud est un(e) leader qui a pour responsabilité :

  • offre : avancer l’effort sur la pertinence des offres
    • benchmark des architectures cloud (Kubernetes, Terraform, containers, CI/CD, …)
    • développement d'enablers internes (frameworks d'audit infra, accélérateurs de migration)
    • animation des tech cloud / followers internes
    • formalisation des apprentissages et bonnes pratiques (secure by design, FinOps, IaC)
  • vente : être le/la solution architect de référence sur les offres Cloud
    • participer aux soutenances et apporter la crédibilité technique
    • co-construire les propositions avec les sales
    • faire foisonner nos partenariats tech
  • delivery :
    • communiquer autour des offres cloud en interne pour attirer les meilleurs profils
    • retenir et recruter les techs autour des offres cloud
  • (bonus) marketing : faire le pont entre l'expertise technique et la visibilité externe
    • Proposer des démos (ex: migration live)
    • faire du contenu et des conférences pour crédibiliser Theodo Cloud sur le marché (blogs, talks, livres blancs, tech radars)
    • alimenter les certifications (ISO 27001, HDS) et partenariats cloud (AWS, GCP, S3ns)

Objectifs de performance :

  • à 3 mois : poser la vision du positionnement sur nos offres existantes (ce qui manque, ce qu’il faut changer)
  • à 6 mois : 2-3 missions vendues et délivrées avec succès + équipe en croissance
  • à 12 mois : practice reconnue sur le marché cloud français + partenariats cloud renforcés

Challenges

  • intégration dans l'équipe existante qui a déjà de l'expérience sur la culture Theodo et les standards cloud
  • bien travailler avec les hyperscalers (GCP, AWS, Azure) face à des grandes ESN déjà très présentes
  • conserver son équipe de profils tech pour scaler le delivery
  • arbitrer en permanence entre performance, résilience et maîtrise des coûts sur les projets clients

Environnement

Manager: Group CTO

Le CTO Cloud travaille avec :

  • les fondateurs du groupe et la Head of Practice Cloud pour travailler sur le go-to-market et définir les priorités
  • la Head of Sales sur le closing des ventes
  • la Head of Marketing pour utiliser les moyens marketing groupe et créer de la visibilité externe
  • le CTO Groupe pour la vision tech interne et externe et les contributions à la notoriété
  • les leaders tech cloud pour renforcer l'expertise collective
  • la Head of Delivery pour s'assurer du respect des engagements clients
  • les partenaires technologiques (AWS, Google Cloud, S3ns, Scaleway, Outscale) pour co-construire les offres

Expériences recherchées

  • Au moins +10 ans d'expérience dans des rôles de leadership technique, avec une composante infrastructure/cloud forte.
  • Vous avez une expérience conséquente sur des migrations cloud critiques (on-premise vers cloud) pour des organisations de taille significative.
  • Vous avez joué un rôle business clé dans des contextes de service (consulting, ESN, ou en tant que CTO/VP Infra), avec un esprit entrepreneurial.
  • Maîtrise de l'écosystème cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) avec idéalement des certifications à l'appui. (bonus)
  • Vous avez déjà été intervenant(e) dans des conférences (ex: KubeCon, DevopsRex, DevOps Days...) ou avez rédigé des contenus structurants sur le cloud, l'infrastructure ou le DevOps.

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ?

L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 700 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget matériel pour t’équiper (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🏋🏽‍♂️ Gymlib 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Chez Theodo, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité est une richesse et que l’égalité des chances est essentielle pour construire des équipes performantes et épanouies. C’est pourquoi notre processus de recrutement est conçu pour être équitable, bienveillant et fondé sur les compétences. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’origine, d’orientation sexuelle, d’âge, de situation de handicap ou de croyances.

title: Customer Success Lead
descriptionHtml:
Über BringLiesel

BringLiesel ist die Plattform für individuelle Bewohnerversorgung in der stationären Pfege.   • Die Chance, den Customer Success bei BringLiesel neu zu defnieren und für die Zukunftaufzustellen – eine Rolle, die du von Anfang an prägst.

Was du mitbringst

  • Verständnis für Online-Marketing und Web-Analytics. Erfahrung mit A/B-Testing, CRO oder GA4 ist ein großes Plus.

  • Technisches Grundverständnis: Du schreckst nicht vor einem Tracking-Setup oder einem Snippet zurück.

  • Du arbeitest gern mit Zahlen und priorisierst nach Daten statt nach Bauchgefühl.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und empathisch, auch wenn ein Kunde gerade unzufrieden ist.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und verhandlungssicheres Englisch, denn ein großer Teil unserer Kunden ist international.

Ihre ersten Monate bei Varify

Du lernst unsere Plattform und unsere Kundenstruktur im Team kennen und übernimmst schrittweise die eigenständige Betreuung unseres Bestandsportfolios. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt unserer Anforderungen zu hundert Prozent erfüllen, freuen wir uns dennoch über deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

Du erhältst ein variables Jahresgehalt von EUR 53,000–72,000, welches sich einem Fixgehalt und einer Provision zusammensetzen.

Du profitierst von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen, Vorteilen bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, Unterkunft, der Möglichkeit zum Remote arbeiten, Mitarbeiterrabatten, Mentoring, kostenlosem Parken, kostenlosen Snacks, kostenlosen Getränken, Homeoffice, einer Home-Office-Ausstattung, erlaubten Haustieren, Gutscheinen und Ermäßigungen, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, einem Fitnesscenter vor Ort, einem Fitnessabo, einem Firmenlaptop, einem Firmenhandy, Entschädigung für Reisekosten, bezahlten Co-Working-Optionen, beruflicher Bildung, barrierefreiem Zugang, lockerer Kleiderordnung sowie Teamevents und Firmenfeiern.

Über uns

Varify ist die europäische A/B-Testing-Plattform für Teams, die ihre Website datenbasiert optimieren wollen: cookieless, DSGVO-konform mit Hosting in Frankfurt, tief integriert in GA4 und BigQuery und zum Festpreis statt nach Traffic abgerechnet. Über 450 Unternehmen und Agenturen testen bereits mit uns.

Unsere Kunden kündigen selten wegen des Preises. Sie kündigen, wenn im Alltag die Zeit fürs Testen fehlt, wenn ihnen die Testideen ausgehen oder die Ressourcen fehlen. Genau da setzt du an: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bestandskunden mit Varify echte Ergebnisse erzielen, langfristig bleiben und mitwachsen.

title: Data Center Warehouse Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

JDC Warehouse Specialist
Position Overview
The Warehouse Specialist runs day-to-day warehouse operations at a Nebius data center site. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.
The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.
Key Responsibilities
1. Receiving & Dispatch
•    Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.
•    Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.
•    Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.
•    Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.
2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations
•    Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.
•    Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.
•    Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.
3. Inventory & Asset Control
•    Post receipts, issues and transfers in ERP/WMS on the same day as the physical movement.
•    Create inventory and asset records for received equipment, including serial numbers.
•    Carry out cycle counts and annual stock takes; investigate and report discrepancies to Back Office.
•    Keep the warehouse tidy, labelled and organized by location.
4. Security, Safety & Compliance
•    Follow site security procedures for deliveries, access control and storage of high-value items.
•    Apply safety rules for handling equipment and operating material handling equipment.
•    Keep records complete and audit-ready (SOX, internal and external audits).
5. Process & Continuous Improvement
•    Work according to global SOPs and site-specific instructions.
•    Suggest improvements and report recurring issues to the Team Lead and the Project Office.
•    Take part in pilots and rollouts of new processes and tools (WMS/TMS, automations) at the site.
6. Local Expertise
•    Provide site-specific knowledge (access rules, dock limits, local carriers and customs specifics) to Transport, Planning and 3PL teams.
•    Identify local operational risks and propose practical mitigation.
7. Add-on Roles (when assigned)
•    + RMA: own RMA flows at the site — intake, documentation, return shipment, status tracking.
•    + Key User (IRG / NetSuite / Project44): first-line support and training for colleagues on the system, test changes, collect feedback for the Project Office.
Expectations
Autonomy: Independently runs daily warehouse tasks at the site within SOPs; escalates discrepancies, damage and security issues to the Team Lead.
Impact: Keeps DC engineers supplied with the right hardware on time and keeps site stock accurate.
Communication: Clear, timely updates to the Team Lead, DC engineers and logistics teams.
Travel: Occasional support to other sites during launches or peaks.
Work Mode: On site; remote work not expected.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Data Engineer

Are you technically skilled, enjoy exploring new approaches, and want to avoid being held back by existing structures and processes? As a Data Engineer, you will join an environment where many things are being built from the ground up and where you can actively contribute your own technical ideas. From architecture and data pipelines to data quality and AI interfaces, you will have the opportunity to develop modern solutions while taking ownership of their implementation. Apply now and take advantage of the technical freedom this position offers. 

Your benefits as Data Engineer

  • Compensation: Enjoy an attractive salary with an additional variable component that reflects your experience and technical expertise. 

  • Creative Freedom: Help build a central data platform from the ground up and bring your own technical ideas to the table. You will have plenty of room to explore modern solutions and actively shape the technical architecture. 

  • Flexibility: Organize your working day largely on your own and work flexibly from home or anywhere in Germany. At the same time, you should be willing to attend important meetings, workshops, and in person collaboration when required. 

  • Workation: Take up to four weeks of workation within the EU and, subject to agreement, potentially beyond the EU. 

  • Pension: Benefit from an occupational pension scheme with a 50% employer contribution. 

  • Development: Take advantage of individual training opportunities, language courses, and personal learning programs. 

  • International Environment: Work in an international environment where both German and English are used as business languages. 

Your tasks as Data Engineer

descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Deputy MLRO (AML Compliance)

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

Nu Global AG is Nu's Swiss entity, based in Zug. It went live in October 2026 with its AML/CFT and sanctions framework already in place: entity risk analysis, internal directives, customer risk classification, monitoring and screening standards, and MROS reporting. The same team also drives the next steps of Nu's expansion in Europe.

We are looking for a senior AML professional to act as deputy to the Head of AML/CFTP & Sanctions. In 2027 you will take over the day to day MLRO duties of the Swiss entity, so the Head of AML can focus on strategy, and you will help take the framework built in Switzerland to new markets in Europe, adapting it to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6).

You will join a small, senior team where everyone owns their decisions and does the work themselves. You will work directly with senior management, the first line, our auditors and our regulators.

You'll be responsible for

  • Act as deputy to the AML Compliance Officer (MLRO) and stand in whenever needed

  • Run the day to day MLRO activities: escalated cases, decisions on reports to MROS under Art. 9 AMLA through goAML, and sanctions duties towards SECO, including asset freezes

  • Review and challenge the first line: sample based quality assurance of alert handling and case files, and sign off on changes to transaction monitoring rules and screening thresholds

  • Keep the framework current: entity risk analysis, internal directives and procedures, and the annual AML/CFT report to the Board

  • Issue the financial crime opinion on new products, features and material changes at the Product Risk Committee

  • Be the point of contact for our SRO, MROS, SECO and the external AML auditor, and for due diligence requests from partner and correspondent institutions

  • Own the AML/CFT training plan and the training duty under Art. 8 AMLA

  • As Nu expands in Europe, adapt the Swiss framework to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6) and turn it into binding control requirements for product, engineering and operations

We are looking for someone who has

  • Served as MLRO, AML Compliance Officer or formal deputy at a regulated financial intermediary in Switzerland, supervised by FINMA or an SRO, or in the EU (mandatory)

  • Lives in Switzerland today (mandatory)

  • Meets the fit and proper requirements that regulators apply to AML officers (mandatory)

  • Holds the CAMS certification (mandatory)

  • Speaks fluent English, our working language, and fluent German (mandatory)

  • Has practical experience with the Swiss AML framework (AMLA, AMLO, FINMA AMLO and SRO rules, MROS and SECO reporting), the EU AML framework, or both, and a working knowledge of the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6)

  • Has built or set up an AML function or framework

  • Has taken and defended reporting and freezing decisions, and has dealt directly with FINMA, SROs, other regulators and external auditors

  • Has reviewed and challenged first line controls at a senior level: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC and customer risk classification

  • Writes clearly and precisely in policies, opinions and regulatory correspondence

Nice to have

  • Sanctions expertise: screening, list management, asset freezes and reporting under Swiss and EU sanctions regimes

  • Experience with international remittances and cross border payments

  • Travel Rule compliance, including for digital assets

  • Experience in a fintech or in a newly authorised financial institution

  • Comfort using data and AI tools to review alerts, test controls and draft documentation

  • Other certifications such as CGSS, CCAS, Chainalysis Reactor or Chainalysis KYT (recommended)

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland (you must live in Switzerland today)

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

title: DevOps - CDI Paris - Theodo Cloud
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech. Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein. Pionniers de la conteneurisation, nous plaçons aujourd'hui l'innovation au cœur de notre approche Cloud. Nous concevons des offres qui adressent les enjeux les plus actuels du secteur :
  • Accélérer les migrations et modernisations Cloud grâce à l'IA pour créer de la valeur au plus vite.
  • Construire et infogérer des environnements d'industries régulées (ex : HDS pour la santé, SecNumCloud) sans sacrifier le time to market.
  • ⁠Exploiter tout le potentiel des LLMs tout en optimisant la performance cloud, les coûts et la sûreté industrielle.

Ton équipe : L’équipe technique de Theodo Cloud est constituée de deux pôles : - le pôle Build, dédié à nos projets de création, migration et optimisation d’infrastructures - le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients Au build, tu travailles main dans la main avec un ou une Lead DevOps et un ou une Agile Project Manager pour garantir l’impact de tes actions chez nos clients. Au run, tu rejoins une équipe d’une quinzaine de personnes avec laquelle tu gères un portefeuille de clients. L’équipe run dispose également d’un volet build, dédié à l’amélioration continue des plateformes de nos clients. Nous déterminerons ensemble à l’issue de l’entretien RH le pôle sur lequel nous pouvons te positionner. Tes futures missions : En tant que DevOps, tu travailles sur des infrastructures cloud en suivant les bonnes pratiques techniques et les standards définis par l’équipe. Au run les missions consistent à : - Réagir aux incidents en production et mener des investigations techniques approfondies - Réaliser les post-mortem et assurer une communication claire et structurée avec les clients - Répondre aux interrogations des clients et formuler des recommandations actionnables pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance de leur infrastructure - Concevoir et découper techniquement des fonctionnalités adaptées aux contraintes projet (qualité, coût, délais) Au build tu apprendras à comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client sur sa stratégie d’infrastructure : - montage d’infrastructure from scratch - migrations Cloud et Kubernetes - mise en place de pipelines de CI/CD - mise en place d’outils de monitoring et d’alerting - apport des bonnes pratiques DevOps chez nos clients - participation active aux rituels agiles (Scrum) de l’équipe projet La réalisation d’astreintes est également possible, elle se fait sur la base du volontariat. Ce poste de DevOps est fait pour les personnes curieuses qui veulent monter en compétences rapidement, au contact d’un large panel d’infrastructures et d’outils (AWS, GCP, Azure, Scaleway, Outscale, OVH, …) et de bugs complexes en production. Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à cœur : la formation des équipes business, la diversité, ou le recrutement technique… Tes perspectives d’évolution : La première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead, et de devenir ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles : - une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager - une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Tu disposes d’une solide formation en école d’ingénieur, avec une première expérience en infrastructures Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP...) - Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’une bonne gestion du stress, et sais intervenir efficacement sur des environnements de production - Tu as l’envie de progresser rapidement et de travailler en équipe Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t’auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l’étudier ! Pour information : - Le poste est proposé en CDI, basé depuis nos locaux à Paris. - Le salaire proposé dépend du niveau d’expérience de chacun : nous en parlons toujours dès le premier appel téléphonique. Déroulement des entretiens : Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 2 jours. Si ton parcours retient notre attention, voici le process qu’on te propose : - un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche - un entretien d’une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo - un entretien de technique théorique de 45 minutes - un entretien technique de debug de 45 minutes - un échange de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe dirigeante Notre process dure 1 semaine en moyenne. Tu seras accompagné(e) par un membre de l’équipe recrutement, qui sera là pour te coacher tout au long du process.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Cloud ? L'environnement : 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?
