title: Ingénieur en Investigation Numérique & Développement Informatique (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences techniques au service de la Justice, contribuer à la résolution d’enquêtes et à la manifestation de la vérité ?

Vous aimez relever des défis technologiques dans un environnement exigeant, où rigueur, précision et innovation donnent tout leur sens à votre travail ?

Alors rejoignez notre équipe et mettez vos talents au service d’une mission qui a du sens !

Qui sommes-nous ?

Le LERTI est un laboratoire privé spécialisé dans l’analyse de données numériques dans un cadre judiciaire, et reconnu au niveau national.

Nous intervenons en qualité d’experts judiciaires, principalement sur des affaires pénales complexes, pour le compte de juges d’instruction et de forces de l’ordre.

Notre mission : extraire, analyser, comprendre et contextualiser des éléments numériques susceptibles de constituer des preuves dans le cadre d’enquêtes et de procédures pénales.

Votre mission

Vous aurez pour mission d’extraire les données de téléphones, ordinateurs et autres supports numériques, puis de les rendre exploitables par les analystes, tout en contribuant au développement d’outils informatiques facilitant leur travail.

Vos responsabilités principales

Faire parler les données numériques

  • Explorer smartphones, ordinateurs et autres supports numériques pour en extraire des informations essentielles aux enquêtes judiciaires.

  • Garantir l'intégrité, la fiabilité et l'exploitabilité des données recueillies.

Relever des défis techniques

  • Identifier des composants défectueux et procéder à des réparations sur les ordinateurs et smartphones.

  • Imaginer et mettre en œuvre des solutions adaptées aux situations les plus complexes.

Développer les outils de demain

  • Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de nos logiciels internes d'aide à l'analyse.

  • Développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour rendre les investigations plus efficaces et performantes.

  • Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des outils existants.

Innover au quotidien

  • Concevoir des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux besoins spécifiques des enquêtes.

  • Automatiser et optimiser les traitements pour faciliter l'exploitation des données numériques.

Contribuer à la qualité des expertises

  • Documenter les opérations techniques réalisées avec rigueur et précision.

  • Participer à la rédaction et au contrôle qualité des rapports d'expertise.

  • Apporter son expertise technique lors d'investigations judiciaires spécifiques.

Avancer en équipe

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les analystes et les développeurs pour répondre aux besoins du laboratoire.

  • Partager ses connaissances, ses idées et ses découvertes techniques.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes et des savoir-faire de l'équipe.

Compétences clés attendues

  • Solides connaissances informatiques : Bonne maîtrise des systèmes d'exploitation, des systèmes de fichiers et du fonctionnement des ordinateurs et smartphones.

  • Développement informatique full stack : Maîtrise de Python, SQL et des technologies web (JavaScript, HTML, CSS).

  • Analyse et résolution de problèmes : Capacité à comprendre des situations techniques complexes, à identifier les difficultés et à trouver des solutions adaptées.

  • Rigueur et fiabilité : Sens de la méthode, précision dans le travail et respect des procédures et des engagements.

  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : Capacité à prendre en charge ses missions, à rechercher activement des solutions et à proposer des améliorations.

  • Curiosité et esprit d'équipe : Goût pour les défis technologiques, volonté d'apprendre et capacité à collaborer et à partager ses connaissances.

Profil recherché

Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master 2 en informatique, idéalement avec une spécialisation en développement logiciel, systèmes informatiques ou cybersécurité.

Polyvalence : Goût pour les missions variées, associant développement informatique, investigation technique et résolution de problèmes concrets.

Qualités rédactionnelles : Excellente maîtrise du français écrit, orthographe irréprochable et capacité à rédiger des documents techniques clairs, précis et structurés.

Autonomie et esprit d'équipe : Capacité à prendre des initiatives, à assumer ses responsabilités et à collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe à taille humaine.

Sensibilité aux enjeux judiciaires : Intérêt marqué pour l'investigation numérique, la recherche de la vérité et les exigences de rigueur et de confidentialité propres au monde judiciaire.

Maturité et discernement : Capacité à conserver une posture professionnelle face à des dossiers sensibles, pouvant comporter des contenus violents ou particulièrement choquants.

Mobilité : Permis B requis et disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels ponctuels.

Conditions particulières

  • Les fonctions impliquent des exigences renforcées de confidentialité et d'intégrité. Une vérification du casier judiciaire pourra être effectuée.

  • Lettre de motivation obligatoire : Nous accordons une réelle importance au sens de votre démarche. Au-delà de votre parcours technique, nous souhaitons comprendre ce qui vous attire dans notre métier et vous motive à rejoindre notre équipe.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Une rémunération attractive selon votre expérience et vos compétences, à laquelle s'ajoutent une prime de vacances et une prime annuelle.

6 semaines de congés payés pour favoriser un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.

Des horaires flexibles, offrant une souplesse d'organisation compatible avec les exigences de nos missions.

Des avantages sociaux : tickets restaurant et mutuelle prise en charge à 60 % par l'entreprise.

Un cadre de travail privilégié, au cœur des montagnes et aux portes de Grenoble, facilement accessible grâce à deux lignes de transports en commun et à la proximité d'un grand axe routier. Une salle de restauration est également à votre disposition.

Une équipe à taille humaine, favorisant la proximité, l'entraide, l'autonomie et le partage des connaissances.

Des missions variées et stimulantes, avec l'opportunité de développer vos compétences, de relever des défis techniques et de contribuer concrètement aux enquêtes judiciaires.

À noter : En raison de la nature de nos activités et de la manipulation de données sensibles, le poste s'exerce exclusivement sur site, sans possibilité de télétravail.

Rémunération

Entre 34 000 et 40 000 bruts / an.

title: Insurance Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

The role

Zego Insurance Limited (ZIL) is a Gibraltar-based motor insurer regulated by the GFSC. We're growing, and as we do, we need to keep maturing how we operate as an insurer - proportionate to our size, with strong governance and a firm regulatory focus. This is a pivotal role to help us do that in a scalable and sustainable way.

Reporting into the Executive Director, Insurance Operations, you'll own ZIL's operations and lead insurer-focused projects across the business. You'll make sure we operate effectively as an insurer, bring more of our regulatory and project delivery in-house, and help us get ready for the bigger initiatives and partnerships ahead.

You'll also be involved in the management and oversight of our insurance partners and outsourced service providers, helping make sure the right operating rhythms are in place and contractual and regulatory requirements are met.

Here's what you'll be doing

  • Lead insurer-focused projects and regulatory workstreams, such as onboarding new insurance partners, operational resilience and GFSC deliverables.

  • Be hands-on in delivery. The expectation is to get things done and see them through to completion, not just oversee or track progress.

  • Take ownership of ZIL's operational resilience framework, as well as business continuity and disaster recovery, keeping them embedded and aligned to regulatory expectations.

  • Support ZIL's internal audit programme, coordinating reviews, working with the business on findings and making sure actions are closed out.

  • Further enhance ZIL's governance, strengthening our frameworks and controls, proactively documenting procedures and keeping policies up to date, clearly owned and on their review cycle.

  • Support the oversight of our outsourced service providers, including Zego MGA. This includes maintaining our outsourcing register, due diligence and exit plans for critical providers, keeping intragroup agreements and service schedules up to date, and producing SLA and KPI reporting for committees.

  • Support the management of our insurance partners, ensuring effective operating rhythms, strong relationships and that contractual requirements are met.

  • Continually improve how we operate, simplifying processes and making the most of AI and the right tools to drive us forward.

What you'll need to be successful in the role

  • Experience in an operations, project or governance role within a regulated insurer. Knowledge of Gibraltar, UK or EU insurance regulation is a plus.

  • A solid understanding of how an insurer works, such as co-insurance, reinsurance or MGA oversight.

  • A track record of delivering complex projects across multiple teams.

  • Experience with governance, policies or audit. Operational resilience experience is a bonus.

  • Strong stakeholder management, both internally and with external partners.

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. As a senior member of our Internal Audit team — the organization's third line of defense — you will lead compliance-focused audit missions across our nine European markets (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Serbia, Belgium, Portugal, Austria, Netherlands), operating under the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards and reporting to our Head of Internal Audit.

  • Lead audit missions: Own compliance audit initiatives in collaboration with the internal audit team and external providers to ensure compliance with regulatory obligations;

  • Participate in centralised process audits: Contribute to Group-wide audit missions on centralised processes led from headquarters (fraud management, operational risk, etc.);

  • Coordinate internal and external auditors: Coordinate and oversee Qonto’s internal auditors and work closely with external firms brought in for specialist expertise where needed.

  • Drive recommendation follow-up: Ensure timely implementation and monitoring of audit recommendations, escalating where needed;

  • Contribute to the risk-based audit plan: Support the Head of Internal Audit in the annual risk assessment on compliance topics, feeding into our multi-year, risk-based audit plan.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Internal audit expertise in banking: Solid experience in internal audit within banking or payment institutions, with a track record of leading audit missions (CIA certification a plus);

  • Compliance expertise: Strong knowledge of AML/CFT, sanctions screening, FATCA/CRS, Anti-Bribery and Corruption, and related regulatory frameworks for banking/payment institutions (ACAMS certification a strong plus);

  • Independent leadership: Comfortable working autonomously, leading missions, and managing relationships with external providers and senior stakeholders;

  • Clear communication: Skilled at conveying audit findings clearly, from operational staff to senior management and governance bodies;

  • Critically independent: Strong critical thinking to identify inefficiencies and discrepancies independently; confident in holding and defending your positions;

  • Languages and location: Fluent in English and French required; based in Paris or Milan.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Real scope, real mandate: Work across all nine of Qonto's markets with no scope limitation, on a function that reports directly to the CEO and the Board of Directors

  • Front-row seat on a defining milestone: Contribute to a pivotal moment in Qonto's history as we pursue our credit institution license, with compliance topics at the heart of that transition;

  • Seniority and autonomy: Lead your own missions with significant independence, while shaping how compliance audit is done at Qonto;

  • Cross-functional exposure: Partner with Compliance, Risk, local stakeholders, and various Qonto departments across markets;

  • Comprehensive Insight: Gain an extensive understanding of Qonto’s activities and departments.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Catherine Soria our Head of Internal Audit:

  • Their background?

    • Catherine joined Qonto in March 2024, bringing over 12 years of experience in the banking sector, with a strong focus on retail and corporate banking and payment services. Throughout her career, she has held diverse roles in sales, internal audit, and risk management. At Qonto, she was recruited to establish the company's internal audit function, laying a solid foundation to support Qonto's safe and sustainable growth.

  • What can they bring to the team?

    • Passionate about her work, Catherine brings a positive perspective to the role of internal audit at Qonto, focusing on continuous improvement and safeguarding the group's interests. As an experienced manager, she will support you with care and guidance to succeed in your role and advance within Qonto.

title: IT Manager
descriptionHtml:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payments infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payments fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role

Paddle's IT team is looking for an IT Manager to lead and develop the team that keeps every Paddler equipped, connected, and secure. This is a role for someone who can operate at two altitudes at once: setting IT strategy, managing budget and vendor relationships, and leading people, while also being willing to get hands-on. You'll lead a lean team of IT engineers, own the systems that underpin how the business works day to day (identity, devices, service delivery), and be the person who pushes the function forward - using data and automation, including AI, to change how IT operates rather than just keeping the lights on.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a lean team of IT engineers - setting priorities, unblocking their hardest problems, and stepping in hands-on for complex or escalated issues.

  • Own Okta identity and access management for the business: the lifecycle, integrations, and day-to-day administration that keep joiners, movers, and leavers secure and frictionless.

  • Own macOS and Apple device management and endpoint tooling across the business, in a way that's secure by default and low-friction for Paddlers.

  • Drive the adoption of data, automation, and AI across IT operations - identifying where tooling and agents can remove manual toil, speed up support, and evolve how the team operates.

  • Set and own IT's operating rhythm: support tooling, SLAs, and the metrics that show whether the function is improving.

  • Manage the IT budget and vendor portfolio - evaluating spend, negotiating commercial terms, ensuring that we’re operating efficiently and running a SaaS estate that spans across multiple departments.

  • Implement and maintain baseline security and resilience practices for IT-owned systems (CIS Benchmarks, patching, disaster recovery), partnering closely with the wider Security team on anything that crosses into security engineering.

  • Act as the conduit between IT and the rest of the business - translating department needs into IT capabilities.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have led or managed a technical IT team before, with a track record of developing people as well as delivering outcomes.

  • Are technically credible: strong systems administration and infrastructure fundamentals, and comfortable being the escalation point when something's genuinely hard.

  • Have hands-on experience running an IAM platform in production, ideally Okta, including lifecycle automation and integrations.

  • Have in-depth knowledge of macOS and Apple hardware, ideally managing it in a corporate/enterprise environment (Iru or equivalent).

  • Are excited about AI and automation as tools for operational leverage, with examples of using them - or data and workflows more broadly - to change how a team works.

  • Can manage a budget and vendor relationships commercially: evaluating cost, negotiating terms, and knowing how to get the most out of a tool or platform.

  • Have experience running IT projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery and stakeholder reporting.

  • Understand core security and compliance fundamentals well enough to implement and maintain them.

  • Communicate clearly and adapt your message for technical peers and non-technical senior stakeholders alike.

  • Are a strong leader who can hold a calm, clear line under pressure (incidents, competing priorities, escalations).

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Why you’ll love working at Paddle

  • Sie übernehmen die umfassende und wertorientierte Steuerung der Geschäftseinheiten, was GuV, Bilanz, Cashflow und das Controlling von Maßnahmen einschließt.

  • Sie führen eigenständig finanzielle Sonderprojekte in Absprache mit der Geschäftsführung durch.

  • Sie begleiten und koordinieren die Erstellung der jährlichen Unternehmensplanung sowie von Zwischenprognosen und mittelfristigen Planungen im Verlauf des Jahres.

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Betriebswirtschaft oder ein vergleichbares Studium mit Schwerpunkt in Controlling und Finanzen.

  • Sie konnten bereits erste Berufserfahrungen im Bereich Controlling/Finanzen sammeln, vorzugsweise in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Sie besitzen ausgezeichnete Excel-Kenntnisse und sind in der Lage, sich schnell in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten, wie zum Beispiel SAP-Business One oder Lucanet.

  • Ihr Arbeitsstil zeichnet sich durch Struktur und Hands-on-Mentalität aus. Zudem sind Sie ein Teamplayer mit einer offenen Persönlichkeit und empfinden Freude daran, sich in neue Themenbereiche einzuarbeiten und komplexe Prozesse zu verstehen und zu optimieren.

  • Ihre analytischen Fähigkeiten sind stark ausgeprägt, und Sie beherrschst die Interpretation von Daten und Informationen sowie deren klare und logische Darstellung.

Benefits

  • Wir behandeln Ihre persönlichen Daten und Bewerbungsunterlagen absolut vertraulich und diskret.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennen zu lernen! Bewerben Sie sich ganz einfach über den Button auf dieser Seite.

Passende Jobs für Ihre berufliche Zukunft haben wir fortlaufend verfügbar - unterschiedliche Positionen werden uns dabei anvertraut, mit denen wir uns an Sie richten. Das Joblevel geht vom Sachbearbeiter über den Spezialisten bis zur Führungskraft.

title: Junior Data Quality Analyst
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
As a Junior Data Quality Analyst, you will play a crucial role in safeguarding the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of Kpler’s global commodity market data, with a primary focus on Oil Market Data. Working cross-functionally across business units, you will monitor data health metrics, identify system anomalies, and build actionable dashboards that empower decision-makers. In this role, you will also help pioneer internal workflow automation by experimenting with modern AI-driven tools to streamline data validation and analysis
Key Responsibilities
  • Monitor and safeguard data integrity: Track data quality KPIs across multiple systems to detect inconsistencies, anomalies, and gaps, escalating critical issues to protect global commodity data reliability.
  • Build intuitive visual analytics: Design, deploy, and maintain dynamic BI dashboards and reports to present clear data health insights to key stakeholders.
  • Perform exploratory analysis: Utilize SQL and BI software to investigate datasets, discover underlying patterns, and resolve complex data quality challenges.
  • Drive process automation & AI integration: Streamline data validation workflows by leveraging automation tools, prompt engineering, and modern AI techniques.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner closely with Data Operations, Business Unit Engineers, Data Engineers, and BI teams to align data quality standards with business needs.
  • Conduct root-cause investigations: Address ad-hoc stakeholder inquiries and deliver swift, accurate data analysis to support operational decision-making

    • Experience & Background
  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience in a data-focused role or internship (e.g., Data Analysis, BI, or Data Science).
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a quantitative field such as Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Solid foundational SQL skills with the ability to query, filter, aggregate, and join complex tables efficiently.
  • Practical familiarity with Python, GitHub, and spreadsheet tools (Excel or Google Sheets) for data manipulation and profiling.
  • Working experience with modern BI visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to take end-to-end ownership of data accuracy.

    • Nice-to-haves:

  • Exposure to or strong interest in energy, commodities, or Oil & Gas markets.
  • Active interest in AI tools and best practices, with a focus on improving documentation, streamlining workflows, and enhancing quality assurance processes.

title: Junior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Berlin, On-site
€60K – €85K + Equity

Most Junior Data Scientists spend their first years building dashboards and reporting on what already happened. Here, you'll work on models that run in production and shape what millions of users see every day.

You'll join a small team of people who have built and shipped ML systems at scale, and learn from them directly. You get real problems from week one, and the support to solve them. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more.

 

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Build and fix the data pipelines your models depend on

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Strong Python and SQL. You use AI tools to move faster, and you still check the output

  • You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and you take it further than you were asked

  • Proof that you aim high: a project, result or choice where you went past "good enough" when nobody asked you to

Why Almedia

  • A small, selective team of very sharp people. We keep it small on purpose, so every hire raises the bar

  • Equity in Almedia. Every Berlin-based employee gets a stake, so you share in what you help build

  • Top-of-market pay as the baseline. Outlier impact gets paid accordingly

     

Small team, high bar. If that sounds like home, apply.

  

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: (Junior-) Sales Development Representative (all genders) Outbound & Messen, B2B SaaS für KMU
descriptionHtml:
Buchhaltung ist für die meisten Gründerinnen und Gründer ein Blackbox-Posten: teuer, langsam, und am Ende weiß niemand genau, wofür er zahlt.
mika ändert das. Wir bauen KI-gestützte Buchhaltung, die Unternehmen selbst in die Hand nehmen können, ohne Steuerberater dazwischen. Belegerfassung, Klassifizierung, E-Rechnung, Validierung und Meldungen laufen automatisiert, statt im Monatsrhythmus über einen externen Schreibtisch zu wandern.
Wir sind 30 Leute, betreuen rund 900 Kunden und haben unsere Seed-Runde frisch abgeschlossen.

Aufgaben
Unser Inbound funktioniert. Leute, die uns finden, überzeugen wir. Was wir jetzt aufbauen, ist die andere Richtung: Gespräche mit Unternehmen, die noch gar nicht wissen, dass ihre Buchhaltung ein lösbares Problem ist.
Genau da sitzt du. Du baust deine Pipeline selbst auf, statt eine fertige zu übernehmen.

Outbound (ca. 50 %)

  • Zielkunden identifizieren und priorisieren: Agenturen, Beratungen, SaaS-Unternehmen und E-Commerce im deutschen Mittelstand

  • Eigene Multichannel-Sequenzen aufsetzen (E-Mail, LinkedIn, Telefon) und laufend gegen Antwortraten optimieren

  • Kaltakquise am Telefon, ohne dass es dir die Woche verdirbt

  • Erste Gespräche führen, in denen du Bedarf überhaupt erst sichtbar machst


Qualifizieren und Abschließen (ca. 40 %)

  • Demo-Anfragen und Trials aus Content, Website und Partnern schnell qualifizieren

  • Kurze Qualifizierungs-Calls führen und die tatsächliche Buchhaltungssituation verstehen: aktuelle Kanzlei, Volumen, Systeme, Schmerzpunkte

  • Produktdemos halten, die auf den konkreten Fall zugeschnitten sind statt auf die Feature-Liste

  • Einwände zu Steuerberater-Wechsel, Haftung und Migration sauber auflösen

  • Abschluss und strukturierte Übergabe an Customer Success


Messen und Events (ca. 10 %)

  • Du bist auf Messen und Startup-Events vor Ort, am Stand und davor

  • Du sprichst Leute an, die nicht vorhaben, mit dir zu sprechen, und machst daraus ein Gespräch

  • Gute Gespräche bringst du direkt zum Abschluss, der Rest geht sauber in die Nachverfolgung


Systeme und Zahlen

  • Pipeline sauber in HubSpot führen

  • Deine Conversion-Raten je Stage kennen und wissen, woran es hakt

  • Einwände, Gewinn- und Verlustgründe dokumentieren, damit das ganze Team daraus lernt


Qualifikation
Wir schauen hier mehr auf Persönlichkeit und Richtung als auf Jahre im Lebenslauf.

  • Erste Vertriebserfahrung: Praktikum, Werkstudium oder ein bis zwei Jahre in einer Sales-Rolle, gerne SaaS, gerne auch aus einer ganz anderen Ecke

  • Wirtschaftlicher Hintergrund aus Studium oder Ausbildung. Du musst kein Steuerexperte sein, aber Begriffe wie Gewerbesteuer, Körperschaftsteuer oder Jahresabschluss sind für dich keine Fremdwörter

  • Du gehst von dir aus auf fremde Menschen zu, am Telefon wie am Messestand, und ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus dem Takt

  • Du willst verkaufen und zwar das hier. Unser Produkt verstehst du in Tagen, nicht in Monaten

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: du weißt zu jedem Zeitpunkt, wo deine Gespräche stehen und warum

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, weil du mit Geschäftsführern über ihre Finanzen sprichst

  • Berlin oder Umzugsbereitschaft



Nice to have

  • Erste eigene Outbound-Erfahrung, Sequenzen von null aufgebaut

  • Erfahrung auf Messen oder im Eventvertrieb

  • Verständnis für Buchhaltung, Steuerberatung oder Fintech-Produkte

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder Sales-Engagement-Tools



Benefits

  • Bis zu 55.000 € Fixgehalt, rund 100.000 € OTE bei guter Zielerreichung, Provision ungedeckelt

  • Ein Produkt mit klarem Kostenvorteil gegenüber dem Status quo

  • Vertriebs- und Kommunikationstraining von Anfang an, du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Reporting-Schichten

  • Eigene Accounts und eigene Pipeline in dem Bereich, der 2026 das Wachstum trägt

  • Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg, hybrid mit mindestens 3 Tagen im Office

  • Budget für Weiterbildung und Sales-Tooling

  • Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club

  • Deutschlandticket

  • Zugang zu Corporate Benefits und Firmenrabatten



Hiring-Prozess

  1. Intro-Call mit dem Recruiting (~30 Min.) — Kurzer Abgleich zu Rolle, Timing, Erwartungen und Vergütung.

  2. Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager (~60 Min.) — Wie du an Menschen herangehst, was du bisher verkauft hast, und ein kurzer Probepitch: du pitchst mika, wir spielen den Gegenüber.

  3. Founder-Call (~30 Min.) — Weniger Skills, mehr Werte, Ziele und langfristiger Fit.



Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

title: Lead AI engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

 This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

You'll Love This Job If you have

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

title: Lead Fullstack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Über Protofy

Wir sind Protofy, die Outcome Agency aus Hamburg, und entwickeln seit über 10 Jahren digitale Produkte, Plattformen und KI-Systeme, die messbar wirken. Technologie ist für uns kein Selbstzweck, sondern ein Business Case, den wir in Umsatz, Effizienz und Wachstum übersetzen.

Deine Rolle

Als technische*r Lead führst Du engagierte Teams und sorgst dafür, dass auch komplexe Projekte pragmatisch, sorgfältig und wirtschaftlich umgesetzt werden. Wir entwickeln Websites und Mobile-Apps für Branchen wie E-Commerce, Wissensmanagement und Sport. Unsere Projekte laufen drei bis neun Monate oder werden als Produkte langfristig weiterentwickelt. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin mit und hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Architektur.

Den Entscheider*innenunserer Kund*innen begegnest Du auf Augenhöhe: Du leitest Architekturworkshops eigenständig und unterstützt uns bei Pitches. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg*innen aus Produkt Designer*innen und Product Owner*innen verantwortest Du Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Deployment von Features.

Neue Technologien erschließt Du hands-on und machst sie für das Team nutzbar. Außerdem gestaltest Du professionelle Standards in der gesamten Organisation mit, insbesondere für KI-gestützte Entwicklung. Den Großteil Deiner Zeit arbeitest Du selbst im Code, daneben übernimmst Du Führung, Kundenkontakt und Themen der Organisation.

Deine typische Woche

  • Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner*in für die Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen und berätst sie strategisch

  • Du unterstützt Pitches, erarbeitest Slides und technische Konzepte und präsentierst sie

  • Du führst Projekte technisch ganzheitlich, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment

  • Du entwirfst neue Funktionen mit Produktmanager*innen und UX-Designer*innen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit Deinem Team um

  • Du baust neue Themen und Technologien hands-on im Projekt auf, z. B. neue Shopsysteme, Frameworks oder Cloud-Provider

  • Du begleitest Dein Team, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst Deine Kolleg*innen durch Tech-Mentoring

  • Du gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse pragmatisch mit, insbesondere KI-gestützte Entwicklung (Tools, Workflows, Qualitätssicherung)

  • Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick: Du schätzt Aufwände, achtest auf Budgets und unterstützt das Projektmanagement

  • Du entwickelst die gesamte Organisation aktiv mit

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Web- oder App-Entwicklung

  • Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung als Tech Lead bzw. in der technischen Führung von Teams

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technischen Verantwortung mittelgroßer Projekte (500+ Personentage)

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Application Architecture und begleitest Teams dabei, Anwendungen auf der grünen Wiese aufzusetzen

  • Du kannst Projekte ganzheitlich technisch führen

  • Du behältst auch in intensiven Projektphasen einen klaren Kopf und gehst gelassen mit Unsicherheit um

  • Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung über Deine eigene Arbeit hinaus und lernst gern Neues

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch

Deine ersten Monate bei Protofy

In deinen ersten Wochen wirst du dich in unsere bestehenden Projekte und Architekturkonzepte einarbeiten und erste Features für unsere Kund*innen umsetzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit dem Team aus und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für die technische Ausrichtung von Web-Anwendungen. Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen auf Anhieb erfüllst, aber das nötige Fundament mitbringst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

Dich erwartet ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag bei einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 40 Stunden und einer Probezeit von 6 Monaten sowie 29 Urlaubstagen im Jahr. Wir unterstützen deine berufliche Bildung und bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit zum vollständigen Remote-Arbeiten oder im Homeoffice, wofür wir dir eine passende Home-Office-Ausstattung und einen Firmenlaptop zur Verfügung stellen. Zusätzlich profitierst du von Betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, einem Fitnessabo, einer Entschädigung für Reisekosten, Vorteilen bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, einem Sabbatical, Unterstützung der psychischen Gesundheit, Mitarbeiterrabatten sowie regelmäßigen Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Vor Ort oder remote erwarten dich zudem kostenlose Getränke, kostenlose Snacks, eine lockere Kleiderordnung und die Möglichkeit, Haustiere mitzubringen.

Vergütung

Unser Gehaltsrahmen für diese Position liegt bei EUR 77,500–90,000 per year.

title: Lead Plant Robotics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Lead Plant Robotics Engineer to develop the manufacturing solutions that allow us to mass-produce solid rocket motors. As the lead, you will own the robotic handling strategy for our pilot plant, from the first layout concept through commissioning and scale-up, and you will lead the robotics team.

This is a unique opportunity to define how rockets are built at scale. The pilot plant is the blueprint for the production lines that follow, and the robotic cells you lead will handle containers, motor casings and energetic materials every day.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the robotics architecture of the pilot plant: robot selection, cell layouts, end-effectors, and handling concepts for buckets, transport boxes, motor casings and carriers.

  • Lead the development of robotic handling solutions for dosing, mixing, casting, curing and demolding stations, including the explosion-protection concept (enclosure, pressure-resistant encapsulation or ATEX-certified equipment).

  • Define robotics requirements for the full line and manage the interfaces with automation, process engineering, ERP/MES and external integrators.

  • Lead the robotics engineering team and external suppliers, including specification, tendering, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT).

  • Drive cycle-time, throughput and availability targets using offline programming, simulation and data from the pilot line.

  • Lead the risk assessment and safety concept for robotic cells together with safety engineering (Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, ISO 13849).

What we are looking for

  • Significant professional experience (typically 3+ years) designing and commissioning industrial robotic systems, ideally in manufacturing or process environments.

  • Lead-level experience: you have led technical teams or acted as technical authority on a robotic project from concept to production.

  • Strong knowledge of industrial robot platforms (ideally ABB, Fanuc), including programming, offline programming and simulation.

  • Solid understanding of machine safety (Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, ISO 10218, ISO 13849) and of structured risk assessment.

  • A hands-on engineering mindset: you can move from a concept sketch to a CAD layout, and you can debug a cell on the shop floor.

  • The ability to work with autonomy and at pace, and to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • Robotic handling in explosion-protected or hazardous environments (Directive 2014/34/EU, TRGS 720 ff.), or with powders, pastes or chemicals.

  • Vision systems, force-torque sensing, or automated quality checks (X-ray or CT integration).

  • Multi-robot coordination, gantry systems, or AGV integration at production scale.

  • Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and PLC integration.

  • Experience building production capability from zero in a startup or scale-up environment.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

 

Compensation: €80K – €100K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.

The Work You’ll Do

Initiate and Connect

  • Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
  • Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value

  • Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
  • Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights
  • Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
  • Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
  • Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
  • Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

 Rollout, Adoption, and Handover

  • Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption
  • Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
  • Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
  • Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

  • You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
  • You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
  • You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
  • You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
  • You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.
  • Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
  • AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
  • Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
  • Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. 
  • Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
  • Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 
  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:
