title: Partner Sales Executive
descriptionHtml:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Partner Sales Executive focused onFinancial Crime Compliance (FCC), you'll navigate partner ecosystems, building strong executive relationships, trust, and new revenue streams through value-based selling. You'll grow revenue and drive adoption of the UiPath platform for FCC use cases — such as anti-money laundering, KYC, and fraud — by partnering with world-class consulting and service organizations, and build the plans that help those partners deliver maximum success for their financial services customers.

This is a unique overlay role: you'll drive partner sales for FCC across the entire company, and no two days will look the same. You'll build offerings and go-to-market strategies — and see them through to execution — with sophisticated, non-transactional partners such as global systems integrators and advisory firms.

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Analyze market potential and build strategic go-to-market plans with partners to maximize revenue

  • Hit agreed sales targets and outcomes each quarter, growing partner-sourced revenue, registered deals, and joint solutions

  • Evangelize the UiPath brand and value proposition so UiPath becomes the automation platform of choice for your partners' customers

  • Show partners how our solutions benefit their customers financially and support their strategic initiatives

  • Build trusted relationships with partner automation practices, account owners, vertical leaders, and executives

  • Work with regional sales leadership and partner leadership on a coordinated go-to-market strategy for high-value solutions

  • Coach UiPath sales reps on working with your partner, managing joint pursuits and keeping communication tight

  • Respond quickly to partner leads, agree deal-support priorities, and nurture opportunities into expansion

  • Drive ongoing partner enablement: training and certification, product updates, quotes, and new release information

  • Team up with field sales, Customer Success Managers, and pre-sales to make sure customers get maximum value and issues are resolved fast

  • Track competitors, new products, and market conditions, and report partner needs, competitive activity, and new opportunities to leadership

  • Keep the UiPath CRM accurate and up to date

What you'll bring to the team

  • 10+ years of business and sales experience, including developing sales with partners and building offerings and go-to-market strategies with sophisticated partners (consulting backgrounds welcome)

  • 2–3 years of industry experience in financial crime compliance, either at a bank or with a vendor in the FCC space (vendor experience is a strong plus)

  • The credibility to hold solid, in-depth conversations on financial crime topics with partners, customers, and compliance leaders

  • Solid knowledge of the automation and AI landscape, and the ability to explain UiPath's key differentiators and customer benefits

  • A track record of building multiple senior-level relationships across a partner ecosystem, including the leaders who shape go-to-market strategy and own key client relationships

  • Experience building account plans that meet sales and profit goals, and taking full ownership of partners across assigned verticals or geographies

  • An agile, confident problem solver who is organizationally savvy and disciplined in execution

  • A proactive self-starter with superlative collaboration and communication skills

  • The ability to handle conflict constructively and balance the interests of the partner, the customer, and UiPath to reach the best outcome

  • Experience working in a CRM (such as Salesforce)

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Payments and Reconciliations Intern (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role

We have an exciting opportunity within our Operations team for an intern who would be interested in learning our Payments and Reconciliations processes. It is a fast paced environment and you are guaranteed to learn a lot from our motivated team of experts who value innovation, excellence, and shared growth in a results-driven environment. In this role, you will support the team in ensuring seamless delivery of day-to-day BAU tasks.

What you’ll do:

  • Timely processing and reconciliation of all inbound and outbound payments and treasury processes, ensuring accuracy and efficiency

  • Monitoring customer payments and all related transactions to support smooth and reliable cash flows

  • Preparing cash & securities reconciliation reports

  • Investigating and resolving any discrepancies between internal cash records and external statements

  • Proper monitoring of the operations bank accounts ensuring that balances are supported at all times.

  • Providing support for customer queries, audit processes, and ensuring smooth communication with banking partners

What you bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field is preferred

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills; ability to identify errors

  • Fluent in English - both written and verbal. German is a strong advantage

  • Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships with both internal and external stakeholders

  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

  • Ability to handle high-pressure situations and meet deadlines

  • Experience in data analysis and process automation using data visualization tools, SQL, Python, or similar is a plus

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: People Operations & Payroll (Working Student)
descriptionHtml:
People Operations & Payroll (Working Student)

About the team

At SumUp, our People Operations & Payroll team is the engine behind a smooth and reliable employee experience. We manage the full employee lifecycle — from onboarding and contract changes through to offboarding — while supporting accurate and timely payroll across Southern Europe.

In France, recurring operational work is growing across employee lifecycle administration, field sales hiring and payroll coordination. You'll join a hands-on, detail-driven team where operational excellence and employee care go hand in hand.

The role

This is a Working Student position supporting the People Operations & Payroll team in France. You'll take ownership of recurring administrative and payroll support tasks, help keep our data accurate and up to date, and make sure employees and managers get timely, clear support.

This is a great entry point into HR and payroll operations for someone who is organised, reliable, and eager to build real expertise in a fast-moving environment.

What you'll do

Payroll support

  • Help to collect, and organise payroll input data ahead of monthly deadlines
  • Support follow-up with external payroll and benefits providers where relevant
  • Help maintain accurate payroll records and flag missing information or discrepancies

HR administration & employee lifecycle

  • Prepare, update, and archive employment contracts and employee documentation
  • Support onboarding, contract changes, and offboarding processes — ensuring data accuracy and completeness at every step
  • Assist with benefits administration where needed

Employee support & ticket handling

  • Respond to routine employee and manager queries via internal systems and email with clarity and care
  • Manage open tickets and follow up, escalating more complex cases when needed

Data management & process improvement

  • Maintain and update employee data in HR systems and Excel / Google Sheets trackers
  • Perform regular data checks and keep Notion pages and internal documentation up to date
  • Identify repetitive steps, data-quality issues, or bottlenecks in recurring workflows
  • Suggest small process improvements that make day-to-day operations more efficient

What we're looking for

  • Currently studying or recently graduated in HR, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • Fluent in French and English — clear written and verbal communication is essential
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, especially with sensitive employee and payroll data
  • Basic Excel / Google Sheets skills and confidence working with structured data
  • Organised and reliable — able to manage recurring tasks and meet regular deadlines
  • Comfortable handling confidential information with discretion and good judgement
  • Quick to learn new tools and systems — we work across multiple HR platforms
  • Team player with a hands-on, service-oriented attitude

Nice to have

  • Previous experience or studies in HR, payroll administration, or people operations
  • Interest in payroll processes, HR systems, or process improvement
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT

Why SumUp?

🌎 Work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Barcelona office.

🌈 Be part of a workplace that values diversity and inclusion, where every perspective is respected.

❤️ Access our Employee Assistance Programme for mental health guidance and support when you need it.

descriptionHtml:

Das bringst Du mit

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung im Personalbereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Erfahrung im Personalwesen mittelständischer Unternehmen
  • Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und ein sicheres Verständnis für personalwirtschaftliche Abläufe.

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein und einen vertrauensvollen Umgang mit sensiblen Personalthemen.
  • Eigeninitiative sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Einen routinierten Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen Sprache.

Was die Stelle interessant macht

Menschen über ihren beruflichen Weg begleiten:Du betreust Mitarbeitende in unterschiedlichen Phasen ihres Arbeitsverhältnisses und bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für ihre Anliegen.

Führungskräfte im Alltag unterstützen:Du bringst dein Personalwissen in konkrete Fragestellungen ein und hilfst dabei, tragfähige Lösungen zu finden.

Abläufe mitgestalten:Du kannst deine Erfahrungen und Ideen nutzen, um Personalprozesse weiterzuentwickeln und HR-Projekte voranzubringen.

Vielseitig arbeiten:Persönlicher Austausch, organisatorische Aufgaben und die Arbeit mit Personaldaten und Kennzahlen sorgen für einen abwechslungsreichen Aufgabenbereich.

Zeit für Erholung haben:Dir stehen 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr zur Verfügung.

title: Pflichtpraktikum Produktentwicklung - Food (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern verstehen, wie aus einer Idee ein Produkt wird, das Kund:innen wirklich nachkaufen?

Die MainTea GmbH ist ein Food-Startup aus Frankfurt am Main mit rund 30 Mitarbeitenden und Teil der MainTea-Gruppe. Zur Gruppe gehören mehrere Marken: Besser im Glas (D2C), PRO2BE, Bubble Pop und Bubble Chill, jeweils im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Die Produktentwicklung arbeitet für alle diese Marken, und genau dort bist du in deinem Pflichtpraktikum fest im Team: Du verkostest, recherchierst Trends, stimmst dich mit Herstellern und Lieferanten ab und begleitest neue Produkte von der ersten Idee bis ins Regal. Wenn du Food liebst und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien echte Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktentwicklung über alle Marken: Du arbeitest aktiv an Neuentwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen für Besser im Glas und PRO2BE, von Tee- und Gewürzmischungen über Protein-Produkte bis zu Getränken.

  • Verkostung & Produkttests: Du planst und organisierst strukturierte Verkostungen, wertest Geschmack, Aroma, Textur und Optik aus und lieferst Feedback, das direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einfließt.

  • Trendrecherche & Marktbeobachtung: Du behältst Food- und Getränketrends im Blick, beobachtest Wettbewerber im Onlinehandel und im Supermarkt und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Sorten und Konzepte ein.

  • Rezeptur-Support: Du hilfst bei der Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Produktentwicklungen und pflegst Rezepturen und Produktdaten.

  • Lieferanten & Muster: Du fragst Rohstoffe, Muster und Angebote bei Herstellern und Co-Packern an, vergleichst sie und behältst den Überblick über laufende Anfragen.

  • Produktdaten & Kennzeichnung: Du unterstützt beim Erstellen von Spezifikationen, Zutatenlisten und Etikettentexten und arbeitest dabei eng mit Qualitätsmanagement und Grafik zusammen.

  • Besorgungen & Testlogistik: Du besorgst Testzutaten und Vergleichsprodukte und sorgst dafür, dass bei Verkostungen alles bereitsteht.

  • Dokumentation: Du hältst Ergebnisse sauber fest und machst Fortschritte für das Team nachvollziehbar.

Dein Profil

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in und musst im Rahmen deines Studiums ein Pflichtpraktikum von mindestens 6 Monaten absolvieren.

  • Idealerweise studierst du Ökotrophologie, Ernährungswissenschaften, Ernährungsökonomie, Food Management oder etwas Vergleichbares.

  • Du brennst für Food, neue Produkte und Trends und probierst gern Neues aus.

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Geschmack und ein Auge fürs Detail.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und packst gern selbst mit an.

  • Du bist kommunikativ und trittst gegenüber externen Partnern professionell auf.

  • Du sprichst gut Deutsch und Englisch (unsere Partner sitzen teils im Ausland).

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit MS Office, vor allem Excel.

  • Führerschein Klasse B.

title: Photonics Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

This role will focus on the design, optimisation, and development of high performance photonic components for next generation Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), contributing directly to our future tape-outs and core IP roadmap.

You will work closely with photonics designers, layout engineers, and testing teams to improve the performance of integrated photonic devices through theoretical analysis, simulation, modelling, and design innovation.

This is a highly technical role suited to someone who enjoys solving difficult physics and engineering problems in a collaborative deep-tech environment. You will contribute to the development of key building blocks within our optical switching and photonic systems roadmap, and other integrated photonic components critical to future high port count architectures.

Depending on experience, we are open to candidates at Senior, Lead, or Principal level.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and optimise integrated photonic components for silicon photonics and related PIC platforms

  • Perform electromagnetic simulations, modelling, and theoretical analysis to improve device performance

  • Validate simulation results against experimental measurement data

  • Develop innovative component designs informed by current research and emerging techniques

  • Collaborate with layout engineers to integrate components into PDK libraries and tape-out flows

  • Work closely with fabrication and testing teams to iterate on device performance

  • Contribute to the development roadmap for future photonic components and architectures

  • Support long term improvements in PIC loss, manufacturability, and scalability

  • Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and cross functional problem solving

  • Stay current with advances in integrated photonics through research literature and conferences

What we're looking for

  • PhD, or equivalent industry experience, in Photonics, Physics, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field

  • Strong theoretical understanding of guided optics and photonic device physics

  • Hands-on experience designing and simulating integrated photonic components

  • Experience working with silicon photonics or InP photonic platforms

  • Strong analytical and mathematical problem solving capability

  • A track record of meaningful technical contributions, whether through publications, patents, or shipped technology

  • Experience using photonic simulation tools and modelling workflows

  • Python programming experience for simulation, analysis, or automation

  • Deep understanding of Photonic IC design and fabrication flows

  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes

  • Experience working in commercial R&D or product development environments

  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams

You will join a highly ambitious deep-tech company operating at the intersection of AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and photonics. We are building foundational technology with the potential to reshape the performance envelope of future AI systems.

Alongside a collaborative and research-driven environment, you will have the opportunity to work on genuinely difficult engineering problems with direct impact on product direction and company growth.

If you're excited by integrated photonics, advanced device design, and solving hard engineering problems at the frontier of AI infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy
descriptionHtml:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About the role
(Hybrid)

As our Principal Engineer for Identity & Privacy, you’ll shape the technical foundations that help us earn traveller trust while safely unlocking the data and AI capabilities behind brilliant product, personalisation, experimentation and advertising experiences.

This is a senior technical leadership role with impact right across Skyscanner. You’ll own the technical strategy and set standards for identity, consent and privacy engineering across our traveller-facing products, data platforms and operational systems — spanning web, app, backend, experimentation, analytics, advertising and machine learning.

What you’ll be doing

  • Setting our technical strategy: You’ll define and communicate the long-term vision and roadmap for identity, consent and privacy engineering, aligning it with our product strategy, traveller trust goals and data and AI ambitions.

  • Shaping identity at scale: You’ll lead our technical approach to purpose-scoped identifiers and consent-aware data processing across sessions, tracking, advertising, accounts, consent and derived identifiers.

  • Connecting the dots end-to-end: You’ll establish how identity and consent state flows from web and app surfaces through backend services, event streams and data pipelines to downstream consumers — making a complicated ecosystem feel a lot less complicated.

  • Turning privacy into engineering practice: You’ll translate privacy principles and legal guidance into reusable engineering patterns, platform controls, decision frameworks and measurable standards, including clear expectations around retention, deletion, masking, access control and auditability.

  • Leading across Skyscanner: You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Governance, Data Science, Marketing, Ads and Analytics to navigate trade-offs, create clarity and turn ambiguous problems into decisions teams can deliver against.

  • Getting hands-on with the big stuff: You’ll provide technical leadership for large-scale initiatives spanning consent platform capabilities, privacy-safe experimentation, data retention and deletion, and traveller-trust features, while guiding teams towards simple, scalable, reliable and cost-effective solutions.

  • Raising the engineering bar: You’ll use observability, engineering health and incident learnings to improve how we operate, while coaching and mentoring engineers and championing high standards, constructive challenge and inclusive collaboration across our Engineering community.

About you

  • Privacy-engineering experienced: You’ve translated privacy and data-protection requirements — including GDPR, PECR, CCPA/CPRA or equivalent global frameworks — into practical engineering decisions, working effectively with Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance partners.

  • Built for scale: You’ve designed, built and operated large-scale distributed systems across identity, data platforms or adjacent areas such as consent, authentication, advertising technology or customer data infrastructure.

  • An influential technical leader: You’ve led significant technical change across multiple teams without direct line authority, creating clarity, alignment and momentum when ownership is distributed.

  • Strong in technical judgement: You’re comfortable making decisions where product value, traveller trust, privacy requirements, operational reliability and cost are all competing for a seat at the table.

  • End-to-end minded: You can reason confidently across client surfaces, backend services, event streams, data products, ML features, analytics, partner exports and operational tooling — and understand how a decision in one part of the system can ripple through the rest.

  • Practical about standards: You know how to turn policy into technical controls and measurable quality standards that teams can consistently use in real systems, rather than another document destined for a forgotten browser tab.

  • Clear, collaborative and credible: You can create shared engineering practices, write clear technical strategy and work effectively with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Legal, Security and Data Governance. Familiarity with privacy and consent technologies, experimentation, personalisation, advertising measurement, Databricks, OpenTelemetry or SQL is valuable but not essential — as is practical experience using AI tools to make engineering work smarter.

What it's like here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

title: Principal Engineer - Platform
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We want our engineers to ship regulated medical software as fast as AI now lets them write it. Our software includes medical device software, holds members’ health data and keeps our clinics running, so every change has to be tested, traceable and ready for an auditor, and that is what makes this problem hard and worth solving.

 

You’ll build the shared AI engineering platform that makes it possible, setting the architecture and writing much of it yourself: a golden path that makes the best way to build with AI the default for every team, agents that do real engineering work end to end, and a pipeline that proves compliance on every change instead of documents written after the fact. This is a director-level individual contributor role, one of the first Principal Engineer roles in our software organisation, working directly with our Chief Software Officer. You make the key calls on which agents and tools we build or adopt, and you take on the hardest problems across teams, some of which reach clinic devices and the test rigs that recreate a scan room.

 

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • 0→1 set the target architecture for the AI engineering platform, including the build or adopt decisions on agents, orchestration and developer tooling

  • Ship a golden path for AI-assisted engineering, with shared context, tools and guardrails, that teams choose because it is the fastest way to ship

  • Put agents to work on real engineering jobs end to end, such as feature implementation, code migrations, automated review and on-call triage

  • Run agents in sandboxed environments with audit trails and clear separation from member health data

  • Shorten the path from merged code to production for regulated software: safe releases, fast rollback, and compliance evidence produced by the pipeline

  • Measure what changes with numbers engineers trust, such as the share of agent pull requests that get merged and how long a change takes to reach production, and share them openly

  • Take on the hardest cross-team technical problems, inside and beyond the platform, where no one has the answer yet

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • You have designed and built platforms or core infrastructure that other engineers relied on every day, and you wrote a meaningful part of the code yourself

  • Deep backend and distributed systems experience in production, with the judgement to make architecture calls in a large, existing codebase

  • Your own engineering is AI-first: you use agents for work you used to do by hand, and can explain where they help, where they fail, and what changed in speed and quality

  • You take a clear position on hard technical questions with incomplete information, defend it with reasons, and change it when the evidence changes

  • Engineers outside your own team changed how they work because of something you built and the technical case you made for it

  • Able to work from our London, New York or Stockholm office

     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with durable workflow orchestration, for example Temporal or Azure Durable Functions, and a clear view on when it is worth it, since long-running agent work has to survive failure

  • Work where software meets hardware or physical operations, such as connected devices, edge computing or hardware-in-the-loop testing

🎯 The Role — Principal Information Security & Data Protection Officer

Working closely with Commercial, Engineering, Product and Legal to lead Unmind's Information Security and Data Protection programmes and act as Unmind's designated Data Protection Officer (DPO). We process health information at scale, so trust is central to what we offer. We're looking for a hands-on, senior individual contributor who can own both disciplines end to end and give the business clear, practical advice.

This role sets security and privacy requirements, advises and assures.

Overall responsibility for;

Information Security

  • the management of Information Security within the business;

  • maintaining ISO 27001:2022 and Cyber Essentials certification, chairing the ISMS Board and running the ISMS day to day – policies, risk management, controls, evidence and internal audits;

  • liaising with Engineering, Product and Data & AI on information security threats and vulnerabilities and recommending mitigations;

  • Information Security incident management and remediation;

  • managing the Application and Infrastructure penetration testing and vulnerability management process, tracking findings to closure;

  • leading AI governance operations, including the AI policy and register, AI use-case risk reviews and readiness for ISO 42001;

  • managing the Information Security pre-sales, RFP and contractual process, and keeping trust materials in Conveyor current;

  • managing the business's security education and awareness training programme;

  • reporting information security compliance and risk to ELT and the Board.

Data Protection Officer

  • performing the statutory duties of the DPO under UK and EU GDPR, including acting as the contact point for the ICO and other data protection authorities;

  • maintaining Unmind's privacy framework, including privacy notices and retention;

  • advising on privacy for new products, suppliers and AI use cases, including coordinating DPIAs;

  • managing data subject rights requests and personal data breach assessments;

  • leading privacy review of DPAs and client assurance with Legal and Commercial, and reporting data protection risk to ELT and the Board.

🌟 About You

We know great people come from all sorts of backgrounds, and we want to make sure we’re focusing on what really matters. We welcome applications from people with different experiences and perspectives, while recognising that certain qualifications are essential for this role. You’ll find these outlined below.

ESSENTIAL:

  • Experience of implementing and maintaining ISO 27001 certification within a global technology business;

  • Expert practical knowledge of UK and EU GDPR, including DPIAs, rights requests, personal data breaches, and international transfers;

  • Experience acting as, or working closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer;

  • Confident client-facing presence, able to explain Unmind's data security and privacy approach clearly to prospective and existing clients;

  • Experience advising engineering and product teams on mitigation solutions for application and infrastructure security risks;

  • Sound understanding of AI-related security and privacy risks;

  • Ability to give clear, independent advice and challenge to senior leaders;

  • Commitment and attention to detail;

  • Able to manage multiple competing requests across the business, prioritising by risk and deadline;

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;

title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts.  Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.

The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, evaluation and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain. EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, trials and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging capabilities and internally developed solutions into deployable systems. The lab operates across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, supportable and resilient. 

Position Summary

We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities. 

The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis. 

The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support. 

This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials. 

The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln. 

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop and integrate RF systems for expeditionary Unmanned Systems control, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum-monitoring and secure communications capabilities
  • Develop RF system architectures covering antennas, receivers, transmitters, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, switching and signal distribution
  • Conduct RF performance analysis, including gain, noise figure, sensitivity, dynamic range, linearity, link budgets and interference assessments
  • Support rapid R&D, prototyping and technology evaluation, translating operational requirements into practical and deployable RF solutions
  • Integrate commercial, government and internally developed RF equipment across airborne, vehicle-mounted, maritime, fixed-site and unmanned platforms
  • Plan and conduct RF testing, characterisation, fault diagnosis, verification and corrective engineering activity
  • Ensure RF designs consider electromagnetic compatibility, spectrum management, grounding, bonding, shielding, environmental protection and relevant standards
  • Work closely with electrical, mechanical, software, cyber, systems and operational teammates throughout the engineering lifecycle
  • Support UK and international trials, demonstrations, installations, commissioning and operational deployments
  • Provide RF technical leadership, design assurance and clear engineering recommendations to customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

What You Bring

  • Degree in RF Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering or a closely related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
  • Minimum of seven years’ experience in RF systems design, development, integration, testing or delivery
  • Experience working with complex RF systems within defence, aerospace, telecommunications, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, secure communications or a related sector
  • Experience with Software Defined Radios, digital RF architectures and the collection or analysis of IQ data
  • Experience designing, integrating or supporting RF systems for unmanned systems, including uncrewed aerial, ground or maritime platforms
  • Strong understanding of RF receiver and transmitter architectures, including amplifiers, filters, mixers, oscillators, switches and frequency-conversion stages 
  • Experience conducting cascade analysis, link-budget calculations and assessments of gain, noise figure, sensitivity, linearity and dynamic range
  • Practical experience with antenna systems, RF distribution, transmission lines, impedance matching, grounding, bonding and shielding
  • Strong RF test, measurement and fault-finding skills using equipment such as spectrum analysers, vector network analysers, signal generators, oscilloscopes and power meters
  • Experience using RF simulation, modelling, schematic-capture or system-analysis tools
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams spanning electrical, mechanical, software, cyber, systems and operational disciplines
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation, communicate engineering recommendations and travel regularly within the UK and internationally

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • Experience designing expeditionary, deployable, ruggedised or rapidly reconfigurable RF capabilities
  • Experience integrating RF systems onto airborne, vehicle-mounted, maritime, fixed-site or dismounted platforms
  • Understanding of antenna selection, placement, radiation patterns, platform effects and co-site interference
  • Experience with wideband receivers, transmit chains, power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, filters and RF switching networks
  • Experience conducting electromagnetic compatibility, electromagnetic environmental effects and radio-frequency interference assessments
  • Familiarity with relevant defence, aviation, maritime, spectrum-management or RF engineering standards
  • Experience supporting prototype builds, field trials, exercises, customer demonstrations or operational deployments
  • Knowledge of systems engineering, size, weight, power and cooling analysis, low-volume manufacturing, component obsolescence and through-life support

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance   
  • Subsidised gym membership / plans through Wellhub   
  • Electric car scheme   
  • Cycle to work scheme   
  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme   
  • Free lunch on office days  
  • Enhanced parental leave  
  • 30 days annual PTO plus bank holidays  

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

The successful candidate must have the right to work in the United Kingdom. 

The role will require the individual to hold, or be capable of obtaining and maintaining, an appropriate UK national-security clearance. Certain projects may impose additional nationality or security restrictions. 

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea Mission Data Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.  

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. This position is offered on a hybrid working basis with three days per week in the office as standard, based out of London or Lincoln.

Work Environment

The role will involve work across: 

  • Office and engineering-design environments 
  • Laboratories and workshops
  • Customer and supplier facilities
  • Vehicle, aircraft and maritime-platform integration environments
  • Outdoor test, trial and exercise locations
  • Operationally representative and potentially austere environments  

Appropriate training, procedures and personal protective equipment will be provided where required. 

The role is not exclusively desk-based. It may involve: 

  • Standing, walking, bending, kneeling and working in restricted equipment spaces
  • Handling tools, cables, connectors and test equipment
  • Installing or removing electrical and electronic equipment
  • Lifting and carrying equipment within appropriate manual-handling limits
  • Working around vehicles, aircraft, generators and other powered systems
  • Periods of outdoor work in varying environmental conditions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with additional needs to perform the essential functions.

Travel

15%

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

Description

QuantumDiamonds (QD) is entering its next phase: with the start of production, we are evolving from a startup into an industrial company. This transition requires an operational foundation built on clean, lean and scalable processes. Join the CEO Office and play a key role in establishing this foundation. As a Process Optimization Intern, you will map our processes in Odoo, from purchase request to bookkeeping, streamline workflows that have grown organically, and automate manual steps. You will work closely with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, and your work will have a direct and visible impact on our daily operations.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Map our end-to-end processes in Odoo, from purchase requests and purchasing to goods receipt, inventory, manufacturing and accounting

  • Analyze existing workflows with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, identify bottlenecks and fix them yourself instead of just reporting them

  • Configure and extend Odoo modules, master data and approval flows, and help decide how the ERP grows with QD

  • Take projects live that make a visible difference in daily work, for example barcode scanning in goods receipt and warehouse

  • Automate repetitive manual steps with n8n and connect Odoo to the rest of our tooling stack

  • Build AI agents with Claude that read documents, check data and prepare transactions

  • Document processes and train colleagues so new workflows are adopted and stick

  • Keep data quality high and help set up reporting that gives management a clear view of operations

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field

  • You have experience with an ERP system, ideally Odoo

  • You understand processes in purchasing, warehousing, manufacturing, or accounting

  • You have experience with automation tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier

  • Experience with LLM-based workflows or agents, scripting in Python or JavaScript, or knowledge of SQL and data modeling is a plus

  • Experience in a fast-growing hardware or manufacturing company is a plus

  • You have a hands-on mentality: you implement things yourself instead of passing on requirements

  • You are available for a full-time internship of 4 to 6 months and can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Procurement & Supply Chain Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy & SourceLight

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. As a spin-out of Focused Energy, SourceLight is turning breakthrough laser-driven radiation source technology into practical solutions for some of the world's most demanding inspection and material characterization challenges.

We are building on cutting-edge scientific innovation to develop scalable technology for industrial applications, including nuclear waste characterization, security screening, and non-destructive testing of safety-critical components.

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success.

Your Role

We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of procurement and supplier strategy across the company, shaping how we identify, qualify, engage, and manage suppliers while ensuring our engineering teams have the components and resources they need to deliver.

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function.

If you enjoy building structure in a fast-moving technical environment, navigating complex supplier relationships, and creating the operational foundations that enable innovative technology to reach the market, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead the Procurement & Supply Chain function: Establish the strategy, processes, tools, and operating standards required to support procurement across all SourceLight product and engineering teams.

  • Develop a strategic supplier ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage suppliers across specialized technical categories, particularly high-value optical, laser, mechanical, electrical, and other advanced hardware components.

  • Own sourcing and commercial negotiations: Lead supplier selection, RFQs, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, lead-time agreements, and framework contracts to secure favorable terms while balancing cost, quality, technical requirements, and delivery timelines.

  • Manage complex technical agreements: Lead commercial negotiations for strategic supplier agreements and Joint Development Agreements (JDAs), partnering with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership to ensure appropriate commercial, operational, and contractual outcomes.

  • Enable engineering and product teams: Take ownership of procurement activities from request through purchase order and supplier follow-up, allowing technical teams to focus on engineering, integration, testing, and product development.

  • Establish scalable procurement processes: Implement standardized purchasing workflows, supplier documentation, approval processes, contract management practices, and procurement systems that support transparency, efficiency, and accountability.

  • Drive supply chain planning and risk management: Monitor supplier capacity, component availability, lead times, delivery performance, and potential supply disruptions. Develop mitigation strategies for critical components and proactively communicate risks to stakeholders.

  • Partner with Finance and Legal: Coordinate purchase order approvals, budget alignment, payment processes, contract reviews, and compliance requirements while maintaining clear decision-making and escalation pathways.

  • Ensure quality and compliance: Establish supplier qualification and performance standards that account for technical specifications, quality requirements, cleanroom and safety considerations, and applicable regulatory or industry requirements.

  • Build visibility and accountability: Develop reporting on procurement status, supplier performance, purchasing cycle times, cost savings, delivery risks, and sourcing priorities to support informed operational decisions.

  • Scale the function over time: Identify future capability and resourcing needs, contribute to hiring plans, and establish the processes and knowledge base required to develop and lead a growing Procurement & Supply Chain team.

Who You Are

  • You bring significant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management, or technical purchasing, ideally within a complex engineering, hardware, deep-tech, industrial technology, or advanced manufacturing environment.

  • You have experience building or significantly improving procurement processes and supplier management practices, ideally within a growing organization where structure and systems are still evolving.

  • You are comfortable managing technically complex sourcing activities, working with engineers to understand requirements, and translating technical needs into effective commercial and supplier strategies.

  • You have a strong track record of negotiating supplier agreements, pricing, delivery terms, and commercial contracts, with the confidence to manage high-value and strategically important supplier relationships.

  • You understand the importance of balancing cost, quality, lead time, technical risk, and long-term supplier reliability when making sourcing decisions.

  • You have experience developing supplier qualification frameworks, evaluating supplier performance, and proactively managing supply chain risks and constraints.

  • You are highly organized and process-oriented, with the ability to establish practical, scalable workflows without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • You operate with a high degree of ownership and independence, bringing structure to ambiguous situations and making sound decisions while knowing when to involve stakeholders or escalate.

  • You are a strong cross-functional partner who communicates proactively, builds trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and can influence decisions without relying on formal authority.

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

title: Procurement & Supply Chain Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Hyperscale Power

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. As we scale from Alpha customer readiness toward Production and Volume Readiness, securing the right components at the right price and lead time – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs and mechanical parts – becomes mission-critical.

The role

As Procurement & Supply Chain Lead, you will own the purchasing and supply chain for the materials, equipment, parts and services that keep our prototype, pilot and volume production on track – from negotiating with suppliers to coordinating with contract manufacturers and logistics partners. You will partner closely with Engineering to translate technical requirements into sourcing decisions, and help build our purchasing processes as we scale.

This role is for you if you’ve negotiated with component suppliers yourself, like being hands-on, and enjoy building processes rather than following them – ideally with experience buying electronic components for B2B hardware such as power electronics, industrial equipment or automation systems. It isn’t for you if you prefer managing a team, require an established ERP and approval chain to work well, or a clearly defined, stable scope. It would not be a fit if your procurement background is mainly consumer goods, retail or indirect spend without hands-on exposure to electronic components.

What you will do

  • Contract and purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, services and supplies needed for prototype, pilot and volume production.

  • Negotiate pricing, terms and delivery schedules with suppliers for critical components – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs, and mechanical/enclosure parts.

  • Issue and manage purchase orders; track order status and expedite as needed to meet production schedules.

  • Source and coordinate with suppliers and contract manufacturers (EMS, PCB vendors, logistics partners) on order status, lead times and quality issues.

  • Work closely with Engineering to understand technical requirements, communicate them clearly to suppliers, and identify alternate sourcing options for critical or long-lead-time components.

  • Support supplier qualification and specification compliance for new and existing vendors.

  • Maintain purchasing records, the Bill of Materials (BOM) and sourcing data; track lead times, inventory levels and supplier performance, and flag supply chain risks.

  • Drive logistics and inbound/outbound shipments together with our logistics partners.

  • Scale the supplier base and purchasing processes as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness.

What you bring

  • BSc in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or comparable education, or equivalent experience.

  • Several years of hands-on experience in procurement, purchasing or supply chain, specifically in electronics or hardware manufacturing.

  • Strong negotiation skills; track record of managing supplier contracts and pricing.

  • Specific experience sourcing electronic or mechanical components (semiconductors, PCBs, magnetics, enclosures); experience with contract manufacturers (EMS) is a plus.

  • Organised and detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple supplier relationships.

  • Team player, comfortable working cross-functionally with Engineering and Operations in a fast-paced start-up environment with evolving priorities.

  • Fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

What we offer

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Product Manager - Agent Experience (Fluency in French & English required)
descriptionHtml:
Product Manager - Agent Experience 

Location: Paris, France preferred, open to London applicants (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Team: Customer care
Salary: €46,000 – €55,000 / £47,000 – £59,000
Language: Fluency in French & English
Contract: Permanent 
Reporting To: Lead Product Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.

  • Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.

  • Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.

  • Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements.

  • Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds

  • Hands-on Delivery & Enablement: Maintain active involvement across the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC)—from agent discovery sessions to feedback loops—and produce materials to support successful client adoption.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Contact Centre & UX Expertise: Deep experience owning end-to-end user journeys for high-frequency operational tools (e.g., agent desktops), with hands-on craft in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing with agents and supervisors.

  • EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems.

  • Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management.

  • Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code.

  • Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop environments.

  • Prior experience within SaaS platforms, the energy sector, or large-scale utility migrations.

  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.

  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
    Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

We want the best people
We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Product Manager* – Artificial Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Product Manager* – Artificial Intelligence

Location: Frankfurt am Main, Düsseldorf, Berlin, München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Gestalte die Zukunft von Artificial Intelligence – von innovativen Produktideen bis zu skalierbaren Lösungen mit echtem Business Impact.

Die Rolle

AlsProduct Manager* – Artificial Intelligence bei Capco gestaltest du die Entwicklung und erfolgreiche Vermarktung innovativer AI-Produkte, Lösungen und Acceleratoren.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Innovation. Dabei vernetzt du unterschiedliche Stakeholder, entwickelst unser AI-Produktportfolio strategisch weiter und übersetzt technologische Möglichkeiten in messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kunden.

Du begleitest AI-Produkte von der ersten Idee über die Entwicklung bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung. Dabei setzt du auf AI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen, intelligente Automatisierung und den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz von AI-Technologien, um Produktentscheidungen zu verbessern, Entwicklungsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten und Innovationen schneller nutzbar zu machen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • AI Product Portfolio Management: Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung eines Portfolios aus AI-Lösungen, Demonstratoren und Acceleratoren und identifizierst Potenziale für Skalierung und kommerzielle Nutzung.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du koordinierst Product Owner, Business-Stakeholder und Engineering-Teams über verschiedene Geschäftsbereiche und internationale Standorte hinweg und sorgst für gemeinsame Prioritäten.
  • Product Development & AI-Enabled Delivery: Du übersetzt Geschäftsanforderungen und Marktpotenziale in Produktstrategien, priorisierte Backlogs und Roadmaps. Dabei nutzt du geeignete AI-Tools und automatisierte Workflows, um Analysen, Produktentwicklung und Entscheidungsprozesse zu unterstützen.
  • Go-to-Market & Commercialisation: Du entwickelst überzeugende Value Propositions, unterstützt die Produktpositionierung und Sales-Enablement-Aktivitäten und arbeitest eng mit Business- und Account-Teams zusammen, um AI-Lösungen erfolgreich am Markt zu etablieren.
  • AI Innovation & Strategic Alignment: Du identifizierst neue AI-Anwendungsfelder, einschließlich Generative AI und Agentic AI, und stellst die Abstimmung mit Unternehmensstrategien und globalen Initiativen sicher. Dabei berücksichtigst du Responsible-AI-Prinzipien, Governance-Vorgaben und menschliche Qualitätskontrollen.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, in der Technologieberatung oder im Innovationsmanagement mit und kannst komplexe Themen in strukturierte Produktstrategien übersetzen.
  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis moderner AI-Technologien, einschließlich Generative AI, Large Language Models und Agentic AI, sowie ihrer geschäftlichen Einsatzmöglichkeiten.
  • Du verstehst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und kannst technologische Fähigkeiten in überzeugende Value Propositions, Business Cases und konkrete Produktanforderungen übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen und kannst interdisziplinäre Teams koordinieren sowie unterschiedliche Interessen miteinander verbinden.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert. Du bist offen für den Einsatz freigegebener AI-Tools, hinterfragst AI-generierte Ergebnisse kritisch und berücksichtigst Datenschutz, Governance und menschliche Entscheidungsverantwortung.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche oder in einem Beratungsunternehmen.
  • Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung, Skalierung oder Vermarktung digitaler Produkte und AI-basierter Lösungen.
  • Kenntnisse im Aufbau von AI-Produktportfolios, Acceleratoren oder wiederverwendbaren Technologiekomponenten.
  • Erfahrung mit AI-Governance, Responsible AI oder der Integration von AI-Lösungen in bestehende Unternehmensprozesse.
  • Erfahrung mit internationalen, funktionsübergreifenden Teams sowie agilen Produktentwicklungsprozessen.

Warum Capco

  • Gestalte innovative AI-Produkte und Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert für führende Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen.
  • Arbeite in einer kollaborativen, offenen und unternehmerisch geprägten Beratungskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Profitiere von kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung, Trainings und branchenspezifischen Zertifizierungen.
  • Werde Teil internationaler Teams und arbeite mit AI-Expertinnen und -Experten an zukunftsweisenden Technologien.
  • Übernimm Verantwortung für eigene Initiativen und gestalte die digitale Transformation der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche aktiv mit.

Benefits

Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Benefits-Paket, das deine persönliche Entwicklung, dein Wohlbefinden und deine individuellen Bedürfnisse unterstützt:

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitsmodelle sind abhängig vom jeweiligen Projekteinsatz möglich.
  • Persönliche Begleitung: Ein umfassendes Onboarding sowie ein persönlicher Coach und Buddy unterstützen dich beim Einstieg.
  • Mobilität: Profitiere von unseren Bike-Leasing-Programmen.
  • Capco Benefits Card: Monatliche Gutschrift in Höhe von 44 EUR.
  • Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks und Mental-Health-Kurse.
  • Familienservice: Der PME-Familienservice bietet Unterstützung in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen.
  • Learning & Development: Kontinuierliches Feedback, interne Trainings und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, beispielsweise über Udemy Business.
  • Community & Networking: Regelmäßige Firmenevents und After-Work-Veranstaltungen.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Arbeitskultur: Eigenverantwortung, flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungswege.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Ein dynamisches, wachsendes Unternehmen mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten, eigene Ideen und Talente einzubringen.

Inklusion bei Capco

Wir möchten unseren Bewerbungsprozess für alle Menschen zugänglich und unkompliziert gestalten. Solltest du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung oder individuelle Anpassungen benötigen, sprich uns gerne an – wir helfen dir weiter.

Bei Capco schätzen wir unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und individuelle Stärken. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Vielfalt und authentische Zusammenarbeit entscheidend zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg beitragen.

Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Individualität, gegenseitigen Respekt und Zusammenarbeit. Diese Werte prägen unseren täglichen Umgang miteinander sowie unsere Partnerschaften mit unseren Kunden.

*Wichtig ist nur, dass wir zueinander passen (m/w/d) #beyourselfatwork.
