title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Upsun

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.

  • Customer and data authority: Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.

  • Influence across teams: Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.

  • Go-to-market: Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.

What you bring

  • Product management experience: Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Technical depth: Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

  • AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

  • Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

  • Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

Bonus points for

  • Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.

  • Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Germany, Canada, Spain, France, and the UK. We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.

You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, Product)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (IC's)
  4. 60 Minutes with Product Leaders
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CTO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

🛜 Internet reimbursement

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

title: Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Product Manager – Operations Systems (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations.

Every item rebuy sells has been through our hands. Before a pre-owned book, DVD, or game reaches a customer, it has been bought in, received, identified, tested, graded, stored, picked, packed, and shipped. The systems that run this flow are the focus of this team, and the users are the hundreds of colleagues in our operations teams.


You will own the tools and services behind inbound processing, grading and quality control, fulfillment, and returns. Your users are warehouse operators, graders, pickers, and operations leads. Your customers are, in the end, every rebuy buyer and seller who relies on the condition and delivery promise we make.

For this role we need someone who is genuinely detail-oriented, who reads the data before forming an opinion, who understands systems and data flows end-to-end, and who can translate operational reality into precise requirements and measurable outcomes.

As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. Improvements are co-created with the people who run the operation, not handed to them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive domain product roadmap: Translate ops strategy (throughput, unit cost, quality, lead time) into a 6–12 month roadmap with the Strategy Manager and Ops Product Lead. Make and document trade-off decisions with ops leaders

  • Understand operational reality: Spend time at the warehouse mapping processes and data flows end-to-end to uncover system gaps and unmet needs early

  • Drive data-backed decisions: Analyze KPIs, pull data, avoid measurement traps, and connect feature changes to unit economics improvements

  • Write precise requirements: Specify business rules, edge cases, data models, state transitions, integrations, and failure modes for engineering

  • Ship iteratively without disruption: Sequence releases safely using pilots, feature flags, parallel runs, change management, and pre-defined metrics

  • Collaborate across teams: Engage in technical discussions and manage scope, time, and urgency trade-offs with tech and ops leads

  • Build stakeholder buy-in: Align ops, CS, tech, finance, and leadership on shared metrics via clear written communication


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on backend, internal, workflow, or operational products (for example warehouse, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, order management, inventory, marketplace operations, fintech back-office, or similar)

  • Hands-on data skills: you can work fluently in an analytics environment, build your own analyses, define metrics rigorously, and spot when a number is misleading

  • Strong attention to detail: experience writing precise specifications covering business rules, edge cases, data models, and failure modes, and catching problems before they reach production

  • Systems thinking: you can map a multi-step operational process and the data flowing through it, identify bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and reason about second-order effects of a change

  • Experience collaborating with engineering on technical decisions, including integrations and data migrations, and negotiating scope and time-to-market trade-offs

  • Clear, structured communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to build buy-in with operations team leads, engineering, and product leadership

  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate daily work such as analysis, writing, and prototyping

  • Fluency in English and German

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to have regular presence at our operations sites located in Rudow)

Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

  • Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events.

  • Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo.

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.


About this role:
Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements
  • Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.
  • Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.
  • Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.
  • Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.
  • Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

    • Bring the outside in

    • Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations.
    • Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.
    • Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands.

      • Decide and prioritize

      • Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan.
      • Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone.
      • Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.
      • Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

        • Communicate

        • Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.
        • Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.
        • Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

Must Haves:
  • 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management.
  • Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense.
  • Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology
  • Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.
  • Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features.
  • Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.
  • High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan.
  • At ease being challenged, and challenging others, in a fast-moving and demanding environment.
  • Working knowledge of both hardware and software development lifecycles.
  • Proficient using and configuring Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence).
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel to other Loft offices and to customers.

Nice to Haves:
  • Fluency in French.
  • Experience with AI/ML products, edge computing, or developer and partner platforms and ecosystems.
  • Experience with satellite operations, constellation services, or ground segment products.
  • Exposure to institutional and defense customers and their procurement cycles.
  • Experience in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial NewSpace company or venture-backed deep-tech startup.
  • Professional experience working with international teams across time zones.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Location: London (Next to East Croydon Station)

Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days from home

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will be the product owner for one of our product teams. You own that team’s backlog, the discovery work behind it, the acceptance of what the team builds, and the conversations with the customers it is built for. You report to the CTO, and our product manager, who owns product strategy and the roadmap across the teams, supervises your work day to day.

This is a product role first and a coding role second. You also generate code with AI tools, mostly on the front end, at roughly the level of a junior to mid-level engineer. We expect you to build working prototypes and small features that an engineer then takes over. We do not expect back-end work, architecture or being on call.

Our teams are formed from the people we have at the time, so you are not being hired into a named team. You will work with the engineers in your team, the product manager, the CTO and our customer-facing colleagues.

In your first year, you will get a team running on your backlog without the CTO or the product manager stepping in, and you will have personally shipped front-end changes and prototypes that engineers took forward.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own your team’s backlog: decide what goes in, what stays out and what comes next, and keep it in order.

  • Run discovery with customers, so that what the team builds is something customers need and will use.

  • Turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices of work with precise acceptance criteria that an engineer can build and a customer can recognise.

  • Accept the team’s work against the acceptance criteria.

  • Say no, or reshape the request, when a customer asks for something that does not fit, and agree a next step with them.

  • Build prototypes and small front-end features with AI tools, check what the tools produce, and hand the work to an engineer to take forward.

  • Work with the product manager so that your backlog fits the roadmap, and tell them early when it does not.

Who we’re looking for

  • You have owned a team’s backlog. You decided what was built next and what was not, you accepted the work, and you can say what you decided and why.

  • You have told a customer no, or changed what they asked for. You can say what they wanted, what you said and what happened next.

  • You find out what customers need before building. You can show us a time you did discovery and what it changed.

  • You turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices with precise acceptance criteria. You can show us a time you did it, how you knew you had it right, and what you got wrong.

  • You build working front-end prototypes or small features with AI tools, in the last 12 months, and an engineer took them forward. You can say what you built and what the engineer changed.

  • You check what AI tools produce. You can describe a time the output was wrong and how you caught it.

  • You work well with engineers: you hand work over clearly and accept the finished work against what you agreed.

Knowledge of parking or of any one industry is welcome, but none of it is required.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working, 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.

  • Real ownership of a team’s backlog and its customer conversations, with a product manager alongside you.

  • A small team and real influence over what we build.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Hello!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

Not sure which Support role is right for you?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

  • Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

  • Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

  • Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

  • Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

  • Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

  • Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

You should apply if:

  • You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

  • You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

  • You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

  • You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

  • You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

You should not apply if:

  • You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

  • Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting.

  • You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself.

  • You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes.

  • You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions.

  • You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works.

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Meet the team — 30 min

    • Technical & integration skills — 45 min

    • CS and Support leadership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Onboarding

Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: Project Controller (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Project Controller (m/w/d)

Einsatzort: Linden (Hessen) oder Berlin

Arbeitszeit: 40 hours/week

Bitte beachten Sie: Diese Rolle ist ausschließlich vor Ort in Linden auszuüben

Über uns

ITM Power ist ein führendes Unternehmen in der Branche für grünen Wasserstoff und entwickelt und fertigt hochmoderne PEM-Elektrolyseure, die eine Schlüsselrolle bei der weltweiten Dekarbonisierung spielen. Mit über zwei Jahrzehnten wissenschaftlicher Expertise haben wir uns als Branchenführer im Bereich der sauberen Energietechnologie etabliert.

Unsere Standorte in Deutschland dienen als zentrale Drehscheibe innerhalb der EU und beherbergen Teams aus den Bereichen Geschäftsentwicklung, Engineering, Beschaffung und Kundendienst, um unseren Kunden schnelle und effiziente Lösungen zu bieten.

ITM Power befindet sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase und konzentriert sich auf die effiziente Umsetzung von Projekten. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die unsere Leidenschaft für saubere Energie teilen und aktiv zur globalen Energiewende beitragen möchten.

Der Projektcontroller ist für die Verwaltung des Gesamtprojektzeitplans und die Kontrolle der Projektkosten verantwortlich und stellt sicher, dass die Ausgaben im Rahmen des Projektbudgets bleiben. Zu den Aufgaben dieser Position gehören die Erstellung von Kostenberichten, die Analyse der finanziellen Leistung im Zusammenhang mit dem Projektplan sowie die Beratung von Projektmanagern und Stakeholdern hinsichtlich Strategien zum Kostenmanagement. Der Projektcontroller arbeitet eng mit den Finanz- und Projektmanagement-Teams zusammen, um eine genaue Kostenverfolgung und Berichterstattung sicherzustellen.

Sie unterstützen Projekte, indem Sie an internen und externen Kosten- und Terminüberprüfungen teilnehmen sowie die Kostenverfolgung und -abstimmung durchführen. Darüber hinaus führt diese Position regelmäßige Überprüfungen und Aktualisierungen des Projektrisikoregisters durch. Sie koordinieren die gesamten Projektsteuerungsaktivitäten unabhängig von Umfang und Komplexität, einschließlich Turnkey- und Pauschalprojekten, unter vollständiger Einhaltung der vertraglichen Anforderungen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam an der Entwicklung von Projektsteuerungsstrategien und -plänen, die mit den Projektzielen und vertraglichen Anforderungen übereinstimmen

  • In dieser Position überwachen, analysieren und berichten Sie über den Projektfortschritt, die Kostenentwicklung und bestehende Projektrisiken, gemeinsam mit dem Projektmanager entwickeln Sie Maßnahmen, um kritische Bereiche anzugehen und die Projektziele zu erreichen

  • Sie stellen die Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz der Projektsteuerungsdaten und -informationen sicher und implementieren Qualitätssicherungsprozesse, um zuverlässige und einheitliche Projektergebnisse zu gewährleisten

  • Sie entwickeln und pflegen Projektzeitpläne und arbeiten mit den Projektteammitgliedern zusammen, um wichtige Projektmeilensteine zu identifizieren und kritische Pfade zu analysieren

  • Darüber hinaus überwachen Sie die Projektkosten im Vergleich zum Budget und zur Prognose, erstellen gemeinsam mit den Projektmanagern Kostenschätzungen, identifizieren Kostenabweichungen und entwickeln entsprechende Korrekturmaßnahmen

  • Sie steuern die Prozesse zum Änderungsmanagement (Change Orders), um sicherzustellen, dass Änderungen ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert und in die Projektpläne sowie Kostenschätzungen integriert werden

  • Sie überwachen und überprüfen den Verbrauch von Arbeitsstunden im Verhältnis zu den erbrachten Leistungen und identifizieren Änderungen, die sich auf das erforderliche Budget auswirken

  • Sie identifizieren terminliche Herausforderungen und Probleme, die sich aus Einschränkungen oder Schnittstellen zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Funktionen ergeben

  • Sie überwachen und berichten über den kritischen Pfad sowie die Terminplanentwicklung des Gesamtprojekts

  • Sie empfehlen dem Projektteam alternative Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung des Terminplans und bringen diese zur Diskussion bzw. Entscheidungsfindung ein

Das bringen Sie mit

Fachliche Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Kosteningenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Kostencontrolling oder in der Projektsteuerung innerhalb der Engineering- und Bauindustrie

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Projektsteuerung im EPC-Umfeld (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie eine Zertifizierung als PMP (Project Management Professional) und/oder AACE (Certified Cost Engineer)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Softwareanwendungen zur Kostensteuerung, beispielsweise Primavera P6, MSP und SAP

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Budgetplanung, Forecasting und Abweichungsanalysen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Software, beispielsweise Power BI, SAP oder Oracle

  • Vertrautheit mit Methoden der Kostensteuerung, insbesondere Earned Value Management (EVM)

Persönliche Kompetenzen

  • Sie treten als engagierter Repräsentant des Unternehmens auf, überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten und gehen mit gutem Beispiel voran

  • Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Sozialkompetenzen sowie die Fähigkeit, den Projektfortschritt präzise und verständlich zu berichten

  • Sie sind teamorientiert und arbeiten effektiv mit anderen zusammen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen

  • Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz

  • Sie arbeiten äußerst strukturiert, organisiert und eigeninitiativ

  • Sie zeichnen sich durch Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft aus

  • Sie verfügen über sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Ihnen bieten

  • Sie arbeiten an einer der wichtigsten Zukunftstechnologien im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien in einem wachsenden Markt mit langfristigen Perspektiven

title: Quality Manager - Manufacturing Operations
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the role

Based in the UK you will be a key member of the Manufacturing Operations team where you will drive the development of our business management systems as well as our product, supplier, software and customer quality initiatives.

You will be comfortable with assessing processes and technologies to identify quality gaps and provide robust but pragmatic solutions to drive all aspects of the business in achieving the highest levels of quality and resilience.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and deliver the company quality strategy, policy and objectives, aligned to the product roadmap and growth plan.

  • Build, lead and develop a quality team covering supplier, product, reliability, software and systems quality.

  • Define and report quality performance to the executive team.

  • Establish appropriate document control, change control, CAPA, internal audit, training and records processes that scale with a fast-growing fabless company.

  • Work with PMO to embed quality gates into the new product introduction (NPI) and product lifecycle process, from concept through end of life.

  • Own quality across the supply chain: wafer foundry, assembly and packaging, wafer and final test, PCB/PCBA and system-level contract manufacturers.

  • Lead supplier selection, qualification, audits and ongoing performance management, including scorecards and quarterly business reviews.

  • Work with engineering leaders to define software quality standards across drivers, firmware, compilers, SDKs and runtime.

  • Establish release criteria, test coverage expectations, defect management and regression processes, aligned with CI/CD practice.

  • Bring in secure development and software supply chain practice, including SBOMs and vulnerability management.

  • Support responsible AI and AI management practice where customers ask for it, including awareness of ISO/IEC 42001.

  • Be the senior point of contact for customer quality, audits and escalations.

  • Lead customer RMA and complaint handling, root cause analysis and 8D responses to agreed timelines.

  • Ensure product compliance with RoHS, REACH, WEEE, conflict minerals reporting, UKCA and CE marking, and relevant safety and EMC standards.

Essential experience and skills

  • Significant experience in quality roles in semiconductors or electronics hardware, including creating and leading a quality function or team.

  • Direct experience managing quality through outsourced manufacturing: foundries, OSATs, test houses and/or contract manufacturers.

  • Deep knowledge of ISO 9001 and hands-on experience building or running a certified QMS.

  • Working knowledge of semiconductor qualification and reliability (JEDEC), failure analysis and

  • Awareness of data centre RAS assessments and HPC system qualification and certification.

  • Fluency in core quality tools: 8D, FMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA and root cause analysis.

  • Experience handling customer quality escalations with large, demanding customers.

  • Degree in electrical or electronic engineering, materials science, physics or a related discipline.

  • Clear, confident communicator who can influence engineers, suppliers and executives, and hold partners to account.

  • Willing to travel internationally, including to Asia and US, for supplier audits and customer quality reviews.

Desirable

  • Experience in a fabless company, particularly one bringing an initial product to volume.

  • Background in high-performance compute, data centre, networking or AI hardware.

  • Exposure to software quality, release management or secure development practice.

  • Lead auditor certification (ISO 9001), Six Sigma Black Belt, or chartered status (for example CQI or IET).

  • Experience working with suppliers in Taiwan, South Korea or US.

The impact you will have

You will help Fractile to makes sure every one of our suppliers builds to our standard, and that our customers receive AI hardware and software they can trust in production whilst shaping the quality culture across engineering, operations and commercial teams.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

title: Regional Field CTO

descriptionHtml:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Regional Field Chief Technology Officer

Location: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)

Black Duck® meets the board-level risks of modern software with True Scale Application Security, ensuring uncompromised trust in software for the regulated, AI-powered world. Only Black Duck solutions free organizations from tradeoffs between speed, accuracy, and compliance at scale while eliminating security, regulatory, and licensing risks. Whether in the cloud or on premises, Black Duck is the only choice for securing mission-critical software everywhere code happens. With Black Duck, security leaders can make smarter decisions and unleash business innovation with confidence.

We are looking for a Regional Field Chief Technology Officer to serve as a senior technical executive, trusted advisor, and public voice of our technology strategy in the market. In this role, the Regional Field CTO will operate at the intersection of technology, sales, and the customer — engaging directly with C-level and technical leaders at our most strategic customer accounts, translating our AI-driven platform capabilities into credible technical narratives, and representing the company as a thought leader across the industry. This is a customer-facing, pre-sales technical leadership role reporting to the VP of Sales Engineering, with a dotted line to Product & Technology.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor and recurring executive sponsor for C-level and senior technical stakeholders at strategic, enterprise, federal and other key accounts — pivoting fluidly between business strategy conversations, risk, compliance, and deep technical architecture reviews.
  • Lead highly visible, multidisciplinary technical engagements of strategic importance across the region, including executive briefings, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, customer advisory feedback loops, and partner or analyst-facing discussions.
  • Represent Black Duck as a technical evangelist for the platform and roadmap within a region, delivering keynotes, webinars, whitepapers, and thought leadership content at industry events, and representing the company externally with press, analysts, and partners.
  • Translate Black Duck platform AI/ML, detection engine, and platform architecture capabilities into clear, credible narratives for both technical and executive audiences, speaking candidly to responsible AI practices such as data privacy, model governance, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Partner with Sales and Presales leadership on the region’s most strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical deep-dives, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, and executive briefings, and advising on the technical implications of new product launches, roadmap changes, and competitive positioning.
  • Support RFPs and security questionnaires with authoritative technical input, and articulate competitive and technical differentiation, including nuanced comparisons of AI/ML capabilities against alternatives in the market.
  • Proactively engage strategic accounts to strengthen technical trust, identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and guide customers toward secure software development and application security maturity.
  • Identify and solve problems of strategic or industry scope, using innovative approaches to remove technical barriers, strengthen customer confidence, and improve business outcomes.
  • Provide field-informed guidance on emerging AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, application security trends, and competitive market dynamics that may influence Black Duck strategy or customer adoption.
  • Capture, synthesize, and escalate regional customer, partner, and market feedback into actionable input for Product, Engineering, and Sales systematically capturing technical objections and influencing the roadmap, packaging, launch readiness, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Coach, enable, and review technical storytelling by sales engineers and account executives, including how to explain AI features accurately without overclaiming.

Qualifications and Experience Required:

  • 15+ years in a senior technical leadership role (CTO, Sales Engineering leader, Principal Architect, or equivalent), including several years in a customer-facing or field/pre-sales capacity.
  • Proven track record engaging and influencing C-level and senior technical audiences at enterprise organizations, with demonstrated success across complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Domain expertise in application security (SAST, SCA, DAST), enterprise architecture, cloud/SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and security best practices.
  • Deep, practical understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, large language models, behavioral analytics, AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows), along with a candid grasp of their limitations and the practical limitations and controls needed for responsible adoption.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating with and influencing executive leadership, significant customers, partners, analysts, or vendors to shape technical decisions and business outcomes.
  • Ability to exercise wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches for complex, critical assignments with material regional, functional, or market impact.
  • Experience shaping standards, methods, practices, or market-facing technical narratives within an industry or discipline.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear stories for both executive and highly technical audiences, including customers, partners, press, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated industry presence — conference speaking, published thought leadership, active contribution to industry/analyst communities, customer advisory leadership, or comparable external technical influence.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites and industry events.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or other advanced degree.

title: AI Research Engineer (Model Compression & Quantization)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities

Break down the key responsibilities in bullet points. It’s helpful to make them actionable and measurable. This could also be grouped into categories for more complex roles.

  • Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

  • Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

  • Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

  • Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

  • Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

  • Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

  • Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

  • Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.


  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

  • Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and fine-tuning techniques.

  • Familiarity with C++ is a plus (especially for implementing low-level quantization kernels or inference optimizations).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren


Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt.
