title: Senior Manager Commerce (Mensch) Retail Media
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten & Remote Work gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen. 
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei. 
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen. 

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Manager Commerce (Mensch) Retail Media bist du die strategische und operative Schlüsselfigur für unsere Großkund. Du verantwortest die ganzheitliche Planung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Retail-Media-Aktivitäten – von Amazon und weiteren Marktplätzen über führende Retailer bis hin zu Video- und Audio-Formaten.

  • Strategie & Jahresplanung: Du entwickelst ganzheitliche Commerce- und Retail-Media-Strategien für deine Kunden, definierst KPI-Ziele und erstellst die Mediaplanung über alle relevanten Touchpoints und Funnel-Stufen hinweg.
  • Kundenführung & Management: Du führst den Kunden partnerschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe, steuerst die regelmäßige Kommunikation (inkl. internationaler Stakeholder) und präsentierst Ergebnisse sowie strategische Roadmaps in Reviews.
  • Ganzheitliche Kampagnensteuerung (A–Z): Du verantwortest das Kampagnenmanagement über das gesamte Retail-Netzwerk – von Amazon (Sponsored Ads & DSP) über führende Retailer (dm, Rossmann, REWE etc.) bis hin zu Video- und Audio-Aktivierungen (Prime Video, Spotify).
  • Operatives Setup & Aussteuerung: Du übernimmst das hands-on Kampagnen-Setup – von der Keyword- und Audience-Recherche über die Kampagnenstruktur bis hin zum täglichen Bid- und Pacing-Management, um Budgets optimal auszuschöpfen.
  • Laufende Optimierung & Testing: Du justierst Gebote, Match Types und Zielgruppen, führst Tests&Learn durch, optimierst und hebst kontinuierlich Performance-Potenziale.
  • Budget- & Rentabilitätsverantwortung: Du steuerst und überwachst signifikante Mediabudgets eigenverantwortlich, behältst ROAS sowie Effizienzmetriken im Blick und optimierst den Media-Mix kontinuierlich.
  • Datenanalyse & Insights: Du analysierst Performance-, Sortiments- und Marktdaten, erkennst Wachstumshebel und übersetzt komplexe Zahlen in klare Handlungsempfehlungen für den Kunden.
  • Fachliche Teamleitung: Du strukturierst und koordinierst Aufgaben innerhalb eines kleinen Teams, coachst Kolleg:innen auf Junior- und Mid-Level fachlich und sorgst für reibungslose operative Abläufe.
  • Innovation & Weiterentwicklung: Du treibst Best Practices voran, testest neue AdTech-Möglichkeiten und gestaltest die Entwicklung unseres Commerce-Bereichs aktiv mit.

 

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Retail Media, Performance Marketing oder E-Commerce (idealerweise auf Agentur- oder Brand-Seite).
  • Fundiertes Plattform-Wissen: Du hast nachweisbare Praxis in der Planung, dem Setup und der Optimierung von Kampagnen im Bereich Advertising (Sponsored Ads und DSP).
  • Ganzheitliches Retail-Verständnis: Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Retailern und Marken (egal ob Drogerie, Food oder Marktplatz) und hast Lust, Kampagnen über mehrere Handelsplattformen hinweg strategisch zu orchestrieren.
  • Strategische & analytische Denkweise: Du denkst in Business-Zielen, verstehst Kennzahlen im Detail und kannst fundierte Mediapläne und Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln.
  • Souveräne Kundenführung: Du trittst überzeugend auf, kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich präsentieren und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Führungs- & Organisationsgeschick: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Aufgaben im Team strukturiert zu koordinieren, zu delegieren und Kolleg:innen fachlich zu unterstützen.
  • Persönlichkeit & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du denkst proaktiv mit, packst bei operativen Herausforderungen selbst mit an und bringst eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit.
  • Nice to Have: Erfahrungen mit weiteren Retail-Plattformen und AdTechs wie Criteo, CitrusAd oder The Trade Desk sowie Tools wie Pacvue, Skai oder Helium10. Kenntnisse in Streaming-Advertising und BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Looker Studio sind ebenfalls ein Plus.

 Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamorientiert #analytisch #kommunikativ #proaktiv #lösungsorientiert

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

title: Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Build, Scale & Operate Leading DTC Brands alongside A-Players

Maneuver Marketing

Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products.

In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs.

These results caught the attention of The Financial Times, as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards, jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore.

This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth!

Your Next Role

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability.

You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps.

Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance.

This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising.

What You’ll Do

1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands

  • Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales.

  • Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand.

  • Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media.

  • Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign.

  • Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance.

  • Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive.

  • Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation.

2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team

  • The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates.

  • Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows.

  • Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently.

3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline

  • Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list.

  • Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop.

  • Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends.

  • Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified.

  • Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees.

4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

  • Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance.

  • Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense.

  • Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate.

  • Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them.

  • Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance.

5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships

  • Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review.

  • Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback.

  • Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners.

  • Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications.

  • Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic.

  • Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly.

6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets

  • Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively.

  • Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content.

  • Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use.

  • Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels.

  • Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content.

  • Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role.

7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence

  • Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house.

  • Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume.

  • Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time.

  • Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly.

  • Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate.

7. Measure and Improve Performance

  • You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic.

  • You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns.

  • Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program.

  • Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment.

  • Build clear weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting for the Growth team and company leadership.

  • Analyze performance by creator profile, product, platform, partnership structure, outreach message and content format.

  • Maintain a structured testing roadmap covering outreach messages, incentives, creator segments and content approaches.

How You’ll Succeed

  • You combine strategic thinking with a willingness to remain close to execution.

  • You create clarity for your team, hold people accountable and help them improve.

  • You build a predictable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially valuable content.

  • You use data and experimentation to improve response rates, partnership quality and return on investment.

  • You can recognize creators who offer strong value beyond follower count alone.

  • You build effective partnerships across Creator Marketing, Paid Media, Creative, Supply, Email Marketing and E-commerce.

  • You introduce structure without slowing down execution.

  • You communicate clearly, act quickly and resolve problems before they affect campaigns.

  • You remain resourceful in a competitive market where budgets and creator expectations may not always align.

  • You care equally about relationship quality, operational accuracy and commercial outcomes.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or creator affiliate marketing, including at least one program you owned end to end with commercial accountability.

  • Operator experience running a TikTok Shop or comparable creator affiliate program, with GMV or revenue you were personally accountable for.

  • DTC or e-commerce experience in health and wellness, beauty, or another regulated consumer category.

  • Experience managing or mentoring team members, with evidence you raised their output rather than just reviewed it.

  • Experience managing external agencies, consultants or vendors: setting scope, holding quality, deciding when to bring work in-house.

  • Experience structuring and negotiating both flat-fee and performance-based partnerships.

  • Strong analytical skills and a track record of using campaign data to change decisions, not just report them.

  • Evidence of an AI or automation workflow you built or deployed that measurably increased throughput. Be ready to walk through what it does and what it saved.

Strongly preferred

  • Ownership of brand-owned organic social channels, not only creator programs. You understand how owned content and creator content compound.

  • Working knowledge of FTC material-connection disclosure and platform claim policy in a regulated category. You know what a creator cannot say about a supplement, and why the answer differs on TikTok and Meta.

  • Experience collaborating with Paid Media or Creative to repurpose creator content into performance advertising, including securing ad authorization at partnership time.

  • Hands-on with an influencer marketing platform - SARAL, Modash, Lefty or equivalent.

  • Experience running influencer or creator programs across multiple brands or product categories.

  • Experience partnering with healthcare professionals or subject-matter experts as brand partners.

  • Understanding of paid social creative testing and direct-response fundamentals.

  • Genuine interest in health, wellness, consumer behavior and social media culture.

title: Senior Market Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Homes Supply team plays a critical role in ensuring Airbnb secures a diverse and high-quality supply of stays listings. Efforts are aimed at meeting the expectations of guests by ensuring a wide offering of high-quality listings at compelling values are available for every search.

The Difference You will Make:

In this role, you will lead a team of Market Associates responsible for a high-velocity, input-driven account management motion supporting our long tail of Small/medium sized Hosts. You will own execution excellence across rapid optimisation workflows, holding the team accountable to activity-based KPIs while driving consistent, scalable impact across the region.

You will also serve as a key stakeholder and operator for all scaled supply acquisition and retention initiatives within your assigned territory. This includes organising and executing regional roadshows and events, developing strategies to grow and retain supply, and rapidly scaling best practices across the team. The role partners closely with Host Services and Community teams to ensure seamless delivery, strong host engagement, and measurable outcomes.

This role plays a critical role in driving host quality, supply performance, and campaign effectiveness at scale.

A Typical Day: 

  • Lead and manage a team of Market Associates executing a high-volume, transactional optimisation motion, with a strong focus on input-based KPIs that drive improvements in listing performance, host quality, and overall supply health.
  • Be accountable for regional business performance, including input and output metrics, supply optimisation results and host quality KPIs.

Serve as an active stakeholder and operator across all scaled outreach initiatives, partnering closely with Host Services and Community teams to ensure campaigns, roadshows, and regional events are delivered consistently, efficiently, and at scale.

  • Monitor performance dashboards and scaled campaign results, identify trends or gaps, and adjust team focus to improve outcomes.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, tooling gaps, or process inefficiencies and partner cross-functionally to improve scale, speed, and consistency.
  • Coach and develop team members to excel in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment while preparing high performers for future growth opportunities.
  • Continually test, refine, and standardise scaled account motions and best practices, codifying what works and rapidly rolling it out across the team.
  • May help design, launch, and scale targeted outreach campaigns for Solo and Small Hosts—partnering cross-functionally
  • Build new communication channels to increase reach, engagement and impact within this cohort

Your Expertise:

  • 3-5+ years relevant experience managing teams, preferably scaled account management teams, with a strong interest in people management and team development.
  • Prior experience in operations, sales or leading projects in a performance-driven environment. 
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-volume workflows with clear metrics and performance goals.
  • Strong organisational and program execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.
  • Data-oriented mindset with the ability to use dashboards and insights to guide decisions and coaching.
  • Clear and confident communicator who can translate strategy into actionable guidance for frontline teams.
  • Ability to partner cross-functionally and follow through on shared goals.
  • Some Marketing experience is a plus.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range£72,000—£85,000 GBP

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

title: Senior Network Administrator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie haben schon einmal ein gewachsenes Netzwerk neu geordnet:
Segmente getrennt, Standorte sauber angebunden und alles so dokumentiert, dass auch andere damit arbeiten können? Und Sie möchten genau das jetzt über mehrere Standorte und mit voller Verantwortung umsetzen?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel und Standorten in Europa und Nordamerika. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis.

Warum diese Rolle

Das Netzwerk ist über Jahre gewachsen und wird jetzt neu strukturiert. Die Netze werden getrennt und segmentiert, die Produktionsnetze abgesichert, und es entstehen verbindliche Standards. Ziel ist eine performante, ausfallsichere und gegen Angriffe belastbare Netzwerklandschaft, auf der alle IT-Services aufsetzen.

• Weil Sie die Netzarchitektur über mehrere Standorte selbst prägen.

• Weil Ihre Arbeit sichtbar wird: in stabilen Verbindungen, sauberen Segmenten und einer Doku, mit der andere arbeiten können.

• Weil eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen Rückhalt gibt, auch wenn etwas nicht auf Anhieb klappt.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Planung, Aufbau und Betrieb von LAN, WAN und Backbone an allen Standorten

• Routing und Switching inklusive VLAN-Konzept und Redundanz

• Standortvernetzung per VPN und sichere Remote-Zugänge

• Betrieb der Firewalls (Fortinet) und Neuordnung gewachsener Regelwerke

• Segmentierung der Netze und Trennung von IT und OT, damit die Produktion geschützt läuft

• WLAN und Access Points

• Netzpläne, IP-Adressverwaltung und Standards, die das Netz für alle nachvollziehbar machen

Zur Einordnung: Security-Monitoring und SIEM betreibt ein externer Partner, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten. Clients, Server und Anwendungen betreuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen im IT-Team. Ihr Schwerpunkt ist das Netzwerk selbst, von der Verkabelung bis zum Routing.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Netzwerkadministrator oder Network Engineer, idealerweise inhouse in einem Industrie- oder Produktionsunternehmen

• Sie haben Netze konzipiert, strukturiert und dokumentiert, gern auch als Allrounder mit klarem Netzwerkschwerpunkt in einem kleineren Unternehmen.

• Fundiertes Know-how in Routing und Switching sowie Erfahrung mit der Vernetzung mehrerer Standorte, idealerweise international

• Praxis mit Fortinet oder vergleichbaren Enterprise-Lösungen, etwa Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco oder Sophos

• Erfahrung mit Produktionsnetzen und der Trennung von IT und OT

• Sicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Abstimmung mit den Standorten

• Von Vorteil: Zertifizierungen wie Fortinet FCP/FCSS, Cisco CCNA/CCNP oder vergleichbar

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort. Dazu kommen projektbezogene Reisen zu den Standorten.

• Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema und kurze Entscheidungswege

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und Bikeleasing

• Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel für Hersteller-Zertifizierungen

Gehalt

60.000–70.000 € brutto im Jahr plus Tantieme, je nach Erfahrung

Interesse?

Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin. Stefan Schulz meldet sich bei Ihnen für ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch.

title: Senior Paid Social Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About You

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who can strategically lead and scale our acquisition efforts across paid social channels in the UK and Europe. You’ll bring deep expertise in managing multi-million-pound budgets, a data-driven approach, and a proven track record of driving large-scale growth. You will be responsible for leading strategy, execution, and innovation in our paid social performance, ensuring we stay ahead of platform changes and industry trends. You’ll also have a clear view on how AI is changing performance marketing, and you’ll build a team that uses it well.

You’ll be a Meta expert, with hands-on experience across bidding strategies, audience segmentation, attribution, and creative testing. Additionally, you’ll have experience scaling campaigns across TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn. You’ll be a martech-savvy professional, comfortable with tracking solutions, first-party data activation, working with MMPs and advanced attribution modeling.

You will play a key role in shaping Tide’s international expansion and long-term paid social strategy, ensuring that performance marketing continues to be a key growth driver. This is an opportunity to lead and grow Tide’s in-house Paid Social team as an AI-enabled team, making a significant impact on the business.

Some of the things you’ll be doing:

  • Owning and scaling paid social performance globally, ensuring we maximise efficiency and return on investment across all platforms.
  • Managing and optimising multi-million-pound budgets, using advanced bidding strategies and automation tools to drive sustained growth.
  • Building an AI-enabled paid social team, deciding which work AI should handle (creative production, reporting, bid and budget management) and which stays with people, then training the team to work that way.
  • Embedding AI into creative and testing workflows, using generative tools to develop concepts, copy and variants faster, with clear quality, brand and compliance checks.
  • Using AI and automation across the account, from platform tools such as Advantage+ to custom scripts, agents and reporting workflows that cut manual work.
  • Developing and executing the paid social roadmap, identifying new opportunities, testing innovative strategies, and expanding our presence across emerging platforms.
  • Driving a full-funnel approach, from awareness campaigns to high-intent lead generation and conversion, leveraging creative and audience insights.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Data, Product, Web, Creative, and more) to align paid social strategies with Tide’s wider growth objectives.
  • Championing attribution and measurement, ensuring best-in-class tracking, incrementality testing, and first-party data activation.
  • Leading creative strategy, working closely with designers and copywriters to continuously test and optimise assets for performance.
  • Staying ahead of industry changes, including privacy regulations (SKAD, ATT, IFDA), AI-driven platform updates, and new advertising solutions.
  • Building and mentoring a high-performing, AI-literate paid social team, shaping the function as we scale both in the UK and internationally.

You’ll be a great fit if:

  • You have 7+ years of experience in paid social marketing, managing large-scale campaigns across multiple platforms.
  • You have a proven track record of driving large volumes of B2B acquisition through paid social.
  • You’re an expert in Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram), with deep knowledge of bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and ad creative best practices.
  • You have extensive hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads, Twitter, TikTok, and other secondary paid social platforms.
  • You’re highly analytical, comfortable with incrementality testing, MMM, and data-driven decision-making.
  • You have strong technical knowledge of tracking solutions, attribution modeling, and martech tools (Appsflyer, GA4, GTM, CDPs, Looker/Tableau, etc.).
  • You have hands-on experience using AI in marketing, such as generative tools for creative and copy, LLMs for analysis, and automation for reporting and optimisation.
  • You have experience building or leading a team that uses AI day to day, including setting standards, sharing prompts and workflows, and measuring the productivity gain.
  • You’re comfortable with Meta’s AI-led campaign products (Advantage+, automated bidding) and know when to trust automation and when to override it.
  • You have sound judgement on AI risk, including brand safety, accuracy of claims and data privacy, ideally in a regulated industry such as financial services.
  • You understand how to drive performance across web traffic, mobile apps, and lead generation channels.
  • You have a test-and-learn mindset, with a structured approach to experimentation and optimisation.
  • You can effectively communicate complex insights, using data visualisation tools to tell compelling performance stories.
  • You have experience managing agency relationships, but also thrive in an in-house, hands-on environment.
  • You’re a natural leader, with experience mentoring and growing a team of paid social professionals.
  • Fluency in a second language (French or German) is preferable.

What you’ll get in return:

  • Make work, work for you! We embrace flexible working and remote-first arrangements.
  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays.
  • Vitality Health and Dental Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical well-being.
  • £1,000 L&D budget per year, plus up to three L&D paid days off.
  • Enhanced family-friendly leave.
  • Work abroad for up to 90 days a year.
  • Snacks, drinks, and social events in our offices.

Tidean Ways of Working

At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. We trust our employees to work in a way that suits them while delivering great results. Our offices are always available for those who want to collaborate in person, and we support remote work across the UK.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. title: Senior Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).


The product

V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve. Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.

Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

  • Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows.

  • Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

  • Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation.

The team you’ll be joining and impact you’ll have

  • A small Platform team with a very wide remit: cloud, SRE, DevOps, developer experience, compliance, and the infrastructure behind our AI products.

  • We run AWS first across multiple regions, with GCP and Azure alongside. Our model providers come through all three, so this is genuinely multi-cloud work.

  • We're in the process of making everything faster, more reliable and nicer to work with, for enterprise customers who expect a lot. There are a number of compliance and big expansion projects on the horizon

  • Our engineers lean heavily on AI coding agents and sandboxes. You’ll shape how that works across the company, giving people freedom while keeping us in control.

What you’ll be doing from day one:

  • Owning our infrastructure as code in Terraform, plus alerting, observability (Prometheus, Grafana) and reliability, including load testing and disaster recovery exercises.

  • Making CI/CD faster (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) and taking obstacles out of engineers’ way, from build times to how they run AI agents day to day.

  • Running the platform behind our AI workloads across Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure, with a close eye on reliability and cost.

  • Getting on calls with enterprise customers and our commercial team to troubleshoot and answer infrastructure and security questions. Alongside that, compliance work and a spot on the on-call rotation.

Who you are

  • Strong AWS in production, ideally multi-region. Hands-on with GCP, with Azure a bonus. You understand how model consumption works through each cloud.

  • Deep experience with Terraform, observability and CI/CD, and you write solid Python (Elixir is a bonus, or you’re keen to learn).

  • A clear communicator who’s happy explaining technical things to a customer, not just to other engineers.

  • Independent and comfortable with ambiguity. You find problems without being handed tickets, and you don’t mind when priorities flip from one week to the next.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
descriptionHtml:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. title: Senior/Principal Physical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior/Principal Physical Design Engineer to contribute to our next-generation chip designs. As a Physical Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end implementation of complex IC physical designs, from synthesis to sign-off, including opportunities for full-chip ownership. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including logic design, verification, and process technology, to optimise performance, power, and area (PPA) while ensuring design integrity and manufacturability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive the physical implementation of ASIC/SoC designs, including floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, and sign-off, with potential responsibility for full-chip execution.

  • Work on synthesis, timing analysis (STA), and optimisation to achieve the best PPA metrics.

  • Perform power planning and analysis, addressing IR drop, electromigration, and low-power design techniques.

  • Ensure design rule check (DRC), layout vs. schematic (LVS), and other physical verification compliance.

  • Collaborate with DFT engineers to integrate design-for-test (DFT) structures into the physical implementation.

  • Develop flows in EDA tools such as Cadence Innovus, Synopsys Fusion Compiler, Mentor Graphics Calibre, and others.

  • Interface with foundries and process engineers to ensure manufacturability and yield optimisation.

  • Work closely with RTL and architecture teams to drive design feasibility, constraints, and physical-aware RTL design.

  • Work with advanced AI tools and models to improve productivity, analysis, and design quality.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’ Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in physical design for advanced technology nodes (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, or below).

  • Strong proficiency in EDA tools for place & route, STA, and sign-off.

  • Solid understanding of CMOS technology, semiconductor physics, and process limitations.

  • Experience with low-power design methodologies, power optimisation techniques, and multi-power domain architectures.

  • Expertise in timing closure, signal integrity, IR drop analysis, and formal verification.

  • Proficiency in scripting languages like TCL, Perl, or Python for automation.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, communication, and teamwork in a collaborative design environment.

  • Experience in high-performance computing (HPC), AI accelerators, or networking chips.

  • Experience or strong interest in leveraging advanced AI tools and models within engineering workflow

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Senior Product Engineer

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 2 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £120k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

How we do it

Most tools start and stop with dashboards. We start with the hard part: turning fragmented, messy enterprise data into a consistent foundation people can trust. Then we use AI to make it conversational, so anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer they can act on.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

The data is only half the story. As AI gets better at analysing large volumes of data, the hard part shifts to the product: helping customers explore and understand what the model finds, designing for trust, and turning insight into action.

You’ll shape how customers work with agentic AI, balancing the stability and reliability enterprises expect with the new, agent-driven experiences we’re building at the cutting edge. You’ll have real autonomy in how you approach it, working in a small, high-trust team with genuine influence over product, architecture and how engineering grows.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and ship high-quality frontend experiences across Deducta's platform.

  • Work directly with customers to understand their problems, and turn those insights into product decisions.

  • Build interfaces that make large datasets, dynamic metrics and AI-generated analysis clear and useful.

  • Design for the limits of AI, so customers know when to trust an answer and how to check it.

  • Push the boundaries of applied AI, both in the product and in how we build it.

  • Own problems end to end, from definition to deployment, making sound calls on architecture, usability, performance and maintainability along the way.

Success in this role means:

  • Customers go from data to decisions: Features you've shipped help customers explore AI-generated analysis and act on it, not just search through data.

  • Trustworthy AI experiences: Customers can see where an answer came from and when to check it, so their confidence in Deducta grows as they use it more.

  • A product foundation others build on: The components and patterns you've built are fast, consistent and reused across the product by the team.

Who you are

You're a senior product engineer who cares as much about the problem as the code, and takes ideas all the way to production. You don't need a background in enterprise data or procurement. We care about how you think and the quality of the products you've built.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Strong JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals, with experience building high-quality frontend applications.

  • Experience making complex data, information or workflows easy for people to understand and act on.

  • A clear view of what AI systems can and can't do, and how good product design accounts for outputs that aren't always right.

  • Sound judgement on architecture and product trade-offs, and the ability to explain the reasoning behind your decisions.

  • A track record of owning problems from investigation through to production.

  • High standards for testing, code quality and maintainability, and clear communication with engineers, customers and stakeholders.

  • A founder mindset: you see a problem and feel empowered to work out how to solve it.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical interview

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.

title: Senior Product Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Program Management Team

Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, product, safety and validation teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more predictably and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake.

As Senior Product Lifecycle Manager, you’ll connect Wayve’s product milestones to the detailed technical plans, system-level artefacts and readiness evidence needed to deliver them. You’ll lead complex, multi-team programmes from one milestone to the next, ensuring teams work from a shared, credible plan across our Level 2 and Level 4 products.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Partner with engineering and product leads to translate product milestones into integrated cross-team schedules, priorities and delivery plans.

  • Review technical progress, backlog health, dependencies and system-level evidence to determine whether programmes are ready to move forward.

  • Identify technical risks and sequencing bottlenecks early, then drive the decisions and mitigation plans needed to protect delivery.

  • Facilitate difficult conversations around scope, resources and competing priorities, helping teams reach clear and practical decisions.

  • Adapt plans quickly as technical understanding, product priorities or delivery constraints change.

  • Communicate programme status, schedule changes, risks and decisions clearly and proactively across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams.

  • Managing cross-team dependencies and critical-path activities across engineering, product, safety, verification and validation.

  • Managing system-level artefacts throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring the right information and evidence are available at each milestone.

  • Establishing clear milestone-readiness criteria and using technical status, metrics and backlog data to support evidence-based delivery decisions.

  • Aligning programme scope, sequencing and resource decisions with Wayve’s strategic and commercial priorities.

  • Improving lifecycle-planning practices and tooling so teams can identify risk earlier, coordinate more effectively and deliver with greater predictability.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-team technical or product programmes, with responsibility for planning, execution and delivery across several engineering teams.

  • You bring a strong background in the automotive or autonomous-vehicle industry and understand the complexity of delivering integrated vehicle and software products.

  • You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution.

  • You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes.

  • You’re decisive under uncertainty and can make sound prioritisation and trade-off recommendations with incomplete or evolving information.

  • You have a strong track record of identifying delivery, technical and dependency risks early and driving them through to resolution.

  • You use metrics, technical evidence and backlog health to assess readiness and guide programme decisions.

  • You’re product-minded and outcome-focused, connecting delivery decisions to customer value and business impact rather than process completion alone.

  • You can facilitate challenging stakeholder conversations, resolve conflicting technical priorities and create alignment without relying on formal authority.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, tailoring complex programme information for both technical and business audiences.

  • You’re proficient with Jira, Confluence and modern backlog, planning and programme-management tools.

  • Experience working in a safety-critical, regulated or complex multi-stakeholder environment would be valuable.

  • A programme-management qualification such as PMP, CAPM or PRINCE2 would be a plus.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency Interviews (HM Call; 60 minutes)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Stakeholder Management, Delivery Use Case; 2 hours)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
  • Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
  • Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.
  • Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.
  • A background as an engineer, ML engineer, or researcher on a production system in one of those areas. This is a requirement rather than a preference. You will be making tradeoff calls alongside senior search engineers, and you need to have built something at that scale yourself.
  • Direct experience shipping a search or ranking change end to end, including how it was evaluated and what happened after it shipped.
  • A strong data foundation: you can design an experiment, read eval results critically, and tell a real quality improvement from noise.
  • Product judgment to match the technical depth: you can decide what to build and what to leave, and defend it to both engineers and customers.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how retrieval fits into agentic workflows.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, moving between strategy and execution without losing the thread.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Depth in information retrieval, NLP, or applied machine learning beyond what the role requires.
  • Experience with index tiering, sharding, freshness pipelines, or cost-per-query optimisation at scale.
  • Experience with hybrid retrieval, semantic and lexical search, re-ranking, or human evaluation programs.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses running both self-serve and enterprise motions.
  • Experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager

  • Be the voice of our product. Speak at customer roadshows, events and webinars, and give our point of view on market shifts, such as what AI means for finance leaders in the UK and Ireland.

  • Typically six or more years in B2B SaaS product marketing, including launches for a product bought through a considered, sales-led process.

  • Customer understanding you've built first-hand: interviews, win/loss, segmentation and personas, and evidence it changed what a product team built.

Desirable:

  • Marketing a multi-product suite, or bringing products and teams together

What's the hiring process?

AIQ Group brings together AccountsIQ and ExpenseIn, two ambitious SaaS businesses helping finance teams work smarter. title: Senior Projektleiter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle bei uns

Du übernimmst die übergreifende Steuerung großer Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallelen IT- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten. Dabei verantwortest du Termine, Budgets, Ressourcen, Qualität und Risiken und führst Projektmanager und Projektteams fachlich.
Dein Fokus liegt auf einer belastbaren, projektübergreifenden Steuerung. Du erkennst Risiken und Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig und greifst gezielt ein, wenn Projekte aus der Spur geraten. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Delivery Management sorgst du dafür, dass komplexe Kundenaccounts erfolgreich gesteuert werden.

Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst große Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallelen IT- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten und behältst Termine, Budgets, Qualität und Risiken im Gesamtblick.
  • Du steuerst und unterstützt die Projektteams innerhalb deines Accounts und förderst deren fachliche Weiterentwicklung im Rahmen der laufenden Projekte.
  • Du setzt ein wirksames Risikomanagement um und stellst sicher, dass Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Eskalationen frühzeitig erkannt, bewertet und adressiert werden.
  • Du schaffst Transparenz durch Kennzahlen, Forecasts, Statusberichte und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
  • Du steuerst die Kommunikation mit Kunden auf Managementebene und moderierst Lenkungsausschüsse sowie kritische Abstimmungen.
  • Du koordinierst Ressourcen und Kompetenzen projektübergreifend und setzt klare Prioritäten.
  • Du greifst bei gefährdeten Projekten gezielt ein, stabilisierst die Steuerung und übergibst die operative Verantwortung anschließend wieder an den zuständigen Projektmanager.
  • Du begleitest die Übergabe neuer Projekte aus dem Vertrieb in die Delivery und schärfst Scope, Erwartungen und Kalkulation.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Delivery Excellence Projektmanagement-Standards, Methoden und Best Practices weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer IT-Projekte, Programme oder größerer Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallel laufenden Projekten.
  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Projektcontrolling sowie in der Budget- und Forecaststeuerung, im Risiko- und Eskalationsmanagement mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Projektmanagern sowie interdisziplinären Teams.
  • Du bist erfahren in der Steuerung anspruchsvoller Kunden und im Umgang mit Management- und Entscheidungsebenen.
  • Du bist in der Lage, kritische Projektsituationen schnell zu erfassen, geeignete Maßnahmen einzuleiten und Projekte nachhaltig zu stabilisieren.
  • Du verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprojekten, IT-Architekturen und modernen Entwicklungsprozessen.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge von IT-Projekten.
  • Du trittst souverän auf und überzeugst durch Kommunikations- und Moderationsstärke sowie eine hohe Entscheidungssicherheit.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

Womit du zusätzlich punktest

  • Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem IT-Beratungs-, Softwareentwicklungs- oder IT-Dienstleistungsumfeld mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Plane, Moco oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen.
  • Du verfügst über Zertifizierungen wie IPMA, PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen.
  • Du hast bereits kritische oder eskalierte IT-Projekte erfolgreich stabilisiert.
