title: Senior Proposal Writer
descriptionHtml:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Senior Proposal Writer- Open to UK, France and Netherlands

The Senior Proposal Writer leads the most complex, high-stakes and non-standard RFX responses from intake to submission, as a trusted partner to Sales. Alongside Solution Consulting and subject-matter experts, this role guides strategy shaping, pulls the contributions together and delivers proposals that are clear, accurate and give buyers confidence in the outcomes OneStream delivers. The role also coaches other writers and helps raise the standards, content and tools the whole team works with. 

Primary Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Lead complex, high-stakes and non-standard RFI, RFP and RFQ responses from intake to submission, maintaining the highest standards of execution and submission integrity. 
  • Work with Sales to understand the deal behind each response (the buyer’s priorities, the competition, the evidence that builds confidence) and shape the proposal around it. 
  • Coordinate concurrent contributions from Sales, Solution Consulting, Finance, Legal, Product and other specialist teams. 
  • Set and run the project cadence (including kick-off, RFP tool setup, check-ins, reviews, packaging and close-down), creating clarity, facilitating multiple contributors and consistently meeting deadlines and milestones. 
  • Take each response over the line, checking structure, formatting, accuracy and clarity before it goes. 

Knowledge & Continuous Improvement 

  • Keep knowledge of OneStream’s platform and competitive positioning current, and catch outdated or inaccurate product information before it goes out. 
  • Spot gaps and help close them, in how responses are crafted and positioned and in the standards, workflows, templates, tools and content library behind them. 
  • Turn lessons from completed proposals and their outcomes into guidance, content and examples the whole team can use. 
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully across the workflow, and share the prompts and practices that improve insight, quality, consistency and pace. 

Collaboration, Coaching & Influence 

  • Build strong relationships with the teams relied on, know their remit and boundaries, and route requests well so that colleagues’ time is used efficiently. 
  • Coach junior and mid-level writers with practical feedback on their work and the thinking behind strong proposal decisions, and help new joiners get up to speed. 
  • Shape how the team approaches content, quality and process, and model the standards expected of the team. 

Competencies 

  • Sound judgement on structure, messaging and emphasis when requirements are ambiguous, incomplete or non-standard, a willingness to adapt when the standard approach doesn’t fit, and ownership of the decisions made. 
  • Influence without direct authority, built on trust. 
  • The confidence to hold a reasoned position with Sales on quality and standards, with an open mind and a realistic view of what each deal needs. 
  • A commercial view of how proposals drive revenue, and the focus to put effort where it most influences the buyer’s decision. 
  • Self-motivation and accountability, working independently and delivering as part of a team. 
  • A habit of learning, spotting opportunities in their own skills and developing them. 

Required Education and Experience 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, English, Marketing or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • Seven or more years writing and managing RFI, RFP and RFQ responses, working alongside sales teams on competitive, high-value deals. 
  • Professional experience using AI tools in a writing, editing or content workflow. 
  • Experience coaching or mentoring colleagues and contributing to team knowledge sharing. 

Preferred Education and Experience 

  • Experience in a cloud or SaaS environment, ideally in finance or a related domain. 
  • Experience with Ombud or a comparable proposal management platform. 
  • Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM in opportunity and proposal workflows. 
  • APMP preferred but not required. 

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 

  • Ability to analyse complex business processes, enterprise technology and buyer requirements, and work out what they mean for the response and where the gaps are. 
  • Exceptional writing, editing and verbal communication, turning complex technical, business and commercial information into accurate, persuasive content. 
  • Ability to prioritise competing projects, manage time effectively and stay accurate as deadlines shift. 
  • Solid grasp of sales frameworks, buyer enablement, and revenue operations. 

Supervisory Responsibilities 

n/a. 

Travel 

Regular travel is not expected for this position.

Mit unserer wöchentlichen „Bewegten Pause“ bringst du außerdem Bewegung und Mobilisierung in deinen Arbeitsalltag – im Büro oder im Homeoffice.

title: Senior QA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
The Role:

As a Senior QA Engineer, you'll own quality across our product portfolio. You'll define and lead our quality strategy across the full platform, from backend services and agent orchestration through to omnichannel communications.

You'll work closely with engineers and product to build in quality from the start, not just a manual check at the end. You’ll design and execute tests to measure the quality of our AI agents, testing for probabilistic outputs, expected reasoning behaviours, performance and overall security.


What You'll Be Doing:

● Design and own the quality strategy for our AI agent platform, including approaches to testing non-deterministic, LLM-powered systems.

● Build and maintain automated test suites covering unit, integration, API, and end-to-end scenarios across our TypeScript/Node.js/React/Python stack.

● Develop evaluation frameworks for agent behaviour, testing reasoning quality, tool use, memory, and multi-step interaction flows.

● Test and validate our omnichannel communication platform across channels: web, messaging, voice, and beyond.

● Collaborate closely with engineers and define acceptance criteria that catch issues early in the development cycle.

● Champion a culture of quality across the team, reviewing test coverage in PRs, advocating for testability in system design, and raising the bar for what "done" means.

● Use and help shape AI-assisted testing tooling to accelerate coverage and surface issues faster.


What We're Looking For:

● Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer on complex, production software products.

● Strong hands-on skills using test frameworks (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Jest).

● Experience testing APIs, backend services, and databases (PostgreSQL or similar).

● A clear understanding of how to approach testing non-deterministic systems.

● Experience designing and implementing QA strategy.

● Strong communication skills, you can articulate quality risks clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to have:

● Experience evaluating LLM or agentic systems, prompt behaviour, output quality, hallucination risks, or agent evaluation frameworks.

● Familiarity with performance, load, or chaos testing for real-time or event-driven systems.

● Background in automotive, dealership tech, or B2B SaaS.

● Exposure to AI-assisted development and testing tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code).

Why join us? We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way. An inclusive environment to thrive We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day. Be rewarded for your efforts We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration. title: Senior QARA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
🏨 L’entreprise

Resilience Care, acteur majeur de la télésurveillance médicale et partenaire de la recherche clinique, est une société française fondée en 2021 avec une mission : mieux soigner.
Notre entreprise propose des solutions de télésurveillance en oncologie, gastro-entérologie et psychiatrie, basées sur la collecte d’ePRO associées à des techniques d’IA. Elles s’appuient sur une plateforme de suivi pour les professionnels de santé, permettant une détection précoce des effets secondaires pour une prise en charge continue et anticipée, et une application mobile pour les patients, permettant de mesurer et gérer leurs symptômes grâce à des ressources adaptées.
Nos solutions permettent d’optimiser les prises en charge, d’enrichir la compréhension des patients en continu pendant leur parcours de soin et d’accélérer la recherche clinique grâce à la collecte, la structuration et l’analyse fine des données de vie réelle. Elles sont aujourd'hui déployées en routine auprès de 35 000 patients, dans plus de 200 établissements de santé, mais également dans le cadre d’une vingtaine d’études cliniques académiques et industrielles.

  • Une mission de santé à fort impact, portée par une ambition de médecine personnalisée.

title: Senior Recruiter
descriptionHtml:

  • Working knowledge of interview techniques and applicant screening methods
  • Familiar with a wide variety of sourcing avenues

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in Startup, Tech, and relevant domain experience

That means seeking to improve all aspects of our company even in ways that are not explicitly part of our job while leveling up anything you can directly impact in realtime
  • Low ego, high curiosity – Value learning over being right. Embraces delivering and receiving candid feedback, and see every setback as an opportunity to iterate and improve

Benefits

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. title: Senior SecOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior SecOps Engineer to take ownership of security operations at Flagstone. That covers everything from alert triage and incident response through to detection engineering and continuous improvement of how our SOC works.

This is a hands-on role that sits right at the operational end of security. You’ll spend real time in the alert queue, as well as building the detections and automation that make it better. You’ll be right in the middle of complex investigations and P1s, while also shaping how the function operates. You’ll also own our relationship with our managed SOC provider, setting the standards they work to rather than simply receiving their output.

About the team

You’ll sit within Security Engineering, reporting to our Security Team Leader. In this role you’ll own detection, triage and incident response, and act as the technical counterpart to our managed SOC provider. That means directing their scope, holding them to clear detection and response standards, and keeping ownership of anything escalated or high severity in house.

Does this sound like you?

You’re an engineer at heart. You’d rather write the detection than describe it, and you treat detections and automation like any other engineering work: version controlled, tested and documented. You’re the go to expert when something serious happens, and you can explain security risk just as clearly to engineers as to senior stakeholders.

You’re curious about new technology, AI included, and you have a clear view on where it genuinely helps and where it introduces risk.

What you’ll do

You’ll take ownership of our SOC operations and report on their performance and health to stakeholders across the business. You’ll run investigations and incident response for complex or high severity alerts, managing parallel workstreams, keeping stakeholders informed and running post incident reviews through to real changes in detections or process.

You’ll own the detection engineering backlog, building, tuning and retiring detections across Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, mapped to a coverage model such as MITRE ATT&CK. You’ll turn threat intelligence into detection logic and hunting activity, and drive our automation and SOAR maturity by building Logic App playbooks that reduce manual effort without losing judgement on the nuanced cases.

You’ll manage our managed SOC relationship day to day: defining scope and escalation criteria, reviewing performance against SLAs and acting as the technical escalation point for anything they can’t close. You’ll keep playbooks, escalation paths and documentation in shape so the practice scales beyond any one person, and you’ll track metrics like triage time, false positive rate and coverage gaps to drive continuous improvement.

You’ll also explore and introduce AI assisted tooling into SOC workflows, such as triage and enrichment copilots, detection authoring and alert summarisation, where it clearly makes a difference, with sensible boundaries on where human judgement stays in the loop.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in a SOC, security operations or detection engineering role, with progression into a senior IC position

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, building detections rather than just consuming alerts

  • Experience running investigations and incident response, including communicating with stakeholders under pressure

  • Experience building SOAR and automation content (for example Sentinel Logic Apps), including monitoring for silent failure

  • A strong grasp of attack patterns and MITRE ATT&CK, and how to turn them into a detection coverage model

  • Experience directing a managed or outsourced SOC or MDR provider, setting scope, SLAs and escalation criteria

  • Practical experience applying AI or LLM tooling to SecOps work

  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders

  • Critical thinking and a real curiosity for new technologies and frameworks

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience in regulated financial services

  • Exposure to identity centric detection (Entra ID) and cloud native threat detection

  • GCIH, GCFA or an equivalent hands-on IR or detection certification

  • Links to the SOC and detection engineering community, through conferences, speaking or open source detection content such as Sigma rules

How we reward you:

title: Senior Security Engineer, Application
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Security Engineer, Application for our Engineering and Technology team. You own application security for Firmus AI Cloud and the internal software that runs it. Automation is how you scale that ownership. Customers provision GPU compute through API and console, software engineers build against it, and our operators run the platform through the same control plane. You own the security of that software: the public APIs, the services behind them, how tenants stay separated inside the application, and the AI assistants and agents we ship on top. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Automation and secure delivery 

  • Own the CI/CD security gates that every production repository passes through: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, and SBOM generation. 
  • Build the systems that do the repeatable work: finding triage, dependency uplift, evidence collection, and draft threat models.  
  • Ship the secure paved roads other teams build on: reusable libraries, service templates, and developer tooling. 
  • Write and review code in the services you protect, including the security-critical paths that tools miss. 

Security architecture and standards 

  • Set the application security standard and control for authentication, authorisation between services, tenant isolation at the application boundary, secret handling and logging. 
  • Lead threat modelling and secure design review. Define what an attacker can do and what must be true before it ships. 
  • Set the security requirements for the AI assistants and agents we ship e.g. prompt injection, context poisoning. 
  • Govern which tools and tool servers our AI agents and software engineers may reach, and how those integrations are scoped, allow-listed, and audited. 

Assurance and vulnerability management 

  • Own application security posture across our services: what is covered, what is open, what is accepted with a named owner and an expiry, and what is overdue. 
  • Prioritise fixes on exploitability and exposure alongside CVSS and hold them to the Firmus vulnerability SLAs. 
  • Drive remediation with the teams that own the code so issues close at the source. 
  • Extend SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the software delivery path as services and sites grow. Evidence that a control ran should be a query, not a spreadsheet exercise. 

Enablement and escalation 

  • Coach security champions inside each team so secure design decisions get made without waiting for you. 
  • Provide application-security expertise during incidents and convert recurring failure modes into gates, tests, standards, or developer tooling. 
  • Give engineering leadership a straight read on application risk and release readiness. Join customer conversations when the question is application security. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field. 
  • 7+ years in application security, product security, or software engineering with a security focus. 
  • Experience securing a public cloud or multi-tenant platform with a public API. 
  • Deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP API Security Top 10. Has threat modelled multi-tenant APIs in production: identity, authorisation between services, tenant isolation, and the ways a client abuses a published contract using STRIDE or an equivalent method, both for REST and gRPC. 
  • Has improved the security posture of software built by other engineering teams through standards, tooling, review, or secure-by-default patterns. 
  • Has owned CI/CD security gates in production (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, SBOM) and tuned them to deliver actionable findings with low false-positive rates that engineers trusted and acted upon. 
  • Writes production-quality code in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript. 
  • Has replaced manual security work with automation: finding triage, dependency uplift, evidence collection, or regression tests that run without someone watching them. 
  • Hands-on with LLM-backed or agentic features: prompt injection, tool misuse, agent identity and delegated credentials, cross-tenant data leakage, and controls on generated code reaching production. Familiar with OWASP guidance for LLM and agentic applications. 
  • Deep practical experience with OAuth, OIDC, JWT, RBAC or ABAC, application-layer cryptography, token handling, and secrets in software. 
  • Has worked under SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001 and can produce evidence that a control ran. 
  • Willing to join incident response for application and API security. 
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it. 
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English 

Bonus Points 

  • Experience securing AI agents, sandboxed code execution environments, or systems where AI-generated output can trigger automated actions. 
  • Has run a vulnerability disclosure programme. 
  • Security certifications with application-security depth, such as CSSLP or OSWE. 

LOCATION 

Singapore or Australia

title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself.

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the role include:

Deliver

  • Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

  • Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

  • Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

  • Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

  • Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

  • Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

  • Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

  • Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

Collaborate

  • Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

  • Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

  • Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

  • Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes


Job Requirements

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell or similar, including working with APIs

Technical Competencies

  • SOAR development, including automation and playbook design using platforms such as Palo Alto XSOAR or similar

  • Scripting and integration using Python, PowerShell or similar, including API-driven automation

Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. About the role:

Upvest is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to raise the bar on how we build, run and recover our systems. Our platform sits in the critical path for our clients and their end customers and as we scale reliability and availability become more crucial.

In the near term, you’ll focus on three things: eliminating toil, improving incident management and observability. That means establishing the standards through automation and guardrails that make good engineering the default, turning our incident process into a robust and effective practice, and giving every team the telemetry to see what their services are doing in production.

Over time, your scope grows into resilience architecture, chaos engineering and disaster preparedness - making sure our systems degrade gracefully and that we find weaknesses before our clients do.

You’ll work closely with product engineering teams, embedding SRE practices into how they design, ship and operate, and mentoring engineers along the way. If you like the idea of setting technical direction for reliability across an organisation, and you measure your success by how rarely anyone has to think about you at 2am, this is the role for you.

  • Stress at Scale: validate system behavior under synthetic load and adversarial conditions, proving our defenses work to improve disaster preparedness.

What you bring:

  • Leadership: proven ability to mentor engineers, see projects through end-to-end and set technical direction in an engineering organisation.

It’s great if you have:

How we Upvest in you:

Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Compensation: £95K – £120K • Offers Equity

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Climate Matters More Than Ever

Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.

Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.

The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.

The Opportunity

Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.

You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.

Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.

Things We ❤️

  • Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.
  • Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.
  • Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.

  • Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.

  • Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.

  • Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.

  • Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.
  • Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.

You Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.

  • Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.
  • Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.
  • Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.

Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.

How We Work

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
  • Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.
  • Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.
  • Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
  • Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
  • Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
  • Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
  • Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.
  • A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.
  • Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.
  • An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.
  • The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.
  • A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.

Next steps

What to expect from our hiring process:

  1. Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role.
  2. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.
  3. Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space.
  4. Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

Please submit your up-to-date resume in English. 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) at Checkout.com, you will manage a portfolio drawn from our largest and most strategic enterprise merchants. TAM coverage is reserved for a select group of accounts, and you will work on them alongside our Account Management (AM) team. You will be responsible for the technical relationship, and together with the AM you will grow and maintain every account in the portfolio. You do that by unlocking the technical elements, removing friction from our technical products and, most importantly, making sure each customer has the best possible payment performance and technical health, so the commercial relationship can grow.

What you'll be doing:

  • Customer Partnership: Be the primary technical point of contact for the merchants in your portfolio. Build trusted relationships with their technical and product teams and run the technical part of quarterly business reviews, while the AM owns the commercial relationship and pricing.

  • Payment Performance: Monitor acceptance rates, decline patterns and authentication results across your portfolio, find what is costing merchants approvals and fix it.

  • Technical Consultancy: Root-cause decline spikes, integration errors and configuration problems using log monitoring and data querying tools, and see them through to resolution. Collaborate with issuers, card schemes and our internal teams that manage those relationships to resolve systemic issues.

  • Product Adoption: Lead the rollout of new products, payment methods and technical migrations as merchants expand with Checkout.com.

  • Account Growth: Spot growth opportunities in your merchants' roadmaps and collaborate with the AM on the best way to position new products and solutions. Strengthen upsell conversations with demos, workshops and technical training on new features.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with many teams across Checkout.com, including Product and Engineering, to translate merchant requirements into clear action items that deliver better outcomes for the customer, such as improved payment performance.

Qualifications

  • 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, managing internal and external stakeholders up to senior level.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex and unfamiliar technical issues independently and drive them to resolution.

  • Comfortable with core technical concepts, such as APIs and how front-end and back-end systems work together, and able to explain them clearly when advising merchants.

  • Strong data literacy, with the ability to use query tools and AI to analyse data, extract insights and turn them into improvements.

  • Experience with data querying and logging tools such as Datadog and BigQuery.

  • Comfortable using AI tools and agents in your day-to-day work to investigate issues faster, automate repetitive tasks and scale your impact.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to client sites as required.

  • Experience in payments or SaaS (software as a service) is a plus.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

title: Senior Stack Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

title: Senior Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Senior Strategist 

Company: VML
Working Model: Hybrid working
Location: Sea Containers office, London, SE1

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our three core practices: Brand Experience, Customer Experience and Commerce. Within these practices, we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

The Role

As a Senior Strategist, you'll be an important strategic voice within the team, working closely with Client Services, Creative, Data, Media and other specialist disciplines to turn business and customer challenges into clear, effective solutions.

You'll work on one of our major Pan-European automotive accounts, helping develop strategy across the customer journey — from brand consideration and lead generation through to lifecycle CRM, digital experiences and retail activations.

You'll be involved from brief through to delivery, using customer understanding, data, research and cultural insight to develop strong strategic thinking and give creative teams a clear direction. You'll also help ensure the work remains connected to the client's wider commercial objectives.

This is a hands-on role, with the opportunity to take ownership of projects and workstreams while working closely with senior members of the strategy team. You'll have regular exposure to clients and will be expected to build trusted relationships, present your thinking confidently and contribute to conversations with stakeholders at different levels.

There will also be opportunities to contribute to wider strategic projects, proactive thinking and new business, giving you the chance to bring your perspective to different challenges and develop your experience across the agency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic thinking across projects and workstreams, from understanding the brief through to creative development, client sell-in and measuring effectiveness.
  • Turn business, customer, cultural and behavioural information into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Develop compelling strategic and creative briefs that give creative teams a clear direction and space to do their best work across CRM, digital, social, search and dealership assets.
  • Support end-to-end CRM communications across Passenger and Commercial Vehicles, including automated and triggered reminders, such as maintenance, MOT and servicing, seasonal promotional campaigns and ad-hoc owner messaging.
  • Develop consideration and conversion activations for individual vehicle nameplates across UK and European markets, ensuring communications ladder seamlessly into wider global brand positioning.
  • Contribute to the development of digital servicing journeys, helping increase consideration for official servicing through effective content and customer experience.
  • Apply an understanding of modern search behaviour, including Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and LLM-ready content, to relevant communications and digital experiences.
  • Work closely with Client Services, Creative, Data and Media partners to develop connected and effective solutions.
  • Build strong working relationships with clients and become a trusted and credible strategic partner.
  • Present strategic thinking and recommendations clearly and confidently to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Use data, research and customer understanding to inform recommendations and strengthen the work.
  • Challenge briefs and thinking constructively when there is an opportunity to make the work better.
  • Contribute to pitches, proactive strategic projects, quarterly thought leadership and opportunities to grow existing and new client relationships.
  • Support more junior members of the strategy team, sharing knowledge and helping raise the quality of strategic output.
  • Bring curiosity and new thinking into the team, keeping up with changes in culture, technology, customer behaviour and the wider industry.

Who You Are

  • Strategically strong: You can get to the heart of a problem, identify what really matters and turn it into a clear point of view.
  • Commercially minded: You understand how strategic thinking connects to client business objectives, customer acquisition, lead generation and long-term retention.
  • Confident but collaborative: You're comfortable presenting your thinking and contributing to senior conversations, while being open to challenge and different perspectives.
  • A strong communicator: You can make complex thinking feel simple, whether you're presenting to a client or briefing a creative team.
  • Customer curious: You genuinely want to understand what makes people tick and how behaviours, needs and motivations can influence the work.
  • Low ego: You care more about getting to the right answer than getting credit for having it. You enjoy working with different people and bringing the best out of those around you.
  • Adaptable: You can move comfortably between different types of briefs, from brand and communications strategy to CRM journeys, digital experiences and retail activation.
  • Culturally and technologically curious: You're interested in what's happening in the world and know how to turn those observations into useful strategic thinking. You're also interested in emerging technology, AI, LLMs and evolving search behaviours.
  • A team player: You enjoy working alongside Client Services, Creative and specialist teams and understand that the best work rarely comes from one person working alone.

What You'll Need

  • Proven experience working as a Strategist or Senior Strategist within an agency environment. Automotive, mobility or Pan-European client experience would be a strong advantage.
  • Experience developing strategic thinking from brief through to creative development and delivery.
  • Strong understanding of customer behaviour, customer journeys and how different communications and experiences work together.
  • Experience across some combination of brand, communications, CRM/lifecycle marketing, digital, social, search or customer experience.
  • Confidence presenting strategic thinking and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • The ability to interpret data and research and turn it into meaningful insight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and compelling.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Creative, Client Services, Data, Media or other specialist teams.
  • Experience contributing to pitches and/or proactive strategic projects would be beneficial.
  • Experience supporting or mentoring more junior team members would be advantageous.
  • An understanding of modern search trends, AI, LLMs and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) would be beneficial.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic thinking that is clear, compelling and rooted in genuine customer and business insight.
  • Work that gives creative teams a strong strategic foundation and a clear opportunity to respond to.
  • Clients who value your thinking and see you as a trusted strategic partner.
  • Strong collaboration across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist teams.
  • Strategic recommendations that contribute to meaningful client and business outcomes.
  • The ability to take ownership of projects and move them forward with confidence.
  • A positive contribution to the development and quality of the wider strategy team.
  • Bringing clarity, curiosity and momentum to complex challenges.

What's in It for You?

  • The opportunity to work on high-profile clients and commercially meaningful challenges.
  • The chance to work alongside talented people across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist disciplines.
  • A genuinely collaborative environment where different perspectives are encouraged.
  • The opportunity to work across a broad range of strategic challenges and develop your experience.
  • A culture that values good thinking, curiosity, collaboration and people who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Strong learning, development and career progression opportunities.
  • A competitive package, hybrid working and access to the full suite of company and group benefits.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. title: (Senior) Supply Chain Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Every RELEX implementation is a solution built from scratch for one customer: their processes, their data, their targets. (Senior) Supply Chain Consultants shape both sides of that build — the business processes and KPIs the customer will run on, and the configuration that makes them work in the system. Depending on your background you will lean more towards one side than the other. This is a heavily customer-facing role.

What you'll be doing

  • Understand how the customer really plans. Prepare, facilitate and document workshops to gather and specify business requirements, and run the data analysis that shows where the strengths and the gaps actually are.
  • Design the target picture — planning processes, roles and the KPIs the project is measured on — and guide customers towards RELEX best practice, including where their current way of working needs to change.
  • Build it. Configuration, business rules, workflows and reporting that deliver the design you just agreed, and that hold up in operation: nightly run performance, scalability and maintainability, not just functional correctness.
  • Make the value case tangible for customer leadership: define how forecast accuracy, availability, inventory and cost will be measured, and report honestly on where we stand.
  • Take it live. Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, resolve what testing surfaces, and upskill super users so the customer is proficient and self-sustaining after go-live.
  • Own adoption, not just delivery. A technically correct solution that nobody uses is not a successful project.
  • Document what you built — requirements, scope and configuration — so the project team, the customer and our Continuous Services colleagues can work with it after handover.
  • Work across disciplines: with Technical Consultants on the data model, interfaces and the customer's ERP landscape, and with Project Managers on scope, effort and timelines.

Within RELEX

  • Challenge and develop implementation best practice across industries (grocery, DIY, home goods, pharma, wholesale and more)
  • Share knowledge with the team as both a trainer and a participant, and support colleagues who are earlier in their journey
  • Work with our global teams on international projects and bring practices between regions
  • Use AI tooling actively in your daily work — we expect curiosity here and give you room to experiment

What we're looking for

  • Around 2+ years of relevant experience in supply chain or retail planning, demand and inventory planning, or in implementing / consulting on planning software. A degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, mathematics or computer science is a good foundation — but we care more about what you have actually done.
  • Structured thinking and comfort with ambiguity. Many customer requirements arrive without a ready-made answer. You break them down, work with data, and arrive at a defensible recommendation.
  • Communication that works across levels — from super users in a training room to senior stakeholders in a steering committee, including the conversations where the message is not what the customer hoped to hear.
  • Business-fluent German and English. Both are used daily.
  • Willingness to travel depending on the project phase.
  • Technical affinity: SQL, scripting, or an interest to pick these up

Additionally, for the Senior level:

  • Several years of consulting or implementation experience, including demonstrable ownership of a workstream or a smaller project end-to-end — scope, risk, timeline and completion, not just your own tasks
  • Reliable effort estimation for standard and custom requirements, supporting scoping and SOW discussions
  • Experience coaching and mentoring less experienced colleagues
  • Confidence in front of senior customer stakeholders, including steering committees
  • Hands-on experience with a supply chain planning system, either as a user or as an implementer
  • Experience defining and tracking KPIs or building a value case

Who we are

We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. 

  • Flexibility in how and where you work
  • Room to thrivein a fast-growing global company with a good market position
  • Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life
  • Annual leave
  • Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture
  • Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability
  • Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies
  • Two paid volunteering days each year

We are a global community of different cultures, voices, and experiences. We celebrate what makes us unique and connect through what we share, in an authentic and safe environment. Together we shape the future, and each other. 

If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your resume through the application form as soon as possible. Please note that we cannot process any applications through email.     

Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, GPU Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Systems Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We offer competitive salaries ranging from $170k-$300k + equity based on your experience.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

#LI-LH2

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Okta: The World’s Identity Company™

About Okta & The TAM Team

Okta is the leader in Identity management and The World’s Identity Company™. Our mission is to build a more secure world by providing a neutral, powerful, and extensible platform that puts identity at the heart of the modern tech stack—securing customers, employees, partners, and AI agents. Two-thirds of the Fortune 100 trust Okta to power their identity journeys.

The Technical Account Management (TAM) team is a global group of Okta product experts dedicated to driving long-term customer success. As a Senior TAM within our Strategic Workforce Identity segment, you will serve as the premier technical advisor and advocate for some of our largest enterprise customers (across Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector, and more), helping them elevate their technical maturity and maximize their Okta investment.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Strategic Customer Partnership & Influence

  • Trusted Advisor: Build deep, executive-level relationships, serving as the primary technical point of contact for customer identity owners and IT leadership (up to CxO).
  • Strategic Roadmapping: Architect tailored technical success plans aligned with customer business objectives to drive platform adoption and secure Okta against competitive displacement.
  • Adoption & Expansion: Guide customers in expanding their Okta footprint across critical Workforce solutions, continuously improving their overall security posture.

2. Complex Problem Resolution & Advocacy

  • Technical Escalation Lead: Independently manage and resolve highly complex customer technical escalations, collaborating with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) as needed.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical roadblocks, design robust mitigation plans, and drive them to resolution.
  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Champion customer needs internally by collaborating with Okta Engineering, Product, and Support teams to influence product direction.

3. Thought Leadership & Team Enablement

  • Knowledge Sharing: Deliver workshops, best practice sessions, and vertical-specific insights to enhance customer security.
  • Asset Creation: Author repeatable technical strategies and assets to level up the global TAM organization.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and develop peer TAMs to upskill technical capabilities across the team.

Workforce Identity Solutions You Will Support

You will provide deep technical guidance across Okta's comprehensive Workforce Identity lifecycle:

  • IAM: SSO, Adaptive MFA, Device Access, API Access Management, Secure Partner Access, Access Gateway, and Universal Directory.
  • IGA: Lifecycle Management and Okta Identity Governance (OIG).
  • PAM: Privileged Access Management.
  • ITDR: Identity Security Posture Management and Identity Threat Protection.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience & Education

  • 8+ years of related professional IT experience (or 6+ years with a Master’s degree).
  • 3+ years of experience as a TAM, Technical Consultant, Solution Architect, or Product Manager.
  • 3+ years of experience working with Identity & Access Management (IAM) solutions or related security technologies is preferred.
  • Education: BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • Certifications: Okta Certified, CISSP, or equivalent certifications are highly preferred.

Technical Mastery (Workforce Identity Focus)

  • Okta Architecture: Extensive hands-on proficiency mapping Okta feature sets to complex enterprise architectures.
  • Federation Protocols: Strong understanding of modern identity protocols (SAML 2.0, OAuth, OpenID Connect, WS-Fed).
  • Hybrid Environments: Experience integrating legacy/non-standard applications that do not support modern federation protocols.
  • Lifecycle & Provisioning: Deep knowledge of lifecycle management, automated provisioning, and integrations (e.g., SCIM, Okta Workflows, HR-driven provisioning, Active Directory).
  • SaaS Ecosystems: Familiarity deploying and securing key SaaS platforms (O365, Salesforce, Workday, Box).
  • Code Proficiency: Ability to read and modify existing quickstarts, code samples, or scripts to match customer requirements.

Communication & Leadership

  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to translate highly technical concepts into clear business outcomes for CxO-level audiences.
  • Boundary Setting: Skilled at managing expectations, tracking portfolio health metrics, and setting healthy boundaries with internal and external stakeholders.

Location & Language Requirements: This is a hybrid role, open to candidates based in London, Munich, Paris, or Warsaw. Fluency in both German and English is mandatory.
