title: Talent Partner
descriptionHtml:
Build the team that builds Conveo. As our London Talent Partner, you'll source and close top talent across the UK, US and Belgium as we scale past 100 people.

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We're scaling past 100 people and delivering our 2027 hiring plan. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We're investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

What We’re Building

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer and B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Canva use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

The Role

As Talent Partner at Conveo, you will build the team that builds the company. You'll join a small, lean talent team and play a big part in how we scale. You'll play a key part in how Conveo attracts, assesses, and ultimately hires talent across the US, UK, and Belgium, helping us scale past 100 people and deliver our 2027 hiring plan.

You'll close exceptional talent across engineering, product, go-to-market, and operations, while contributing to hiring strategy and talent decisions. You won't be limited to one area. You'll work with stakeholders and leadership across departments. If your experience leans towards one area, such as product and engineering, go-to-market, or operations, that's fine. We're open to candidates with a variety of backgrounds.

This isn't a transactional recruiting role. You'll shape how candidates experience Conveo and help build a team with high talent density for the long term. Proactive sourcing and strong execution will be central to your success.

Talent operations plays a small part in this role. Lots of foundations are already in place, and you'll help build on them as we scale. If you like to experiment and work with the latest tech, especially AI, you'll find this role really interesting.

We're growing fast, so priorities shift and you'll often make calls with imperfect information.

What You’ll Do

Own hiring outcomes end-to-end

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and leadership

  • Own roles from kickoff to close, including sourcing and closing

  • Maintain speed without sacrificing quality

  • Develop strong hiring judgment

Build proactive talent pipelines

  • Develop centralised talent pipelines across key disciplines, enabling the business to take a broader and more proactive approach to hiring

  • Create innovative sourcing strategies for particular searches, incorporating AI-enabled sourcing, targeted outbound campaigns, market mapping, events, and external communities

  • Proactively source top-tier talent using LinkedIn, Juicebox, and other tools. Our toolkit isn't fixed. We're always looking at new tools, and deciding whether to build them internally or use them externally, to level up our sourcing and recruitment capabilities.

  • Provide external talent intelligence, including candidate availability, competitor activity, compensation, and wider market trends

Build a high-signal candidate experience

  • Be the main point of contact and advocate for candidates

  • Every candidate hears back from us quickly, whether it's a yes or a no.

  • Pitch Conveo with real conviction, because you understand the product, the market and why people join.

Grow our employer brand

  • Contribute to employer branding content that shows what it's like to work at Conveo

  • Support events that put Conveo in front of top talent

Build scalable hiring and people systems

  • Improve interview loops, scorecards, and decision-making

  • Track funnel health

  • Maintain clean hiring and people data in Ashby (our ATS) and internal tools

  • Build repeatable playbooks and templates

What Success Looks Like

  • Hiring managers see you as a true partner and want you on their searches: you've added key players to their teams quickly and efficiently.

  • Hires that work out: you bring in the right people, and we can see who was hired and why they did well in the organisation.

  • Ownership of our hiring goals: you understand the hiring plan and your contribution to it. When blockers come up, you flag them and proactively work to fix them so we hit our goals.

  • Gaps found and closed: you work autonomously, but take time early on to understand what gaps exist and why, then work with the team to close them.

  • Better decisions over time: you make decisions in the moment with the best information available, even when the data isn't perfect, and push to gather more data so future decisions are better informed.

  • A better way of doing things: you challenge the status quo when something could be done in a way that's better for the business, drawing on your experience and backing it up with data and resources.

Your First 3 Months

  • You've taken ownership of a set of live roles and closed your first few hires.

  • You've built a pipeline for our hardest-to-hire discipline, so we're ahead of demand, not chasing it.

  • Hiring managers trust you as a partner and come to you early when they're planning hires.

What You’ll Bring

You're truth first, not fluff first: opinionated and thoughtful, with high standards and low ego. You're structured, fast, and iterative, and you build things once and make them reusable. You'll also bring:

  • Minimum 4 years of recruiting or high-performance hiring experience across in-house teams, startups, scale-ups, or agencies

  • Excellent proactive sourcing, headhunting, and market-mapping skills, with the ability to engage high-performing passive candidates who aren't actively seeking a move

  • Strong execution and high ownership: you run several roles and priorities at once, keep every process moving without dropped steps, and follow through on what you commit to

  • A good understanding of recruitment analytics and the ability to use data to influence hiring strategy and improve performance

  • Practical experience using AI and modern recruitment technology to improve sourcing, personalisation, market intelligence, and recruitment efficiency

  • Experience partnering closely with senior leaders, and the ability to build credibility with highly senior stakeholders

  • A builder mentality and a genuine interest in tech, AI, and the startup community. You enjoy identifying problems, improving processes, and creating better ways of working rather than simply operating within an existing recruitment model.

Why Join Us?

  • Build the team for a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

  • Work directly with founders and strong operators. At our size, every hire you make visibly shapes the company.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Based in our London office 3 days a week. We also have offices in Antwerp and New York.

  • Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more

  • Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to: Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal

  • Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

  • Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

  • Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000

title: Talent Partner - Manufacturing and Industrial
descriptionHtml:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

We're scaling incredibly fast, and our manufacturing capability is central to our future. As our Talent Partner, you'll be focused on hiring workers across the manufacturing lifecycle.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and nurture talent pools across the manufacturing space, such as facilities managers and factory technicians, to ensure consistent delivery across high-volume pipelines.

  • Build a robust employer brand, enabling microagi to be known as a competitive employer in an emerging industrial startup ecosystem.

  • Advise the team on best practices for building out and scaling manufacturing recruiting.

  • Plan and attend industry events to further our market presence amongst the best manufacturing talent.

Requirements

  • 5+ year track record in high-volume blue-collar manufacturing hiring in innovative manufacturing environments

  • Deep network within European manufacturing and industrial talent pools

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

We’re growing fast, and we don’t post everything.

Over the next year we’re hiring across silicon, hardware test, manufacturing operations, device software, compilers, performance simulation and the teams that keep all of it running. Some of those roles are live on this page. Plenty aren’t yet.

If you’ve read what we’re building and want to work on it, send us your details. Tell us which area interests you and what you’ve worked on that’s relevant. We’ll come back to you when something fits.

This isn’t a formality. We read these, and several of our team joined this way.

title: Team Lead - Invoices
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product.

This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important:

  • Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale.

  • Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised.

  • Turn the team into an empowered product team. Today, a lot of work still arrives as requests through proxies. You lead the shift toward a team that owns its problem space, defines outcomes, measures them, and decides what to build.

As Engineering Team Lead for Invoices, you lead the team that owns BLP's invoice product: You own the team's roadmap, delivery, people, and hiring.

This job is for you if you want to lead a strong engineering team through its next phase of growth and own the result.

You report to the Director of Product Engineering and work closely with the other product team leads, product management, and the go-to-market organization (project managers, customer success, and sales). The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned.

What you'll do

Lead and grow the team

  • Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership.

  • Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows.

  • Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early.

Hire

  • Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition.

  • Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy.

Own the roadmap and priorities

  • Build the quarterly roadmap and run monthly planning with product owners and product management, prioritizing by customer impact, revenue, and strategic value.

  • Balance enterprise go-lives, automation improvements, platform migration, developer experience, operations, and new products, and say no when something does not move the product forward.

  • Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization.

Deliver for strategic enterprise customers

  • Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness.

  • Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates.

  • Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case.

What you'll bring

  • You have led an engineering team of 8+ people for at least two years, ideally in B2B SaaS, and you have grown a team through hiring rather than only inheriting one.

  • You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers.

  • You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process.

  • You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders.

  • You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship.

  • You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads.

  • You take ownership, surface problems early, ask for help when you are stuck, and hold your team to the same standard.

  • You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, since many of our customers and colleagues are in the DACH region.

What you'll get

  • A real mandate. You own the invoice team end to end: people, hiring, roadmap, and delivery.

  • Impact you can measure. Automation rates and go-lives on our largest accounts are directly visible to customers and to the business.

  • A strong team. Engineers from serious academic and industry backgrounds who care about doing the work well, with subteam leads already in place.

  • A smooth handover. The current team lead moves into a new role in engineering leadership and stays available to support your start.

  • Room to grow. As a fast-growing, global AI company, BLP keeps creating new leadership opportunities.

title: Team Lead, SEO & GEO (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by making it easier for customers around the world to discover, plan, and enjoy high-quality meals. Over the past decade, we’ve grown from a meal-kit company into a global food solutions group, active across multiple brands including HelloFresh, Factor, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chef’s Plate, and Youfoodz.

As search behavior evolves across Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Reddit, and other discovery surfaces, our SEO team is expanding its focus from traditional organic search to broader Organic Discovery: building the content, technical, authority, and measurement foundations that help customers find our brands wherever discovery and dinner decisions happen.

We are looking for a Team Lead, SEO & GEO to lead our global Organic Discovery team and help shape the next phase of how HelloFresh Group approaches organic growth. This role will lead a team of SEO/GEO specialists and work across international markets to translate global strategy into scalable programs that grow non-brand organic demand, strengthen our visibility across traditional and AI-driven search, and improve the quality and discoverability of our content.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Content, Brand, and local Marketing teams to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact work, and build scalable solutions across brands and markets. You’ll need to be equally comfortable setting strategy, coaching a team, digging into performance data, and influencing senior stakeholders to move complex initiatives forward.

 

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of SEO/GEO specialists, setting clear priorities and creating an environment of strong ownership, collaboration, and continuous development.
  • Help define and execute the global SEO & GEO strategy across HelloFresh Group brands and markets, translating broader Organic Discovery priorities into actionable roadmaps.
  • Identify opportunities to grow non-brand organic demand and customer acquisition across traditional search engines, AI search experiences, and emerging discovery platforms.
  • Partner with local Marketing teams to understand market-specific opportunities and challenges while building global strategies, standards, and solutions that can scale across markets.
  • Lead cross-functional Organic Discovery initiatives spanning technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimization, structured data, internal linking, authority and trust signals, and GEO/AI visibility.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate SEO/GEO opportunities into clear requirements, influence roadmap prioritization, and ensure Organic Discovery is considered in all major product and platform decisions.
  • Develop scalable approaches to content creation, optimization, and governance across recipe, editorial, transactional, and other high-value organic surfaces.
  • Advance our GEO strategy by identifying how our brands can become more visible, cited, and authoritative across AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Use search, analytics, AI visibility, competitive, and internal business data to identify opportunities, diagnose performance changes, prioritize investments, and measure impact.
  • Establish clear performance reporting and communicate SEO/GEO performance, opportunities, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Support global and local teams with SEO/GEO expertise, creating frameworks and best practices that enable markets to move quickly without sacrificing quality or consistency.
  • Manage relationships with relevant agencies, technology partners, and vendors where appropriate, ensuring external resources are aligned to our strategy and delivering measurable value.
  • Stay ahead of changes in search behavior, search engine platforms, generative AI, and the broader discovery ecosystem, translating emerging trends into practical implications for HelloFresh Group.

 

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of experience in SEO / Organic Growth, ideally within large-scale, international, consumer-facing websites.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing SEO or Organic Growth teams, with the ability to balance people leadership with hands-on strategic involvement.
  • Broad SEO expertise spanning technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimization, authority, international SEO, and performance measurement.
  • Strong understanding of how AI-powered search and answer engines are changing organic discovery, with curiosity and practical experience applying GEO/AEO principles.
  • Experience developing strategies and roadmaps across multiple markets, brands, or business units and balancing global scalability with local-market needs.
  • Strong ability to partner with Product and Engineering teams, translate organic growth opportunities into clear requirements, and influence prioritization without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using platforms such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Profound, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO, analytics, and AI-visibility tools.
  • Ability to connect SEO/GEO performance to broader business outcomes and clearly communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience navigating complex, cross-functional organizations.
  • High ownership, strong judgment, and comfort operating in an evolving environment where priorities, technologies, and customer discovery behaviors are changing quickly.

 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, and wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill. HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

 

Are you up for the challenge?

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

title: Tech Lead Google Cloud - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Nous cherchons en urgence un Tech Lead expert Google Cloud pour reprendre les sujets d'avant-vente et d'architecture (SA) et devenir le champion GCP du groupe Theodo.

Theodo Data & AI accompagne ses clients sur des projets data et IA de bout en bout : plateformes data, migrations cloud, GenAI et architectures agentiques. Les deals Data/AI ont des spécificités fortes (stacks data, use cases orientés ML) qui demandent une vraie crédibilité technique face aux DSI, CTO et CDO.

Missions

  • Avant-vente / Solution Architecture : qualifier techniquement les leads entrants, recueillir les exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles, concevoir la stratégie technique des deals
  • Conception d'architectures GCP : définir des architectures adaptées sur la stack Google Cloud (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Composer, Vertex AI, GKE, Cloud Run, IAM…) en s'appuyant sur les bonnes pratiques et les contraintes client
  • Audit de l'existant : analyser les architectures data/IA et modèles de données existants, proposer une stratégie technique (migration, modernisation, optimisation FinOps)
  • Estimations & pricing : construire une approche technique et un chiffrage cohérents pour maximiser les chances de succès du deal
  • Soutenance : défendre les propositions face à des interlocuteurs métier, DSI et directions data exigeantes
  • Champion GCP : porter l'expertise Google Cloud au sein du groupe — veille, standards, bonnes pratiques, montée en compétence des équipes, relation avec l'écosystème Google
  • Passation delivery : accompagner les kickoffs et aligner les équipes de delivery avec la stratégie définie

Profil recherché

  • 5+ ans d'expérience, dont un rôle au-delà de dev (Tech Lead / Architecte / Staff Engineer)
  • Maîtrise parfaite de la stack GCP — certifications Google Cloud (Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer) fortement appréciées
  • Expertise data (plateformes, architectures, modélisation, migrations) et/ou IA (ML classique, GenAI, architectures agentiques)
  • Expérience en interface client : capacité à créer de la confiance, vulgariser, challenger et re-framer un client sur sa stratégie technique
  • Expérience dans le service / conseil appréciée

title: Tech Ops Lead
descriptionHtml:
Hozah makes parking automatic. Our cameras recognise your car when you arrive and payment happens by itself when you leave. No apps, no tickets. We were named PayTech Company of the Year, we sit in Deloitte’s list of the 50 fastest growing tech companies in the UK, and we are expanding our estate of automated car parks across the country.

Every site runs on ANPR cameras, payment kiosks, edge devices and 4G connectivity, and all of it has to work around the clock. The TechOps team keeps that estate healthy. We are hiring the person to lead it.

The Role

This is a player-manager role, split roughly 50:50.

Half your week is leading our TechOps engineers: running 1:1s, setting standards, managing KPIs, coaching, and owning the service desk. You decide how technical problems get diagnosed and resolved at Hozah, and you hold the team to that standard.

The other half is hands-on engineering. When a client reports that revenue at a site has dropped 40% while every device shows healthy, you dig into the data, query the database, test the APIs and work out whether it is a bug, a misconfiguration or a camera problem. The systems are built in house, so there is no vendor to escalate to. TechOps own it through to resolution whether the problem lies in hardware, software or config and the fix is yours or a developer's. The software side is similar to L3 application support.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading the service desk and developing a small team of TechOps engineers.

  • Personally investigating the hardest faults across cameras, networks, kiosks and our backend platform.

  • Using SQL, API testing and log analysis to get to the root cause of operational problems.

  • Improving monitoring and alerting so we catch degradation before it becomes an incident.

  • Technically assisting on new site launches: network design, hardware spec and commissioning.

  • Working closely with our Estate Manager, our developers and the COO to improve the estate week on week.

What we’re looking for

  • You manage a technical team today, or have very recently: real direct reports and real performance conversations, while staying hands-on yourself.

  • You have run a busy operation with high ticket volumes, multiple sites and live incidents, and kept on top of it.

  • You are an adept service desk manager: you know what to prioritise, when and what to escalate, and how to direct the team’s workflow so the queue keeps moving.

  • Your instinct is to investigate first: querying data, testing APIs, reading logs. L3 application support backgrounds fit this role well.

  • You have solid networking fundamentals (IP addressing, DNS, VPNs). Deep enterprise networking not needed.

  • You stay calm during live incidents and organised when several things need attention at once.

What this role isn’t

  • Corporate IT support. The users of our systems are cameras and cars, and the work is operating a distributed technology estate.

  • A pure management job. Half the week is engineering work, and we want someone who likes it that way.

  • Heavily process-bound. We are a scale-up, so you will build the processes we need as we grow.

Salary, location and working pattern

  • £50-60k depending on experience.

  • 3 days a week in our Croydon office, 2 days from home, with occasional site visits around the UK.

  • You report directly to the COO and own the new TechOps function.

As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from the first design conversation to running it in production, and you’ll build it with AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.

Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.

What you’ll do

  • Set the technical direction for your team: be accountable for the solution designs and architecture decisions, work with your team on technical strategy, and assist them through ambiguity over the longer term.

  • Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

  • Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

  • Own the health of your services: SLOs and SLAs, operational health reviews, post-mortems, and the in-hours support rota, with your turn on the on-call rota alongside the team.

  • Coach the engineers around you: technical guidance for a mix of junior and senior engineers, pairing, and code review that teaches as well as gates.

  • Connect your team to the rest of Kaluza: work with other Tech Leads and Principal Engineers on the wider architecture, and represent your team where platform decisions and engineering standards are made.

What you’ll bring

These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our best tech leads and value deeply, but we don’t expect everyone to tick every single box. If you’re excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience with our tech stack: TypeScript and React, utilising GraphQL and Kafka, backed by AWS and Terraform.

  • Experience leading technical change: you’ve taken a new service or a major architecture change from idea through to running in production, and you can say what you’d do differently.

  • A daily agentic development practice: you build with tools like Claude Code or Cursor, you can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way, and you have views on where agents help a team and where they get in the way.

  • Operational ownership: comfortable deploying with shared tooling, well-versed in SRE fundamentals like SLOs, disaster recovery and platform health monitoring, and used to owning your software in production, including out-of-hours on-call.

  • A coach’s instincts: you’ve mentored and grown engineers at different levels, and you make the people around you better.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to action: you can deliver against a technical strategy iteratively over months, and you’d rather ship a sound first step than wait for certainty.

  • Strong product sense: you ask why before building, and you can point to times when user feedback or metrics changed what you shipped.

  • Clear communication, especially in writing: designs, specs, PR descriptions and post-mortems that a teammate, a stakeholder or an agent can act on, and the stakeholder skills to work well with Product Managers, Principal Engineers and other Tech Leads.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Transactional Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

The Transactional Financial Controller owns the full Accounts Payable, Billing function, Credit control, working capital management, and banking operations across the group, while also leading the ongoing automation and optimisation of the finance systems that underpin transactional finance. This is a hybrid role based in London combining hands-on operational leadership of AP, Billing and credit control teams and processes with responsibility for driving system-led improvement, control, and efficiency across the wider finance systems landscape along with the Finance transformation team.This role has line management responsibility for a team based in London and Porto, working under hybrid and remote arrangements

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Transactional Finance (AP, Billing and Credit control) Management

  • Full management of the Accounts Payable and Billing and Credit control functions, including team leadership, prioritisation and quality control.

  • Oversight of all banking and expense transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and appropriate controls.

  • Own working capital management, including planning and execution of payment runs.

  • Implement and manage the Purchase Order (PO) system end-to-end, liaising with stakeholders across the business to ensure compliance and efficient processing.

  • Act as the escalation point for AP, Billing and Credit control queries, both internal and external, ensuring timely and professional resolution.

  • Oversee & drive DSO performance improvement, setting and monitoring cash collection targets and driving corrective action where collection is behind plan by using escalation channels with various business stakeholders

  • Overseeing the review AR ledgers regularly, identifying and escalating aged debt in line with credit control policy.

  • Line-manage direct reports based in Portugal & London, while providing day-to-day supervision and quality oversight of AP, Billing and Credit Control activity across the UK, Portugal, Germany and Spain.

  • Partner with the Director of Financial Control and wider Finance team on reporting, audit requirements and process governance.

Finance Systems & Process Improvement

  • Support along with Finance Transformation the finance systems automation roadmap, driving the elimination of manual processes and delivering scalable, efficient finance operations.

  • Own the optimisation of the finance systems landscape, reviewing and enhancing NetSuite integrations with Moss, Precoro, Abacum, Salesforce and QV to ensure scalability, data integrity, and accurate revenue recognition.

  • Drive continuous improvement of finance system integrations and workflows, proactively identifying and resolving issues to enhance performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Lead the transformation of Billing and AP processes through enhanced controls, automated workflows, invoice validation, credit management, supplier remittance optimisation, and customer communications.

title: Trust Communications
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

Millions of people build on Lovable, from software that runs new businesses to the tools that power existing ones. At the center of it all is trust. That’s why we’re looking for an exceptional storyteller to spearhead Lovable’s trust, safety, and security communications efforts.

Why Lovable

For decades, the ability to build software belonged to a tiny fraction of the population: the people with the credentials, the technical training, the access. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now.

Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too.

The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway.

What you’ll do

Build and own Lovable’s trust narrative. You’ll own Lovable’s trust narrative in earned, new, and owned media, proactively telling the story of how we think about security, privacy, and safety. You’ll shape the stories that highlight our commitments and ensure we show up in the conversations where trust in AI platforms is being decided right now.

Be the comms partner to our security and trust leadership. You’ll develop and own the spokesperson platforms for our CISO and other senior leaders who speak on our trust efforts, identifying and preparing them for on-stage and media opportunities. You’ll help them become recognized voices on topics of trust in AI software creation.

Own incident communications, end to end. When something doesn’t go as planned, you’re the incident comms lead who ensures clear and swift communications for every audience that needs to hear from us, including media, customers, and employees. You’ll build and run the playbook that lets us move faster each time.

Build relationships with relevant media and creators. You’ll know the voices who matter most in telling our trust story, and you’ll make sure those relationships exist before we need them.

Who you are

You’ve done trust, safety, or security communications. You have proven comms experience across a variety of trust-related topics, from AI safety to security. You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams.

You have real incident experience. You’ve been the incident comms lead more than once, and you’ve probably written a playbook along the way. You bring the attention to detail, precision, speed, and judgment an incident requires.

You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem. Security and trust reporters, analysts, policy-adjacent media, perhaps even researchers. You know who they are, what they care about, and how to earn their attention honestly.

You’re voraciously curious. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to be willing to understand how a platform like ours works well enough to describe an incident accurately and explain a safety decision without hand-waving.

You write clearly and have keen attention to detail. Your writing is precise, human, and accessible, even when the subject matter is complex or the situation is sensitive. You also catch things others may miss.

You’re calm, hands-on, and low-ego. You’ll draft the statements, build the media list, prep the spokesperson, and coordinate across teams yourself. You thrive in environments where the plan often changes and the pace is relentless.

You have 6+ years of experience in communications, with significant time spent on trust and safety, security, or incident communications at a technology company. We care more about the right years than the number of them: judgment under pressure matters more than tenure.

What you need to know

This is a strategic but hands-on role with both proactive and reactive components. That means you’ll need to be comfortable being the person who’s on call when something breaks, while simultaneously leading the charge on work that moves our trust narrative forward. The role itself lives at the intersection of several functions, and you’ll be the one finding the red thread among all that’s happening so we can tell a cohesive story externally.

Lovable is a European company with a global audience. The trust story has to resonate outside of Silicon Valley and our home turf in Stockholm. Wherever you sit, you’ll work across time zones and build relationships with the teams whose work you’re talking about.

Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you’re deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. You find ways to work smarter with AI, to measure what matters, and to step into work that isn’t technically “yours” when the moment calls for it.

title: VP Sales

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking a VP Sales to lead new business development with government and large space sector customers. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thrives on winning major contracts personally, not just directing a team from a distance.

You bring deep, current knowledge of the satellite sales landscape, a track record of closing significant contracts, and the seniority to represent NewOrbit at the highest level with strategic customers.

  • Build strategic relationships: Develop and maintain senior-level relationships across government agencies, primes, and major operators.

  • Set commercial strategy: Shape and execute NewOrbit's sales approach for government and enterprise customers.

  • Represent NewOrbit externally: Executive-level presence at customer meetings, government engagements, and industry events.

  • Partner internally: Work closely with engineering and delivery teams to scope deals that are commercially sound and deliverable.

  • Report to leadership: Own pipeline, forecasting, and deal status reporting to the board.

  • Grow the function: Build out a wider sales team as the business scales.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Satellite sales experience (required): Direct, hands-on experience selling satellites specifically, across the full sales process. Current, up-to-date knowledge of the satellite customer landscape.

  • Deal track record: Demonstrated history of winning significant (single-digit million £) contracts with large space organizations and/or governments.

  • Seniority: Minimum 10 years in space industry sales; realistically 15-20+ years. This is a senior hire.

  • Career focus: Majority, ideally the entirety, of your career spent in the space industry.

  • Relationship-led approach: A strong, established professional network across government, primes, and major operators, built through years of direct engagement in the sector.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

Wichtiger sind deine Motivation, Lernbereitschaft, Freude am Kundenkontakt sowie die Bereitschaft, eigenverantwortlich und unternehmerisch zu arbeiten.

Die notwendigen fachlichen Kenntnisse kannst du dir im Rahmen unserer praxisorientierten Aus- und Weiterbildung aneignen.

Du passt zu unserem Konzept, wenn du:

  • Interesse an Websites, Online-Marketing und Digitalisierung mitbringst.

  • gerne mit Menschen zusammenarbeitest und Kunden beraten möchtest.

  • Analyze and optimize HR processes across the hire-to-retire lifecycle, working with People Operations and process owners to identify inefficiencies, conduct as-is/to-be gap analyses and translate requirements into practical Workday, automation and AI solutions
  • Support hands-on Workday operations and optimization, including approved HRIS transactions, organizational and position management, data maintenance, EIB uploads and functional testing, working within established security and governance frameworks
  • Design, build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, UiPath, Python and GenAI/LLM technologies, including MCPs, custom connectors, exception handling, monitoring and operational support.
  • Build and deploy AI-powered HR tools and internal applications, including Claude-based apps, with appropriate authentication, role-based access, data privacy and governance in collaboration with FlixTech and IT Security.
  • Drive business analysis and technical delivery from requirements and process design through prototyping, integration specifications, SIT/UAT, implementation and adoption, collaborating with Workday tech team on Workday configuration and technical integrations
  • Develop HR technology products and service-delivery solutions using Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo Agents, improving employee and HR experiences through workflow automation, self-service and continuous product improvement

Most HR analyst roles stop at scoping requirements and handing them over. This one doesn't. You will keep Workday running for HR day to day, shape how our processes work in Workday, and build the automation and AI that removes manual work. You'll be the person the People function brings its problems to, and you'll help define how AI & Automation is adopted responsibly across HR at scale.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in HR technology, HR business analysis, HRIS or automation, with strong operational HR domain knowledge across the hire-to-retire lifecycle
  • Strong understanding of Workday Core HCM, business processes, organizational structures, security concepts and HRIS governance, including practical experience with Workday optimization, operational transactions, reporting, data maintenance or EIBs. A Workday (e.g. Core HCM) certification is preferred
  • Strong business analysis skills: gap analysis between as-is Workday processes and feasible to-be processes, requirements engineering, BPMN, and the ability to explain clearly to both HR and technical colleagues what is possible and what is not
  • Strong hands-on programming and automation experience, particularly Python, n8n, UiPath or comparable tools, with proven experience building, troubleshooting and maintaining production workflows. N8n certification is a strong plus
  • A solid understanding of various integration approaches e.g. APIs, custom connectors and enterprise integrations, including REST APIs, SFTP, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, to specify integration requirements for tech teams to ensure secure data exchange between HRIS and other enterprise systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of the Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo agents, together with experience building AI-enabled tools using Claude MCP, GenAI/LLMs or similar technologies and applying appropriate security controls
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently across HR and technology teams

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.

  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Workforce & Business Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope.

This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support.

You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success.

What you'll ship

  • Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget.

  • Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations.

  • Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence.

  • Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend.

  • Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle.

What you'll bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field.

  • You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight.

  • Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained.

  • Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar).

  • You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it.

  • You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Working Student AI Engineer – LLMs, RAG & AI Agents
descriptionHtml:
IMPORTANT Application note

Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you.

About AgentixLake

AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.

Your role

Build AI application components that are ready to be tested, deployed and maintained. You will take ownership of defined engineering work within our generative AI projects, collaborating with colleagues on implementation, review and operational quality.

Our team builds enterprise AI solutions that connect models with useful data and tools. Your work may contribute to document intelligence, knowledge assistants, governed analytics or AI agents that support engineering and operational workflows.

What you will do

Develop Python services and integrations connecting language models to enterprise data, APIs and tools.

Implement document ingestion, chunking, embeddings and retrieval, with source references that users can inspect.

Build structured extraction and validation workflows for complex documents and downstream business systems.

Implement defined agent steps, including tool calls, permission checks, error handling and human approval.

Maintain evaluation cases and compare retrieval quality, answer usefulness, latency and cost as the application changes.

Contribute automated tests, deployment configuration, logging and documentation through reviewed pull requests.

What you bring

Current university enrolment in computer science, AI, data science or a related technical discipline.

Strong practical Python skills and evidence of software you have delivered for actual users, including responsibility for testing and deployment.

Hands-on experience with an LLM application involving retrieval, tool use or structured outputs, and the ability to explain its limitations.

Comfort working with APIs, JSON, Git and code review, and taking a defined task from an agreed requirement to a maintainable implementation.

Clear English communication and an evidence-based approach to debugging and evaluating system behaviour.

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, FastAPI, Docker, vector databases or self-hosted models is valuable. We value sound implementation decisions more than the number of frameworks on your CV.

What you can expect

You will contribute to real delivery work with direct access to experienced engineers and the founders. Expect clear ownership, thoughtful code review and a part-time scope planned around your studies.

How to apply

Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Explain one AI application you built, your individual contribution, how you evaluated it and what you improved after testing. An anonymised description is welcome; please do not share confidential client material.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you.

Stay connected

Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions.

Website: https://agentixlake.com/
